bugs.title: HTTP2 requests may contain invalid headers when sent to servers
bugs.symptoms: HTTP requests handled by an HTTP/2 virtual server may have blank header names when proxied through to the server or when handled via iRules.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server has the HTTP/2 profile assigned. -- Client and the BIG-IP system negotiate/use HTTP/2.
bugs.impact: HTTP/2 applications may generate CSRF-related errors. Alternately, the server may return intermittent (and from the client's perspective, spurious) 400 Bad Request responses.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround other than to remove the HTTP/2 profile from the virtual server.

bugs.title: Reports for AVR are missing data
bugs.symptoms: Some data collected by AVR is missing on some aggregation levels and thus missing from the reports.
bugs.conditions: Using AVR statistics.
bugs.impact: Expected AVR statistics may be missing.
bugs.workaround: Run the following shell command on BIG-IP: sed -i "s|\(\s\)*SET\ p_aggr_to_ts.*$|$1$(grep "SET p_aggr_to_ts" /var/avr/avr_srv_code.sql | sed 's/truncate(/CEILING/' | sed 's/,0)//')|" /var/avr/avr_srv_code.sql
bugs.fix: Time-range selection for aggregation is fixed and now statistics should be aggregated correctly to the next level.

bugs.title: PingAccessAgent causes TMM core
bugs.symptoms: PingAccessAgent can cause TMM to core due to accessing freed memory.
bugs.conditions: It happens in edge case situation. Exact steps are still under investigation. Suspicion is that the client aborts the connection while TMM/PingAccessAgent module is still awaiting response from the PingAccessAgent back-end server.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.

bugs.title: DoS Visibility does not support display of more than 500 attacks and/or virtual servers
bugs.symptoms: If there are more than 500 Attacks or Virtual Servers in the system at a given time, DoS Visibility is unable to consistently show all relevant data. The reasons are both technical and due to performance considerations. This applies to the attacks chart and table, and the virtuals table in the center of the dashboard page. This does not apply to the dimension widgets on the right side.
bugs.conditions: More than 500 Virtual Servers exist, or/and more than 500 DoS Attacks are logged during the selected time period.
bugs.impact: Not all attacks/virtuals are displayed on the DoS Visibility overview page.
bugs.workaround: Zoom into a shorter time period, or use filters to limit the amount of displayed data. Once number of attacks and virtuals are under 500, data should be correct.

bugs.title: Failure when using transactions to create and publish policies
bugs.symptoms: Use batch mode transactions to create Virtual Servers with Policies containing rules.
bugs.conditions: Create and publish in the same transaction a Policy containing rules.
bugs.impact: Operation fails. This occurs because the system is trying to look up a policy that does not exist because the 'create' operation is not yet complete. This might happen when the create and publish operations occur simultaneously, which might happen in response to scripts from iApps, batch mode creation of policies, UCS load, upgrade operation--all try to create domain trust, and all might include the policy create in the same operation.
bugs.workaround: Separate the create Policy and publish Policy operations into two transactions when the Policy contains rules.

bugs.title: Some filters don't work in Security->Reporting->URL Latencies page
bugs.symptoms: If a filter by Virtual Servers or URLs in Security->Reporting->URL Latencies page, the data is not filtered.
bugs.conditions: No special condition.
bugs.impact: It it impossible to filter data in the aforementioned page.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.
bugs.fix: An incorrect SQL query was applied to the statistics database upon such data request. The SQL query is fixed.

bugs.title: Potential MCP memory leak in LTM policy compile code
bugs.symptoms: Failure in processing LTM policy may result in MCP memory leak
bugs.conditions: When Centralized Policy Management (CPM) fails to process LTM policy
bugs.impact: MCP memory leak
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.
bugs.fix: This fix handles rare MCP memory leak which may occur if CPM fails to process LTM policy

bugs.title: German Webtop help window is empty
bugs.symptoms: APM end user configured to use the German language sees empty Webtop help window.
bugs.conditions: -- APM end user configured to use the German language. -- Webtop has been reached and help button clicked.
bugs.impact: Help window is empty. Cannot read help.
bugs.workaround: The following workarounds are available. For each existing Webtop, perform these steps: 1. Go [Text] tab of Customization. 2. Go to Webtop : name : Full Webtop : Help. 3. Replace all double quotation marks: " with single quotation marks: '. 4. Save/Apply For new Webtops, edit the default_webtop.xml to use single quotation marks for language "de", for example, using the vi editor, follow these steps: 1. Type vi and press return. 2. Open /var/sam/www/php_include/webtop/renderer/customization/webtop/default_webtop.xml. 2. For language "de" inside <help_webtop_text> all double quotation marks: " with single quotation marks: '. Now, all new groups have ' by default.

bugs.title: Licensing and phonehome_upload are not using the sync'd key/certificate
bugs.symptoms: After config-sync, the secondary unit's key passphrase does not decrypt the cached key file.
bugs.conditions: The original file for f5_api_com.key is used instead of the cached file.
bugs.impact: phonehome_upload will fail on the secondary unit because the passphrase doesn't match the key file.
bugs.workaround: After sync, copy the file /config/filestore/files_d/Common_d/certificate_key_d/:Common:f5_api_com.key_xxxx over to /config/ssl/ssl.key/f5_api_com.key using the following commands: # cd /config/filestore/files_d/Common_d/certificate_key_d # cp -a :Common:f5_api_com.key_xxxx /config/ssl/ssl.key/f5_api_com.key :Common:f5_api_com.key_xxxx Once the /config/ssl/ssl.key file is in sync, then loading the config with either cached or un-cached file will work fine.
bugs.fix: The system now removes the source-path files and only keeps the cache-path files. phonehome_upload now will work on the standby unit after a config-sync. Without the source-path files which do not get sync'd, there is no danger of re-loading them.

bugs.title: Unable to save an 'Enable ASM' policy rule action with an ASM profile selected
bugs.symptoms: An error is returned instead of the policy rule being saved.
bugs.conditions: -- LTM and ASM are provisioned. -- Security ASM profile. -- LTM policy. -- Within a policy, create a rule that enables ASM with the policy just created.
bugs.impact: Unable to save an 'Enable ASM' policy rule action.
bugs.workaround: Create policy using tmsh.
bugs.fix: ASM Policy can now be updated properly in policy rule page's enable ASM action

bugs.title: Citrix Receiver for Android (v3.13.1) crashes while accessing PNAgent services
bugs.symptoms: Citrix Receiver for Android (v3.13.1) crashes while accessing PNAgent services through F5 BIG-IP APM virtual server. The application closes just after entering the credentials.
bugs.conditions: -- Citrix Receiver for Android (v3.13.1) is used. -- PNAgent replacement mode is configured for BIG-IP APM virtual server.
bugs.impact: No access to published Applications and Desktops through Citrix Receiver for Android.
bugs.fix: System now provides valid data to Citrix Receiver for Android client.

bugs.title: Non-admin user is unable to run save /sys config in tmsh if the admin user is disabled
bugs.symptoms: Non-admin user is unable to run save /sys config in tmsh if the admin user is disabled. ...notice tmsh[32418]: 01420003:5: Cannot load user credentials for user "admin" Current session has been terminated. ...notice tmsh[32418]: 01420003:5: The current session has been terminated. ...err tmsh[32417]: 01420006:3: Project-Id-Version: f5_tmsh 9.7.0 POT-Creation-Date: 2008-05-13 16:18-0700 PO-Revision-Date: YEAR-MO-DA HO:MI+ZONE Last-Translator: F5 Networks <support@f5.com> Language-Team: LANGUAGE <en@li.org> MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8 Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit ...err tmsh[32415]: 01420006:3: UCS saving process failed.
bugs.conditions: The default admin account is disabled, using an alternate user that has the administrator role.
bugs.impact: User is unable to save the configuration.
bugs.workaround: A user with the administrator role can save the config. The root user can save the config.
bugs.fix: If the admin user is not the default user, a non-admin user is able to save the config in tmsh.

bugs.title: Add Minimum Up members required for GTM pool to be up
bugs.symptoms: A pool is marked UP even with one active pool member. If the application servers cannot support all client connections in a single site with fewer pool members, this may result in delayed response or server down.
bugs.conditions: -- GTM pool -- The pool requires a minimum number of members to be available
bugs.impact: If the pool has insufficient pool member resources, the servers could become overloaded and disrupt traffic.
bugs.fix: You can now configure the minimum up members.
bugs.behavior: You can now set the minimum up members: Create gtm pool a test members add { Server1:/Common/vs1 Server1:/Common/vs2 Server1:/Common/vs3 } min-members-up-mode number min-members-up-value 2 Pool minimum up members works with mode and value options where mode has 3 possibilities: OFF, NUMBER and PERCENT. Mode is OFF and the value is 0 by default.

bugs.title: MRF SIP LB - Message corruption when using custom persistence key
bugs.symptoms: If the custom persistence key is not a multiple of 3 bytes, the SIP request message may be corrupted when the via header is inserted.
bugs.conditions: Custom persistence key is not a multiple of 3 bytes
bugs.impact: The SIP request message may be corrupted when the via header is inserted.
bugs.workaround: Pad the custom persistence key to a multiple of 3 bytes in length.
bugs.fix: All persistence key lengths work as expected.

bugs.title: TMM may crash when processing TCP DNS traffic
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, when processing TCP DNS traffic, TMM may crash
bugs.conditions: DNS profile enabled TCP profile enabled AVR enabled ASM enabled
bugs.impact: TMM crash, leading to a failover event.
bugs.fix: TMM processes TCP DNS traffic as expected

bugs.title: DNS::return iRule "loop" checking disabled
bugs.symptoms: In ID 517347, checking was added to attempt to detect infinite loops caused by improper use of the DNS::return iRule command. This is occasionally catching false positive loops resulting in connections being dropped incorrectly.
bugs.conditions: A virtual with a DNS profile that is using the udp profile instead of the udp_gtm_dns profile. An iRule that uses the DNS::return command.
bugs.impact: If a loop is erroneously detected, the connection will be dropped.
bugs.workaround: Where possible use the udp_gtm_dns profile instead of udp on virtuals with a DNS profile. Where possible, use a "return" command immediately after the "DNS::return" command to prevent accidentally calling DNS::return multiple times.
bugs.fix: The loop detection logic has been removed.

bugs.title: TLS1.1 handshake failure on v12.1.3 vCMP guest with earlier BIG-IP version on vCMP host.
bugs.symptoms: TLS1.1 handshake failure on guest. The following error appears in /var/log/ltm: warning tmm[11611]: 01260009:4: Connection error: ssl_hs_cn_vfy_fin:2339: corrupt Finished (20)
bugs.conditions: -- Using the VIPRION 42xx/43xx and B21xx blades. -- Running BIG-IP software earlier than v12.1.3 (for example v12.1.2-hf2) on the vCMP host system. -- Deploying vCMP guest running v12.1.3. -- Using TLS1.1.
bugs.impact: TLS1.1 handshake fails on the guest.
bugs.workaround: Use the same software version on the vCMP host and vCMP guests.
bugs.fix: TLS1.1 handshake no longer fails running v12.x/v13.x vCMP guest with earlier BIG-IP software version on vCMP host.

bugs.title: TMSH tab completion for adding profiles to virtual servers is not working as expected
bugs.symptoms: TMSH tab completion for adding profiles to virtual servers does not work. The list of profiles is not displayed when tab is pressed. root@(localhost)(cfg-sync Standalone)(Active)(/Common)(tmos)# create ltm virtual asdf profiles add { Configuration Items: [enter profile name]
bugs.conditions: List of profiles is not displayed when trying to add profiles during creation of a virtual server.
bugs.impact: List of available profiles is not displayed.
bugs.fix: TMSH tab completion for adding profiles to virtual servers now shows the list of profiles.

bugs.title: Support of virtual wire on VE
bugs.symptoms: Virtual wire can now be configured on BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE).
bugs.conditions: -- Using VE. -- Creating virtual wire configurations.
bugs.impact: You can use virtual machines (VMware ESXi) to create virtual wire configurations.
bugs.workaround: None needed. This is new capability.
bugs.fix: Virtual wire can be created on VMware ESXi machines with VyOS switches. Both tagged and untagged traffic is working as expected.
bugs.behavior: Virtual wire can now be configured on BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE).

bugs.title: Eventd restarts on NULL pointer access
bugs.symptoms: The loop that reads /config/eventd.xml to load configuration data processes data in 1024-byte chunks. If the size of the file is a multiple of 1024 bytes, the end of file condition that terminates the file read does not occur until the subsequent read. The subsequent read returns zero (0) bytes and passes an empty buffer to the parser, which causes eventd to restart repeatedly.
bugs.conditions: The length of the file /config/eventd.xml is a multiple of 1024 bytes.
bugs.impact: Causes eventd to crash.
bugs.workaround: To work around the problem, insert whitespace in /config/eventd.xml to pad the file to a size that is not a multiple of 1024 bytes.

bugs.title: a specific kind of request with can be incorrectly identified as a login request
bugs.symptoms: A regular request may be considered a login request and will be logged incorrectly
bugs.conditions: Parameter configured as json parameter, and a login is configured
bugs.impact: This can result in incorrect logging of login requests.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with incorrect login request logging.

bugs.title: Cannot add 'secure' attributes to several ASM cookies
bugs.symptoms: There is an option to add 'secure' attribute to ASM cookies. There are some specific cookies which this option does not apply on.
bugs.conditions: -- ASM policy is attached to the virtual server. -- Internal parameter 'cookie_secure_attr' flag is enabled, along with either of the following: + Using HTTPS traffic. + The 'assume https' internal parameter is also enabled. -- Along with one of the following: + Web Scraping' feature is enabled. + 'Bot Detection' feature is enabled. + The 'brute force' feature is enabled using CATPCHA.
bugs.impact: Some cookies do not have the 'secure' attributes.

bugs.title: Fixed iControl REST not listing GTM Listeners
bugs.symptoms: When using iControl REST to get a list of GTM Listeners, no listeners will be returned.
bugs.conditions: Use iControl REST to get a list of GTM Listeners
bugs.impact: Cannot get a list of GTM Listeners by iControl REST
bugs.workaround: Use iControl REST to get a list of all LTM Virtual Servers, and then look for virtual-servers with a DNS Profile
bugs.fix: Fixed issue preventing iControl REST from returning a list of GTM Listeners

bugs.title: Disable DSA keys for public-key and host-based authentication in Common Criteria mode
bugs.symptoms: On a BIG-IP system configured for Common Criteria (CC) mode, DSA keys can still be used for key-based authentication to the BIG-IP system.
bugs.conditions: -- Running a CC release with CC Mode enabled. -- Attempt to SSH-connect to the BIG-IP system from another system with a DSA key. -- That DSA key is present in the BIG-IP system's authorized_keys file.
bugs.impact: If the key is in the BIG-IP system's authorized_keys file, public-key authentication succeeds, when DSA authentication should be disabled in CC mode.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.
bugs.fix: DSA SSH keys are now disabled for public-key and host-based authentication in Common Criteria mode, as expected.

bugs.title: TMUI - Multiple Certificates cannot be deleted in a single operation
bugs.symptoms: Unable to delete all unused certificates/keys in single operation. If a certificate/key delete fails, the delete operation exits, leaving the remaining certificates and keys.
bugs.conditions: -- Multiple certificates/keys assigned to profiles. -- At least one of the certificates/keys is in use. -- Try to delete all certificates/keys from the SSL certificate list screen in a single operation.
bugs.impact: Cannot delete multiple certificates/keys in a single operation. If the delete operation fails because one certificate/key is in use, the remaining certificate/keys are not deleted, so you must perform the operation again.
bugs.workaround: Ignore the certificate/key that failed, and rerun the delete operation until all certificates/keys are deleted.
bugs.fix: The delete operation now skips certificates/keys that are in use and deletes all other remaining certificates/keys.

bugs.title: tmm restarts when using ACCESS::perflow get' in certain events
bugs.symptoms: tmm will restart when using 'ACCESS::perflow get' if the per-request policy has not been started yet.
bugs.conditions: Use 'ACCESS::perflow get' iRule in an event that runs before the per-request policy (e.g., CLIENT_ACCEPTED).
bugs.impact: tmm cores and traffic flow will be interrupted while it restarts.
bugs.fix: Initialization of certain variables was reworked so that the iRule command will not cause a core anymore if the per-flow value is unavailable due to the per-request policy not having been started yet.

bugs.title: ACED core file during restart
bugs.symptoms: During shutdown ACED occasionally produces a core file.
bugs.conditions: A race condition during shutdown occasionally produces a core file.
bugs.impact: RSA SecurID authentication fails briefly while ACED restarts.
bugs.workaround: The core file can be ignored.
bugs.fix: A race condition in ACED that caused a core file during shutdown has been fixed.

bugs.title: Enable DIAMETER::persist reset in MR_EGRESS events
bugs.symptoms: "DIAMETER::persist reset" is prohibited in MR_EGRESS by .jet rules. TCL error: /Common/persist-irule <MR_EGRESS> - invalid command name "}" while executing "}
bugs.conditions: Load balancing Diameter service. Configure iRule for bi-directional persistence.
bugs.impact: Unable to maintain desired persistence in fail over.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.

bugs.title: Some bot detected features might not work as expected on Single Page Applications
bugs.symptoms: Some client side features do not work correctly when enabling single page application.
bugs.conditions: Enabling single page application (on DoS or ASM), and Web Scraping-> Persistent Client Identification
bugs.impact: Captcha challenge causes a loop of ajax requests.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.
bugs.fix: Fixing Persistent Client Identification for Single Page Applications.

bugs.title: When using scp into BIG-IP, user must specify the target filename
bugs.symptoms: File transfers via scp allow indistinct target filenames.
bugs.conditions: File transfers using scp into BIG-IP.
bugs.impact: Transfers allowed without explicit specification of target filename.
bugs.fix: Users without Advanced Shell Access must specify a target file name when using scp command, such as: $ scp source_filename1 user1@BIG-IP-ADDR:/tmp/target_filename1
bugs.behavior: When using scp to copy files to BIG-IP, you must specify the target filename in the URL path, like so: $ scp filename1 root@100.100.28.39:/tmp/target_filename1

bugs.title: Possible memory leak when reusing statistics rows in tables
bugs.symptoms: The handling of the pointers to memory in the statistics tables includes a path that zeros out a pointer to more memory that should be free'd. This means the memory is not free'd for that case.
bugs.conditions: This condition is usually only hit when the entire file is being deleted and so it doesn't matter that the list is not fully traversed.
bugs.impact: When slabs are being reused this bug may cause a memory leak.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround at this time.
bugs.fix: The code has been fixed to properly follow the list.

bugs.title: Waagent updated to 2.2.21
bugs.symptoms: Microsoft updates waagent via an opensource process, but it is not compatible with BIG-IP software, and so cannot be upgraded outside of BIG-IP releases. Without this, Microsoft will not support older releases of BIG-IP systems in their environment.
bugs.conditions: Using Microsoft Azure.
bugs.impact: Microsoft does not support the version of waagent shipped as part of BIG-IP software.
bugs.fix: Waagent was updated to 2.2.21 from Microsoft along with F5 changes for compatibility with BIG-IP software.

bugs.title: TMM SIGSEGV crash in poolmbr_conn_dec.
bugs.symptoms: TMM cores in poolmbr_conn_dec function.
bugs.conditions: A connection limit is reached on a VS having an iRule using LB::reselect and a pool using request queueing.
