bugs.symptoms: The username table in the AVR DB reaches a huge size, you observe high I/O wait and high CPU utilization.
bugs.conditions: AVR configuration with a very large number of different users.
bugs.impact: High I/O wait on the device. It might cause tmm core dues to tmm not getting enough CPU. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: The following command disables the collection of the username (which prevents this issue): tmsh mod sys db avr.collapseasmhttpusername value disable

bugs.title: Adding option to mask each AFM stats separately
bugs.symptoms: If the AFM stats are enabled, the BIG-IP system logs ACL, DoS L3 firewall events, IP Reputation, DNS, and SIP stats, and you are unable to mask any of them. It might cause performance issues.
bugs.conditions: -- AFM provisioned. -- AFM stats enabled.
bugs.impact: All AFM stats are collected (ACL, DoS L3 firewall events, IP Reputation, DNS, SIP). There is no way to specify a subset of stats to collect.

bugs.title: Import/create policy may fail after failed upgrade UCS load
bugs.symptoms: Import/create ASM policy may fail after a failed upgrade UCS load.
bugs.conditions: An upgrade UCS load ends in failure.
bugs.impact: Import/create ASM policy may fail.
bugs.workaround: As a workaround, the policy import schema from the current version can be copied: ---------------------------------------------------------------------- /bin/cp -f /ts/var/schema/negsig/common.xsd /ts/var/schema/negsig/common.xsd.pre_overwrite /bin/cp -f /ts/share/*.xsd /ts/var/schema /bin/cp -f /ts/share/negsig/*.xsd /ts/var/schema/negsig [[ $(stat -c%s "/ts/var/schema/negsig/common.xsd.pre_overwrite") -gt $(stat -c%s "/ts/var/schema/negsig/common.xsd") ]] && /bin/cp -f /ts/var/schema/negsig/common.xsd.pre_overwrite /ts/var/schema/negsig/common ---------------------------------------------------------------------- This can be performed safely at any time, and does not require ASM restart.

bugs.title: Policy Compilation may cause MCPD to crash
bugs.symptoms: If a policy has rules involving IPv6 addresses, and the addresses differ only on 32-bit boundaries, then the compilation of that policy may cause MPCD to crash.
bugs.conditions: -- A policy is attached to a virtual server. -- That policy contains conditions that involve IPv6 addresses. -- The addresses in different rules differ only on 32-bit boundaries.
bugs.impact: MCPD cores, and then restarts. The policy is not usable.
bugs.workaround: You can try either of the following: -- It may be possible to create multiple rules from a given rule by altering the netmask. -- Another possibility is to add a placeholder rule with no action that matches IP addresses differently.
bugs.fix: Policies involving matching IP addresses now compile correctly.

bugs.title: Incorrect recommendation in Online Help of Proactive Bot Defense
bugs.symptoms: The online help of Proactive Bot Defense within the DoS profile shows the following under the 'Cross-Domain Requests' section: Allow configured domains; validate in bulk: ... We recommend this option if your web site has many cross-domain resources. Allow configured domains; validate upon request: ... We recommend this option if your web site does not have many cross-domain resources. The recommendation is actually the reverse: for many cross-domain resources, it is better to use 'validate upon request'.
bugs.conditions: Application has multiple cross-domain resources.
bugs.impact: Confusing documentation. The recommendation is actually the reverse: for many cross-domain resources, it is better to use 'validate upon request'.
bugs.workaround: For many cross-domain resources, it is better to use 'validate upon request'.
bugs.fix: The online help of Proactive Bot Defense has been corrected under the 'Cross-Domain Requests' section.

bugs.title: Cannot access GUI via hostname when it contains _ (underscore character)
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP allows configuring hostname with embedded '_' (underscore). However the BIG-IP GUI is not accessible when hostname includes '_', and results in a 400 Bad Request.
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP hostname includes '_'
bugs.impact: BIG-IP GUI cannot be accessed.
bugs.workaround: No known work around if having '_' in hostname is a requirement.

bugs.title: BIG-IP floods packet with MAC '01-80-c2-00-00-00' to VLAN instead of dropping it
bugs.symptoms: In STP 'passthru' mode, any packet sent to the BIG-IP system with a destination MAC of 01-80-c2-00-00-00 is treated as an STP bridge protocol data unit (BPDU), and is flooded to the VLAN.
bugs.conditions: -- The BIG-IP system is configured for STP 'passthru' mode -- The BIG-IP system receives a packet with MAC 01-80-c2-00-00-00.
bugs.impact: A packet that is not an STP BPDU, but is sent to the same destination MAC address may be flooded as if it was a BPDU.
bugs.fix: Added an STP drop rule for certain LLDP-type packets sent to STP destination MAC: # list sys db bcm56xxd.rules.lldp_drop sys db bcm56xxd.rules.lldp_drop { value "disable" } It is disabled by default. You must manually set it to cause the LLDP frames to be dropped in STP passthrough mode.

bugs.title: Category ID for new Traffic Intelligence Categories needs range check
bugs.symptoms: In Traffic Intelligence Categories, while creating new URL Category allows category ID to be outside range 28672-32768. There is no indication in the GUI that it needs to be within that range.
bugs.conditions: -- AFM license with Traffic Classification feature flag enabled. -- Create New URL Category with Category ID outside valid range.
bugs.impact: GUI allows creation of New URL Category with Category ID outside valid range.

bugs.title: Ordinal value in LTM policy rules sometimes do not work as expected
bugs.symptoms: Which actions trigger in a first-match policy should depend on the ordinal of their rule. Sometimes, this does not work correctly.
bugs.conditions: The conditions under which this occurs are not known.
bugs.impact: LTM policy rules do not execute in the expected order.
bugs.workaround: It may be possible to re-arrange the rules to avoid the incorrect action execution.

bugs.title: Optimistic ACKs degrade Fast L4 statistics
bugs.symptoms: Fast L4 Analytics reports very large integers for goodput.
bugs.conditions: Endpoints send ACKs for data that has not been sent.
bugs.impact: Goodput statistics are not usable in certain data sets.
bugs.fix: Additional checks prevent analytics from trusting optimistic ACKs.

bugs.title: SYN w/ data disrupts stat collection in Fast L4
bugs.symptoms: Fast L4 analytics reports very large integers for goodput.
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP receives SYNs with attached data.
bugs.impact: Goodput data is unreliable.
bugs.fix: Data coupled with the SYN breaks the check for a Fast L4 state change. The connection can still function normally, but statistics collection is reliant on the state change to initialize things properly. The system now ensures the correct state under these conditions, so statistics are measured correctly.

bugs.title: Cross origin AJAX requests are blocked Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) protection
bugs.symptoms: When enabling Single Page Application (SPA) option in ASM, cross origin AJAX requests are resulting in the following error in the browser console, and site application might not work: Access to XMLHttpRequest at 'https://x.com' from origin 'https://www.y.com' has been blocked by CORS policy: The value of the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header in the response must not be the wildcard '*' when the request's credentials mode is 'include'. The credentials mode of requests initiated by the XMLHttpRequest is controlled by the withCredentials attribute.
bugs.conditions: -- ASM with SPA enabled -- App is sending cross-origin requests
bugs.impact: App does not work as expected.
bugs.workaround: Using an iRule, add the following headers to the response: -- Access-Control-Allow-Origin with originating domain. -- Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
bugs.fix: This release adds the relevant CORS fields to responses.

bugs.title: TMM may crash or iRule processing might be incorrect
bugs.symptoms: After modifying an iRule: - The iRules on one or more virtual servers might fire in the wrong order. - The iRules on one or more virtual servers might not fire at all. - TMM might crash if the iRule event is modified again. - TMM might crash if a virtual server is modified.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when all of the following conditions are met: - An iRule is in use on more than one virtual server. - The iRule occupies a different position in the iRule list on various virtual servers, and one or more of the other iRules define the same event. - The iRule event is modified.
bugs.impact: Traffic interruption while TMM restarts. Incorrect iRule processing.

bugs.title: Send Disconnect-Peer-Request message per RFC3588.5.4
bugs.symptoms: Following a connection close, the system continues sending Device Watchdog Request (DWR) messages to the pool member instead of sending a Disconnect Peer Request (DPR) event when a pool member is disabled/forced offline.
bugs.conditions: -- MRF Diameter is configured. -- Connection close occurs.
bugs.impact: The BIG-IP system does not comply with the RFC for the event of connection close.
bugs.fix: The BIG-IP system now sends DPR instead of DWR in the event a pool member is force-offline.

bugs.title: When using NetHSM integration, after upgrade to 14.1.0 or later (or creating keys using fipskey.nethsm), BIG-IP cannot use the keys
bugs.symptoms: For Thales: The ltm/log shows SSL handshake failures with similar lines (this is for Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange): -- warning bigip1 tmm1[28813] 01260013 SSL Handshake failed for TCP 192.0.2.1:5106 -> 192.0.2.200:5607 -- warning bigip1 tmm1[28813] 01260009 Connection error: ssl_hs_vfy_sign_srvkeyxchg:13583: sign_srvkeyxchg (80) -- debug bigip1 tmm1[28813] 01260036 FIPS acceleration device error: fips_poll_completed_reqs: req: 4 status: 0x1 : Cancel -- err bigip1 pkcs11d[26259] 01680002 Key table lookup failed. error. After enabling pkcs11d debug, the pkcs11d.debug log shows: -- 2019-10-03 11:21:50 [6399] t00075a9a462b0000: pkcs11: 000008D9 D obj_match_attribute class CKO_PRIVATE_KEY attribute CKA_CLASS -- 2019-10-03 11:21:50 [6399] t00075a9a462b0000: pkcs11: 000008D9 D obj_match_attribute type CKA_CLASS matches -- 2019-10-03 11:21:50 [6399] t00075a9a462b0000: pkcs11: 000008D9 D obj_match_attribute class CKO_PRIVATE_KEY attribute CKA_ID -- 2019-10-03 11:21:50 [6399] t00075a9a462b0000: pkcs11: 000008D9 D obj_match_attribute type CKA_ID does not match <=== For Safenet: -- warning tmm1[17495]: 01260009:4: Connection error: ssl_hs_vfy_sign_srvkeyxchg:13544: sign_srvkeyxchg (80) -- warning tmm1[17495]: 01260013:4: SSL Handshake failed for TCP 10.1.1.11:6009 -> 10.1.1.201:443 -- err pkcs11d[5856]: 01680002:3: Key table lookup failed. error.
bugs.conditions: 1. Keys were created on earlier versions of BIG-IP software, no matter if using tmsh (Safenet) or using fipskey.nethsm (Thales, Safenet) and the device was upgraded to 14.1.0 or later. 2. Keys were created on BIG-IP v14.1.0 or later directly, using fipskey.nethsm (Thales). For Safenet, fipskey.nethsm was deprecated in 14.0.0.
bugs.impact: SSL handshake failures.
bugs.workaround: There are two workarounds: -- Re-create the keys using tmsh command. IMPORTANT: This workaround is suitable for deployments that are new and not in production. -- Re-import the keys from nethsm using: tmsh install sys crypto key <key_label> from-nethsm You can find the key_label here: -- The rightmost string in the output of the Thales command: nfkminfo -l -- The string after label= in the 'cmu list' command for Safenet.

bugs.title: IKEv2 auth encryption is missing defensive coding that checks object validity
bugs.symptoms: Auth signature crypto callback does not check objects for validity before encryption.
bugs.conditions: Encryption during auth signature callback processing for IKE_AUTH.
bugs.impact: IPsec tunnels go down when tmm cores in rare situations.
bugs.workaround: No workaround is known at this time.
bugs.fix: Add defensive coding that checks object validity during auth encryption.

bugs.title: Callback for Diffie Hellman crypto is missing defensive coding
bugs.symptoms: Destruction of objects during Diffie Hellman crypto callback does not first check for object validity.
bugs.conditions: Async callback for Diffie Hellman crypto call when objects no longer look valid.
bugs.impact: IPsec tunnels down during tmm core in rare cases.
bugs.workaround: No work around is known at this time.
bugs.fix: Add defensive coding to forestall action when objects look invalid.

bugs.title: Deploying the f5_microsoft_exchange_2010_2013 template generates erroneous APM policy customization-group.
bugs.symptoms: There is an erroneously named APM policy customization-group after importing a BIG-IP system into BIG-IQ, where the BIG-IP system already has a deployed iApp based on the f5_microsoft_exchange_2010_2013 template: [ERROR]... Missing cache path for Kind: tm:apm:policy:customization-group:templates:templatesstate, Object: /Common/Exchange_2013_internal.APM.app/logon.inc.
bugs.conditions: -- The BIG-IP system has a deployed iApp based on the f5_microsoft_exchange_2010_2013 template (f5.microsoft_exchange_2010_2013_cas.v1.6.2). -- Importing the BIG-IP system into the BIG-IQ for managing.
bugs.impact: The resulting configuration contains an incorrectly named APM policy customization-group. For example, the group name is: /Common/Exchange_2013_internal.APM.app/exch_custom_logon:logon.inc The name should be: /Common/Exchange_2013_internal.APM.app/exch_custom_logon_ag:logon.inc" Specifically, the '_ag' suffix on the first part of the filename is missing.
bugs.workaround: You have two options: -- Modify the bigip.conf file by searching to 'app-service /Common/Exchange_2013_internal.APM.app/Exchange_2013_internal.APM' and changing 'app:exch_custom_logon' to 'app:exch_custom_logon_ag'. -- Upgrade to the latest Exchange iApp and iApp deployed to BIQ-IQ with version 6.1.0-0.0.1224.0.

bugs.title: BIG-IP system forwards BPDUs with 802.1Q header when in STP pass-through mode
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions BIG-IP may forward VLAN-tagged frames even if the VLAN is not defined on the ingress interface.
bugs.conditions: Tagged VLANs in use. STP pass-through mode enabled.
bugs.impact: Frames not delivered as expected.
bugs.workaround: Disable global STP.
bugs.fix: Frames now delivered as expected.

bugs.title: Traffic Intelligence IM pkg for 14.1.0 fails to install on base build version 14.1.0.x
bugs.symptoms: Traffic Intelligence IM pkg for v14.1.0 fails to install on base build version v14.1.0.1 through v14.1.0.4. This is due to strict version check in upgrade scripts.
bugs.conditions: When hitless upgrade for traffic intelligence with version 14.1.0 is used on base build v14.1.0.1 through v14.1.0.4,l.
bugs.impact: The process it fails to load/instal. The system does not receive the latest traffic intelligence signatures.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround other than requesting a purpose-built traffic intelligence IM for that particular build.
bugs.fix: You can now install 14.1.0 IM on any other 14.1.0.x with minor version update.

bugs.title: OAuth database instance appears empty after upgrade from v13.x
bugs.symptoms: The database from a prior configuration does not seem to have any tokens. The tokens are being stored in a new database with a different name.
bugs.conditions: Upgrade from v13.x. -- The name of one OAuth database instance is duplicated entirely in another instance name (for example, 'oauthdb' and 'oauthdbprod').
bugs.impact: Old database seems to have lost tokens. In the case of these two database instances: oauthdb oauthdbprod Because the name 'oauthdb' is also present in the name 'oathdbprod', the system creates a new database instance of 'oauthdb' at upgrade, so oauthdb will have an empty database.
bugs.workaround: Before upgrading, do the following: 1) Copy database oauth to another database with a completely different name. 2) Copy tokens in new database to the old, empty database.
bugs.fix: The new database instance is no longer created created, so the old database now retains tokens after upgrade.

bugs.title: Unable to associate cipher group with long name profile
bugs.symptoms: TMM reports the following error when cipher group is associated with client SSL or server SSL profiles: cipher group: invalid profile name
bugs.conditions: Client SSL or server SSL has a name longer than 31 characters.
bugs.impact: Unable to configure cipher groups with certain profiles.
bugs.workaround: Shorten the profile name to be fewer than 31 characters.

bugs.title: IPv6 Management route is preferred over IPv6 tmm route
bugs.symptoms: The IPv6 Management route has lower metric than the static IPv6 tmm route. As a result, traffic that matches the default route goes to the mgmt interface.
bugs.conditions: Create an IPv6 mgmt route and a static IPv6 tmm route on the same BIG-IP system. IPv6 routes from TMM are injected at metric 1024.
bugs.impact: The incorrect routing table sends the traffic that matches the default route to the mgmt interface.
bugs.fix: The IPv4 and IPv6 management routes now have a metric value of 4096. Default value of static routes are 1 for IPv4 and 1024 for IPv6. This makes static routes (TMM routes) preferred over management routes, which is correct behavior.

bugs.title: Deleting a port from a single-port trunk does not work.
bugs.symptoms: Deleting a port from a single-port trunk does notwork.
bugs.conditions: 1. Disable all ports for a trunk, for example by disabling them on a directly connected switch. The last port is not deleted correctly. 2. Re enable some other ports, the trunk now also uses the disabled port.
bugs.impact: No user connectivity depending on which port is used.
bugs.fix: Fixed deleting a port from a single-port trunk.

bugs.title: Reconstructed POST request is dropped after DID cookies are deleted
bugs.symptoms: POST Request is dropped during DID challenge.
bugs.conditions: POST request is issued a DID challenge.
bugs.impact: Request is dropped.
bugs.fix: Reconstructed POST request are no longer dropped after DID cookies are deleted.

bugs.title: Auto-disable TMM.HTTP.TCL.Validation when APM is provisioned
bugs.symptoms: The db variable Tmm.HTTP.TCL.Validation is enabled by default. This db variable should be disabled when APM is provisioned/enabled, and when ACCESS::restrict_irule_event is disabled and HTTP_RESPONSE_RELEASE events are detected with the assigned iRules.
bugs.conditions: Steps to Reproduce: 1. Fresh install of APM 2. Define the following iRule in the virtual server. when CLIENT_ACCEPTED { ACCESS::restrict_irule_events disable } when HTTP_REQUEST { set u [ HTTP::uri ] log local0. "XXX: [ HTTP::uri ]" } when HTTP_RESPONSE_RELEASE { log local0. "XXX: [ HTTP::status ] [ HTTP::header Location ]" set l [ HTTP::header Location ] if { $l starts_with {/my.policy} } { append l {?modified_by_irule=1} HTTP::header replace Location $l } elseif { $l starts_with {/renderer/agent_logon_page_form.eui} } { # Next response will be the real response to the client. ACCESS::log "XXX: lp_seen" set lp_seen 1 } if { [ HTTP::status ] == 200 && [ info exists lp_seen ] && $lp_seen == 1 } { unset lp_seen HTTP::header insert X-MyAppSpecialHeader 1 } } 3. Configure START :: LOGON PAGE :: ALLOW policy. 4. Access the virtual server.
bugs.impact: TCP reset triggered when it should not. With respect to the specific condition described, the system should post the logon page.
bugs.workaround: Manually disable Tmm.HTTP.TCL.Validation.

bugs.title: ec_point_formats extension might be included in the server hello even if not specified in the client hello
bugs.symptoms: RFC 5246 states that if an extension does not exist in the client hello, it must not exist in the server hello. When an EC cipher suite is selected, the server might send the ec_point_formats extension, even if none exists in the client hello.
bugs.conditions: -- An EC cipher suite is selected. -- The client does not send an ec_point_formats extension.
bugs.impact: Some clients abort the connection in this case.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround other than not configuring any EC cipher suites.
bugs.fix: With this change, the server does not send an unsolicited ec_point_formats extension.

bugs.title: Portal Access: JavaScript object with reserved property names may be handled incorrectly
bugs.symptoms: JavaScript object may contain properties with names that match reserved names like 'default' or 'for'. If such a property is defined using getter / setter functions, Portal Access handles it incorrectly.
bugs.conditions: JavaScript object with property with reserved name defined via getter / setter functions, for example: a = {get default () {}}
bugs.impact: JavaScript code cannot be rewritten; web application may not work correctly.
bugs.workaround: Use an iRule to rename such a property in JavaScript object.

bugs.title: TMC does not allow inline addresses with non-zero Route-domain.
bugs.symptoms: When trying to create a traffic-matching-criteria with inline addresses with non-zero Route-domain, receive an error: TMC(/Common/tmc333) and addresses within the address list have different route domain.
bugs.conditions: Attempting to creating a traffic-matching-criteria with inline address (source or destination) and non-zero route-domain, e.g.: create ltm traffic-matching-criteria tmc333 destination-address-inline 111.111.111.194 source-address-inline 0.0.0.0 route-domain 100
bugs.impact: Cannot create the traffic-matching-criteria.
bugs.fix: You can now create a traffic-matching-criteria with inline addresses with non-zero Route-domain.

bugs.title: BIG-IP VE HA actions are not invoked when offload hardware hangs
bugs.symptoms: When TMM detects a crypto or compression offload device hang it does not invoke the configured high availability (HA) action.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when the following conditions exist: -- BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) Cryptographic Offload is licensed. -- BIG-IP VE VM has been assigned QuickAssist Virtual Functions (VFs). -- A QuickAssist endpoint associated with one of the VFs hangs. -- BIG-IP VE executes crypto or compression operations.
bugs.impact: Client requests eventually time out.

bugs.title: API Protection Profile requires URI Path Property to attach to virtual server
bugs.symptoms: Unable to attach API Protection Profile to virtual server if API Protection Profile does not have a URI defined in the Path Properties.
bugs.conditions: The API Protection Profile has no paths configured.
bugs.impact: Cannot attach an API Protection Profile to the virtual server without setting paths in that profile.
bugs.workaround: None. To add an API Protection Profile, there needs to be at least one path.
bugs.fix: The virtual server page now displays all the API Protection Profiles that the admin has configured, not only the ones that have paths configured.

bugs.title: APM fails to handle Remote Desktop Gateway connections from standalone RDP clients after fresh install
bugs.symptoms: Remote Desktop (RD) Gateway connections from standalone RDP clients on Mac/iOS/Android fail against a fresh APM installation. Following error is logged into /var/log/ltm: ... 01220001:3: TCL error: /Common/_sys_APM_Citrix_SmartAccess <HTTP_REQUEST> - ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED (line 1) invoked from within "HTTP::path"
bugs.conditions: - Fresh APM installation. - Standalone Mac/iOS/Android RDP client uses APM as RD Gateway.
bugs.impact: Connection can't be established.
bugs.workaround: Disable "tmm.http.tcl.validation" variable: # tmsh modify sys db tmm.http.tcl.validation value disable
bugs.fix: Remote Desktop (RD) Gateway connections from standalone RDP clients on Mac/iOS/Android are not failing anymore against fresh APM installation.

bugs.title: Excessive 'GuestInfoAddNicEntry: NIC limit (16) reached' logging
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP logs 'GuestInfoAddNicEntry: NIC limit (16) reached' messages every 30 seconds.
bugs.conditions: Configuring more than 16 VLANs on VMware where the VLAN limit is 16.
bugs.impact: BIG-IP logs 'GuestInfoAddNicEntry: NIC limit (16) reached' every 30 Seconds, and it logs one entry for every limit above the maximum (for example if you configure 20 VLANs the message will be logged 4 times).

bugs.title: Importing a cert with an expiration time of 'Dec 31 23:59:59 9999' causes errors in the GUI
bugs.symptoms: General database error retrieving information when loading the SSL certificate management page: Certificate Management : Traffic Certificate Management : SSL Certificate List.
bugs.conditions: Import a certificate that has an expiration date of 'Dec 31 23:59:59 9999 GMT' into the BIG-IP system. Note: Some of these certificates are generated by Cisco Expressway.
bugs.impact: Error message is posted. Unable to manage certificates in the GUI.
bugs.workaround: Adjust the timezone to GMT and restart tomcat using the following commands: tmsh modify sys ntp timezone GMT bigstart restart tomcat
bugs.fix: GUI now shows appropriate time in local timezone for certificates with expiration time of 'Dec 31 23:59:59 9999'.

bugs.title: Virtual wire on a BIG-IP does not pass traffic when configured over two terminating link aggregation/trunk ports.
bugs.symptoms: Traffic does not pass through the BIG-IP system.
bugs.conditions: - Configure two trunk/LAG ports on a BIG-IP system. - Create a virtual wire across it.
bugs.impact: Loss of service across the virtual wire.
bugs.fix: Corrected the faulty validation checks during configuration that were a result of collateral damage.

bugs.title: APMD Core when CRLDP Auth fails to download revoked certificate
bugs.symptoms: Download CRLDP Auth fails to download revoked certificates, so the list of revoked certificate remains empty (NULL). APMD cores while accessing this empty (NULL) list.
bugs.conditions: Empty revoked-certificate list handling.
bugs.impact: APMD core. No access policy enforcement for user session or any MPI-reliant processes, such as rewrite and websso while apmd restarts.
bugs.fix: The system now checks for empty revoked certificate lists (for NULL) and lets the validation OK (because there is nothing to validate against).

bugs.title: DNS Cache RRSET Evictions Stat not increasing
bugs.symptoms: In the DNS Cache stats, the 'Resource Record Cache' statistic of 'Evictions' does not increase.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when the cache is full enough for records to be evicted.
bugs.impact: The 'Evictions' statistics do not increase when those records are evicted. Incorrect statistics accounting.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue preventing the DNS Cache's 'Resource Record Cache' statistic from counting 'Evictions'.

bugs.title: iControl SOAP get_certificate_list commands take a long time to complete when there are a large number of certificates
bugs.symptoms: The following commands take a long time to complete when there are a large number of certificates: get_certificate_list() get_certificate_list_v2() get_certificate_list_v3()
bugs.conditions: -- Using the get_certificate_list(), get_certificate_list_v2(), and get_certificate_list_v3() commands to get certificate information. -- A large number of certificates (typically in the thousands) are installed on the BIG-IP system.
bugs.impact: Slowness might cause timeouts in applications that are calling these functions.
bugs.workaround: Use iControl REST API corresponding to sys/file/ssl-cert.

bugs.title: Introspect request might fail for 'refreshed' access token
bugs.symptoms: If an Introspect request is made after an opaque access token has expired and the access token was refreshed with 'reuse-access-token' config option, the subsequent access token Introspect request fails.
bugs.conditions: The following conditions must apply for it to show up: 1. Reuse Access Token config option is enabled. 2. Access Token being issued is opaque. 3. Introspect request is made for the access token after it expired. 4. Refresh the access token. 5. Introspect requests the access token after 'refresh'.
bugs.impact: The Introspect request fails. The system reports a valid opaque access token as not-active.
bugs.workaround: This issue does not occur if any one of the following is true: -- The opaque access token is refreshed before it has expired. -- The 'reuse-access-token' config is disabled. -- The Introspect request is not made for an expired access token.
bugs.fix: Introspect request no longer fails for 'refreshed' access token under these conditions.

bugs.title: While using explicit or transparent http type service on SSL Orchestrator, TMM cores.
bugs.symptoms: TMM can core while using http type service (explicit or transparent ) on SSL Orchestrator.
bugs.conditions: SSL Orchestrator configured while using explicit or transparent http type service.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while TMM restarts.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer cores using explicit or transparent http type service on SSL Orchestrator.

bugs.title: TMM memory leak
bugs.symptoms: When a Clustered Multiprocessing (CMP) disabled virtual server enters syncookie mode the flows created on TMM instances other than tmm0 are not removed, resulting in a TMM memory leak. Note: CMP-disabled virtual servers are not distributed among the available TMM processes, but instead are processed on tmm0.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server is CMP disabled. -- The same virtual server enters syncookie mode.
bugs.impact: Elevated memory utilization that may impact performance. In extreme cases, it might lead to out-of-memory crash.
bugs.workaround: Make sure the virtual server is not CMP disabled, for example, avoid using global variables in iRules.
bugs.fix: Flows of CMP-disabled virtual servers are now properly removed from all TMM instances.

bugs.title: BIG-IP VE with ixlv devices does not reliably pass some traffic after hard-boot
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) with ixlv devices (Intel X710/XL710/XXV710 family) might not reliably pass traffic after a hard boot of the host on which it runs. The tmm log contains messages similar to the following: ixlv[0:8.0]: Error: AQ returned error -1 to request 10! ixlv[0:8.0]: Error: Error -1 waiting for PF to complete operation 4 ixlv[0:8.0]: Error: WARNING: Error adding VF mac filter! ixlv[0:8.0]: Error: WARNING: Device may not receive traffic! The host's kernel log might contain messages similar to the following: i40e 0000:06:00.0: VF is not trusted, switch the VF to trusted to add more functionality
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP VE with one or more virtual functions that utilize the ixlv driver within tmm. -- Hard reboot the host and observe traffic. Note: This issue might be dependent upon the version of the PF driver in the host, and has been observed with at least 2.1.4 and 2.4.10, but this list is incomplete.
bugs.impact: IPv6 and other network traffic may be handled unreliably.
bugs.workaround: Reboot the guest. This problem has been observed only on the very first boot after a hard boot of the host.

bugs.title: After full config sync or modifications to SSL profiles, new SSL/TLS handshakes fail for at least 5 seconds
bugs.symptoms: After a device finishes receiving a configuration sync from its peer or after SSL profiles are modified, new connections to virtual servers are unable to complete TLS handshakes for 5 seconds. If a device processes a full (non-incremental) sync from the peer device, all SSL profiles are affected. If only a few SSL profiles are modified, then only virtual servers that reference those SSL profiles are affected. The BIG-IP system logs this message: warning tmm[12345]: 01260009:4: Connection error: hud_ssl_handler:910: invalid profile (40)
bugs.conditions: -- High Availability (HA) configured with two or more devices. -- One or more Client SSL profiles are modified, and these profiles are in use by a virtual server. Note: Client SSL profiles are modified when an associated object (e.g., a certificate, a key, etc.) is updated. -- A full config sync is triggered. -- Running BIG-IP v13.x. This has not been found to impact any other software versions.
bugs.impact: After the TCP handshake completes, the BIG-IP system responds to the client with a TCP FIN. As a result, new TLS connections to affected virtual servers fail for approximately 5 seconds before recovering without intervention, until the next configuration change occurs and causes TMM to start up another 5-second timer.
bugs.workaround: In the case where this occurs because you are directly modifying the SSL profile referenced by a virtual server (as opposed to it occurring because of a ConfigSync operation), you can avoid directly modifying SSL profile that's actively referenced by the virtual server, replacing the SSL profile used in the virtual server with a new one. 1. Create a new SSL profile that has same configuration as a SSL profile currently in use (i.e., create a copy of the currently used SSL profile). 2. Modify the parameters on the new SSL profile as needed. 3. Assign the new SSL profile to the virtual server, and remove the old one. 4. Once the new SSL profile is successfully attached to the virtual server, you may want to the delete old SSL profile.

bugs.title: TMM may crash will processing PEM traffic
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, TMM my crash while processing PEM traffic with the Openvpn classifier.
bugs.conditions: Virtual Server with classification profile attached. When classification / cec engine is used with Openvpn classifier enabled.
bugs.impact: TMM may crash leading to a failover event.
bugs.workaround: Yes, disable openvpn classifier from sys db using the following command (tmsh)$ modify sys db tmm.cec.classifier.openvpn.enable value false
bugs.fix: TMM now processes PEM traffic as expected.

bugs.title: Bcm56xxd MIIM bus access failure
bugs.symptoms: Bcm56xxd daemon running on certain BIG-IP devices might experience MIIM bus access failure. The system posts a message similar to the following in the ltm log: info bcm56xxd: 012c0016:6: MiimTimeOut:soc_miim_write, timeout (id=0xc9 addr=0x1f data=0x0000)
bugs.conditions: Using one of the following platforms: + VIPRION B2250 Blade (A112) + VIPRION B2150 Blade (A113) + VIPRION B4300 Blade (A108) + BIG-IP 5250v + BIG-IP 7200S + BIG-IP 12250 + BIG-IP i5600 + BIG-IP i5820 + BIG-IP i7800 + BIG-IP i10800
bugs.impact: The affected BIG-IP system fails to pass traffic. If configured for high availability (HA) and the HA connection has not been disrupted, failover occurs.
bugs.workaround: Reboot the affected BIG-IP platform / VIPRION blade.

bugs.title: Datasafe RTE causing login form to not be updated on subsequent login attempts
bugs.symptoms: After a failed login attempt to an app using a web form, subsequent log in attempts fail.
bugs.conditions: This can occur when Datasafe is in use.
bugs.impact: Datasafe end users are unable to log in after an initial failed login attempt.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with end users being unable to log in to a web application after a failed login attempt.

bugs.title: During brute force attack, the attempted passwords may be logged
bugs.symptoms: Request data potentially included passwords is not masked in the ASM local and remote logger.
bugs.conditions: A brute force attack is in progress and login traffic is blocked from the suspicious IPs.
bugs.impact: An exposure of potentially sensitive data to the BIG-IP logger.
bugs.fix: Potentially sensitive data from brute force blocked requests is no longer logged.

bugs.title: The BIG-IP may use the traffic-group MAC address rather than a per-VLAN MAC address
bugs.symptoms: tmm may use a combination of the traffic-group MAC address and the per-VLAN MAC address for traffic associated with the traffic-group.
bugs.conditions: All of the following: -- The traffic-group has a MAC address set. -- The sys db variable 'tm.macmasqaddr_per_vlan' is set to true. -- There are multiple tmm processes running on the BIG-IP system. Note: BIG-IP Virtual Edition is not affected since there is only one tmm process.
bugs.impact: Incorrect MAC address used for traffic associated with the traffic-group.
bugs.fix: tmm uses the proper MAC address when there is a traffic-group mac address defined and 'tm.macmasqaddr_per_vlan' is set to true.

bugs.title: Data in the 'Last 4 hours' view have a 1-hour delay
bugs.symptoms: AVR aggregates data hourly, so data reported in the 'Last 4 hours' view are shown with a 1-hour delay.
bugs.conditions: Viewing data in the 'Last 4 hours' view.
bugs.impact: Some data in the 'Last 4 hours' view is reported after a 1-hour delay.

bugs.title: Autodosd history files not loaded correctly after software upgrade
bugs.symptoms: DoS statistics do not reflect historic detection thresholds.
bugs.conditions: -- Enable autodosd. -- Upgrade the system.
bugs.impact: Incorrect DoS detection thresholds.
bugs.fix: The system now correctly loads autodosd history files after a software upgrade.

bugs.title: DoSL7 site_severity always equals "1" in remote log
bugs.symptoms: Log always shows site_severity as '1'.
bugs.conditions: - Enable DoSL7. - Configure remote logger. - Send traffic.
bugs.impact: Logged DoSL7 attack severity shows as '1'.

bugs.title: "PEM::session info" does not set IMSI, IMEISV of a subscriber
bugs.symptoms: Cannot set imsi, imeisv for subscriber using irule PEM::session info <ip addr> <imsi | imeisv > <value> to values greater than 2,147,483,647.
bugs.conditions: Trying to set IMSI and IMEISV attributes of a subscriber to values greater than 2,147,483,647 (INT32 max value) using PEM::session info iRule returns an error.
bugs.impact: Cannot set IMSI, IMEISV using PEM:session info attributes with values greater than 2,147,483,647.
bugs.workaround: If IMSI, IMEISV attributes need to be set to values greater than 2,147,483,647 then force the TCL to interpret them as strings by using the iRule as PEM::session info <ip addr> <imsi | imeisv> [format %d <value>]

bugs.title: stpd memory leak on secondary blades in a multi-blade system
bugs.symptoms: On secondary blades in a multi-blade system, stpd shows continued increased memory usage.
bugs.conditions: A non passthru STP mode (STP, RSTP or MSTP) is enabled on the system.
bugs.impact: System performance is degraded due to needless memory usage by stpd.
bugs.fix: Stpd no longer leaks memory.

bugs.title: MRF SIP filter queue sizes not configurable
bugs.symptoms: The ingress and egress queues of the MRF SIP filter have fixed sizes that cannot be configured.
bugs.conditions: If the hard-coded queue size of 512 messages or 65535 bytes are exceeded, the filter enables its flow control logic.
bugs.impact: Messages may be dropped.
bugs.fix: The max-pending-messages and max-pending-bytes values in the SIP router profile will be used as the limits for the SIP filter's queues. If the configured value is less than the existing hard-coded limits (512 bytes or 65535 bytes), the hard-coded limits will be used.

bugs.title: AVR report limits are locked at 1000 transactions
bugs.symptoms: AVR reports are limited to 1000 transactions. This is due to a hard-coded limit.
bugs.conditions: Using AVR reports for more than 1000 transactions.
bugs.impact: Unable to create reports with more than 1000 rows.
bugs.fix: A db variable avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit has been added, that can be controlled via TMSH. The variable controls the number of rows in report within the range of 1 to 100000. For example, for a report with 10000 rows, modify the 'avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit' variable using the following command: tmsh modify sys db avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit value 10000
bugs.behavior: There is a new db variable avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit available in TMSH, which controls the number of rows in an AVR report. Valid values are from 1 to 100000. For example, to create a report with 10000 rows, modify the 'avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit' variable using the following command: tmsh modify sys db avr.stats.reportrownumberlimit value 10000

bugs.title: Changing ASM policy on security tab results in a GUI error
bugs.symptoms: Occasionally, when trying to change the ASM security policy from the Security tab of a virtual server, you might see the following error message: An error has occurred while trying to process your request.
bugs.conditions: This is an intermittent issue that is not always reproducible.
bugs.impact: The impact is low: Even though the error is displayed the Policy is saved.
bugs.workaround: The Policy is saved, so this is a cosmetic issue only. You can refresh the page to remove the message.

bugs.title: Read Access Denied: user (gu, guest) type (Certificate Order Manager)
bugs.symptoms: GUI guest user is supposed to see Key properties (which includes cert order manager association details) and Certificate Order Manager object itself, but reports an error: -- General database error retrieving information. -- err mcpd[6586]: 01070823:3: Read Access Denied: user (gu) type (Certificate Order Manager)
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE). -- Guest user attempts to view Key properties (including cert order manager association details) and Certificate Order Manager object information.
bugs.impact: Certificate Manager role does not allow users to create certificates. They can upload and delete certificates, but when trying to create one, the GUI stays blank and the logs show a Read Access Denied error.

bugs.title: Challenge loop when Single Page Application is enabled
bugs.symptoms: Challenge loop might occur when sending POST to Single Page Application (SPA) is enabled.
bugs.conditions: -- SPA is enabled. -- POST request is sent. -- PBD/Captcha/Challenge is enabled.
bugs.impact: The ASM end user connection goes into a challenge/captcha loop.
bugs.fix: The system now handles this condition so there is no challenge/captcha loop.

bugs.title: Disassociating SP connector from SSO config (IdP) that is assigned to a SAML resource is allowed but should not
bugs.symptoms: No errors occur when disassociating the SP connector from SSO config (IdP) that is assigned to a SAML resource.
bugs.conditions: Disassociating the SP connector from the SSO config (IdP) that is assigned to a SAML resource.
bugs.impact: SP connector can be disassociated from a configuration with no error messages. This might lead to a non-working configuration.
bugs.fix: Disassociating the SP connector from SSO config (IdP) that is assigned to a SAML resource is no longer allowed, and error message is given.

bugs.title: While using explicit or transparent http type service on SSL Orchestrator, TMM cores.
bugs.symptoms: TMM can core while using http type service (explicit or transparent ) on SSL Orchestrator.
bugs.conditions: SSL Orchestrator configured while using explicit or transparent http type service.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while TMM restarts.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer cores using explicit or transparent http type service on SSL Orchestrator.

bugs.title: TMM core during display of PEM session under some specific conditions
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes during display of PEM session if the session has multiple IP addresses added under certain conditions.
bugs.conditions: -- Session has multiple IP addresses added. -- When the session was created, addition of multiple IP addresses was not allowed.
bugs.impact: TMM restart. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Do not change the value of sys db variable tmm.pem.session.ip.addr.max while some sessions are already created.
bugs.fix: TMM core during display of PEM session no longer occurs.

bugs.title: Instances shows incorrect pools if the same members are used in other pools
bugs.symptoms: Monitor 'Instances' tab shows incorrect pools if the same members are used in other pools.
bugs.conditions: Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create custom monitor or use system default. 2. Assign that monitor to a test pool. 3. Navigate to Local Traffic :: Monitors, click the test monitor, then select the Instances tab.
bugs.impact: The test pool is displayed, as well any other pools that use the same member or members (but with other monitors assigned).
bugs.workaround: Use tmsh to list monitor instances For example: tmsh show ltm monitor gateway-icmp /Common/gateway_icmp

bugs.title: The same dynamic flow can not be added to different URLs
bugs.symptoms: When you try to add a dynamic flow that already exists for a different URL, the system reports an error message: This dynamic flow already exists in policy.
bugs.conditions: 1) Create default policy with /aaa and /bbb URLs. 2) Add dynamic flow with "RegExp Value"="a" to /aaa URL. 3) Try to add the same dynamic flow to /bbb URL.
bugs.impact: You are unable to add the dynamic flow to /bbb URL.
bugs.workaround: You can add the dynamic flow using the REST API.
bugs.fix: The dynamic flow, which already exists for a different URL can now be added to a second URL using the GUI

bugs.title: Enhance oauth client failure error log message id:01490290.
bugs.symptoms: The log message for id:01490290 does not include JSON Web Token (JWT) information.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when none of the configured JWK keys match the received JWT token.
bugs.impact: Without JWT information in the log message, it is very difficult to debug which token caused the error.
bugs.fix: Added JWT Header in the error log message indicating which token caused the error.

bugs.title: MacOS Edge Client installer does not follow best security practices
bugs.symptoms: The MacOS Edge Client installer does not follow current best security practices.
bugs.conditions: MacOS Edge Client installer executed by a malicious user without high privileges.
bugs.impact: Installation log file contents are not protected as expected.
bugs.workaround: Delete the installation log file.
bugs.fix: The issue is fixed by removing any existing installation log file before modification.

bugs.title: Access session data cache might leak if there are multiple TMMs
bugs.symptoms: Due to asynchronicity in the TMM subsystem, it is possible that the session data cache might be created after the session is terminated. As a result, that session data cache never gets released.
bugs.conditions: -- Transparent SWG. -- The BIG-IP system has more than one TMM.
bugs.impact: TMM memory might be exhausted eventually.

bugs.title: Apply Policy fails due to policy corruption from previously enforced signature
bugs.symptoms: Apply Policy fails due to policy corruption in PLC database from a previously enforced signature.
bugs.conditions: 1. Export a policy containing a signature with an enforced rule. 2. Update ASM Signatures (ASU). 3. Import that previously exported policy. 4. Apply the newly imported policy.
bugs.impact: Apply policy fails.
bugs.workaround: As a workaround, run the following SQL, and then apply the policy: ---------------------------------------------------------------------- UPDATE PLC.PL_POLICY_NEGSIG_SIGNATURES SET previous_enforced_rule_md5 = '' WHERE previous_enforced_rule = '' and previous_enforced_rule_md5 != '' ----------------------------------------------------------------------

bugs.title: FIX protocol messages parsed incorrectly when fragmented between the body and the trailer.
bugs.symptoms: FIX message has successfully parsed header part (iRule event FIX_HEADER triggered), but is eventually discarded as incomplete (no iRule event FIX_MESSAGE).
bugs.conditions: FIX message fragmented between body part and the trailer (tag 10).
bugs.impact: FIX protocol messages are not forwarded.
bugs.workaround: Assure FIX protocol packet size does not exceed MTU value.
bugs.fix: Message parsing improved to correctly handle fragmented packets.

bugs.title: Records for an external data-group can be incorrectly managed
bugs.symptoms: The system does not use data-group records added directly to external data-groups, although you can use tmsh and iControl to directly modify external data-group.
bugs.conditions: -- There is an external data-group configured and the name of that external data-group as an internal data-group when adding records to the data-group. -- Using tmsh or iControl.
bugs.impact: This results in data-group records that exist but which the configuration does not use.
bugs.workaround: Do not use the 'ltm data-group internal' configuration path to add records to an external data-group. Manage records in an external data-group via the external data-group's file.
bugs.fix: The system now disallows internal data-group commands on external data-group types.

bugs.title: HTTP_REQUEST iRule event triggered for internal APM request
bugs.symptoms: Requests for the internal APM renderer for logo customization trigger the HTTP_REQUEST iRule event.
bugs.conditions: Customized logo in Access Profile
bugs.impact: HTTP_REQUEST event will be raised for requests for the customized logo in the Access Profile.
bugs.workaround: Inside the HTTP_REQUEST event, if it is necessary to not take a certain action on a customized logo, it is possible to check that the URL does not equal the URL for the logo (it should start with '/public/images/customization/' and contain the image name).

bugs.title: HTTP2 monitors can be created
bugs.symptoms: The HTTP2 protocol is not supported as a built-in monitor type.
bugs.conditions: A pool of HTTP2 servers needs to be monitored.
bugs.impact: HTTP2 servers cannot be monitored.
bugs.workaround: It may be possible to create an external monitor. SSL or TCP monitors may approximate the wanted functionality.
bugs.fix: It is now possible to create built in monitors that inspect HTTP2 traffic.

bugs.title: Unable to attach default SSL and FTP profiles to virtual server
bugs.symptoms: Configuring a virtual server with default SSL and FTP profiles failed with the following error message 01b40014:3: Virtual server (/Common/testvs) requires clientssl profile (/Common/clientssl) to enable SSL forward proxy when FTP profile (/Common/ftp) is present.
bugs.conditions: -- SSL Forward Proxy is disabled in the client SSL profile, and -- FTPS Mode is set to 'Disallow' in the FTP profile.
bugs.impact: The virtual server cannot be configured successfully.
bugs.fix: Configuring a virtual server with default SSL and FTP profiles now succeeds.

bugs.title: Unable to modify the application language with 'Copy ASM Policy'
bugs.symptoms: When using the 'Copy policy' feature, if you select another application language, it copies the actual policy without taking account of the modification on GUI, and it remains UTF-8 if it originally was UTF-8.
bugs.conditions: 1. Go to Security :: Application Security : Security Policies : Policies List. 2. Select an ASM Policy. 3. Click 'Copy policy'. 4. Modify application language to anything else. 5. Click Save.
bugs.impact: Newly copied policy carries the application language setting that was active before the change, so the copy does not match the original.
bugs.fix: In this release, if the encoding is different from the source policy encoding, copy now handles the operation so that the resulting policy has the correct application language.

bugs.title: HTTP::respond or HTTP::redirect in LB_FAILED may result in TMM crash
bugs.symptoms: When a request is sent to the virtual server which meets the conditions specified, TMM may crash.
bugs.conditions: When all of the following conditions are met: -- Virtual server configured with iRule that contains HTTP::respond or HTTP::redirect in an LB_FAILED event. -- A command in an LB_FAILED event (does not have to be in the same iRule as the previous point, but must be attached to the same virtual server), that parks the iRule (e.g., table, session, persist, after, HSL). -- A CLIENT_CLOSED event is present. -- The pool member fails in some manner, triggering LB_FAILED
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Add reject command to LB_FAILED event to force the serverside of the connection closed before response is sent to the client.

bugs.title: Message about HTTP status code which are set by default disappeared from the UI
bugs.symptoms: When creating a new policy using the policy-creation page, there are status codes (200-399) that are enabled by default. There is no message about HTTP status codes that are set by default does not appear in the GUI.
bugs.conditions: Open Create a New Policy page.
bugs.impact: The message is not shown on Create Policy page
bugs.fix: The message was added and shown always next to Allowed Response Status Codes input.

bugs.title: Upgrade from version 12.1.3.7 to version 14.1.0 failing with error
bugs.symptoms: Upgrade from version 12.1.3.7 to version 14.1.0 fails. Running 'tmsh show sys software' shows the following message: failed (Could not access configuration source; sda,n)
bugs.conditions: 1. Install BIG-IP version 12.1.3.7 in new volume. 2. From 12.1.3.7, try to install 14.1.0 in new volume.
bugs.impact: Upgrade fails.
bugs.workaround: To work around this issue, delete the 14.1.0 volume and try the installation again. The second installation of 14.1.0 succeeds in this scenario.

bugs.title: GUI not available after upgrade
bugs.symptoms: After installing over the top of a previous version, the Management GUI is inaccessible while SSH access works. You may see one or more of the following conditions Shell prompt may show logger[1234]: Re-starting named bigstart restart httpd fails bigstart start httpd fails
bugs.conditions: Installation over a previously used Boot Volume
bugs.impact: Corrupt install
bugs.workaround: Boot back to previous boot volume and then delete the boot volume containing the failed install.

bugs.title: Full Webtop: 'URL Entry' field is available again
bugs.symptoms: 'URL Entry' field is no longer visible from full webtop.
bugs.conditions: Using Portal Access full webtop screen.
bugs.impact: It is not possible to open Portal Access session with arbitrary URL from full webtop screen.
bugs.fix: Now 'URL Entry' field can be enabled and used on full webtop.

bugs.title: Creation of RADIUS authentication fails with service types other than 'authenticate only'
bugs.symptoms: RADIUS authentication can only have an initial service type of 'authenticate only'.
bugs.conditions: This is encountered when configuring RADIUS authentication via the GUI.
bugs.impact: If you change the Service Type to anything except Authenticate Only (default), Authentication creation fails, and the following error appears in /var/log/webui.log: 01020066:3: The requested RADIUS Authentication Configuration (/Common/system-auth) already exists in partition Common.
bugs.workaround: After configuring RADIUS authentication with 'authenticate only' as the service type, go back and change the service type to the desired option.

bugs.title: Tcl errors in iRules 'table' command
bugs.symptoms: The iRules 'table delete' command causes Tcl errors due to improperly handling the return code from SessionDB.
bugs.conditions: -- iRules 'table delete' command is used. -- Does not occur consistently, but is more prone to occur when the system is processing more traffic.
bugs.impact: The 'table delete' command randomly fails and causes disruptions in traffic.
bugs.workaround: Do not use 'table delete' command
bugs.fix: Fixed 'table delete' to properly interpret the return code from SessionDB.

bugs.title: REST error message is logged every five minutes on vCMP Guest
bugs.symptoms: Guestagentd periodically logs the following REST error message for each secondary slot in /var/log/ltm: Rest request failed{"code":502."message":"This is a non-primary slot on the Viprion. Please access this device through the cluster address.","restOperationId":6410038,"kind":":resterrorresponse"}
bugs.conditions: Upgrade a vCMP guest from pre-13.1.x to a 13.1.x or later version.
bugs.impact: There is stale stat information for vCMP guests running on secondary slots.
bugs.workaround: Create a Log Filter with no publisher on the vCMP guest to discard the specific error message: sys log-config filter Filter_RestError { level info message-id 01810007 source guestagentd }

bugs.title: APM current active and established session counts out of sync after failover
bugs.symptoms: The 'tmsh show apm license' command shows that the current established session count is much larger than the current active session count. In the extreme case, current established session count can reach the maximum allowed, and the system reports the ERR_TOOBIG error in the apm log. err tmm3[12351]: 01490581:3: (null):Common:00000000: Access stats encountered error: SessionDB operation failed (key: tmm.license.global_estab_stats.f26de3c7, ret: ERR_TOOBIG).
bugs.conditions: This counter out-of-sync period happens right after failover and lasts for five minutes.
bugs.impact: There is no impact to user sessions. Only the connection counts are impacted.

bugs.title: Logon failure with Session Expired/Timeout
bugs.symptoms: When 'Session Expired/Timeout' window popup is produced on the Logon Page via the Edge Client for macOS and then 'Start new session' link is clicked, this results in BIG-IP APM server categorizing uimode as Full Browser (0) for the new session. If your Access Policy logic has a uimode check where Full Browser mode results in no Network Access resource, logon failure can occur.
bugs.conditions: -- Logon form configured with additional fields other than username, password, and soft token fields. -- Session times out when user is in logon page.
bugs.impact: Access Policy branch logic decision-making based on uimode. On macOS, Edge Client is detected as Full Browser (uimode 0) by APM. If your Access Policy logic has a uimode check where Full Browser mode results in no Network Access resource, logon failure can occur.
bugs.fix: On macOS, Edge Client is no longer detected as Full Browser (uimode 0) by APM.

bugs.title: LDAP remote authentication with remote roles and user-template failing
bugs.symptoms: The directory server that performs authentication requests refuses a query for authorization (user attributes), which prevents the BIG-IP user from logging on with remote authentication. BAD_NAME errors are usually present in LDAP communication.
bugs.conditions: -- Configure LDAP remote authentication with remote roles and a user template. -- As a remote user, attempt to logon.
bugs.impact: The query request sent to the directory server is refused because the password is not included in the request, and the server does not accept an anonymous bind request. The refused request prevents a lookup of the user account attributes on the directory server. As a result, the BIG-IP user cannot logon.
bugs.workaround: Remove user-template. bind-dn must be used to authenticate against LDAP server.

bugs.title: Remove Event Listener support of edge case
bugs.symptoms: In cases where the protected input field is not located under the form tag, the Remove Event Listener removes the malicious event listeners of the input field, but the field itself is missing in the traffic (that is being sent on submit).
bugs.conditions: Protected inputs located outside of the form tag. For example: <form> ... </form> <input name="username">
bugs.impact: In an edge-case situation, the entered values are not sent when submitting the form.
bugs.fix: Remove Event Listener feature now supports cases where an input field is not inside the form.

bugs.title: Unescaped slash in RE2 in user-defined signature should not be allowed
bugs.symptoms: An unescaped slash in RE2 keyword in a user-defined signature caused a REST PATCH to the signature to have no effect.
bugs.conditions: A user-defined signature has an unescaped slash in RE2 keyword.
bugs.impact: REST PATCH to update the user-defined signature has no effect.
bugs.workaround: The slash in the signature keyword must be escaped by backslash.

bugs.title: DNS GUI does not follow best practices
bugs.symptoms: The DNS WebUI does not follow best security practices.
bugs.conditions: DNS services provisioned, enabled, and configured
bugs.impact: The DNS WebUI does not follow best security practices.
bugs.fix: The DNS WebUI now follows best security practices.

bugs.title: Abnormally terminated connections on server side may cause client side streams to stall
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system provides HTTP/2 Gateway configuration when an HTTP/2 client is served by HTTP/1.x pool members. When a server-side connection terminates abnormally, TMM may crash.
bugs.conditions: -- A virtual server with HTTP/2 Gateway configuration is configured on the BIG-IP system. -- Traffic on the server side has some abnormalities, resulting in aborted or unclosed connections.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: Fixed a tmm crash when a virtual server is configured as a HTTP/2 gateway.

bugs.title: TMM can crash when handling MRF SIP traffic.
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes with a SIGSEGV signal and produces a core file.
bugs.conditions: This issue is known to occur when a BIG-IP system is configured with a MRF SIP virtual server that makes use of a complex iRule to manipulate traffic.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while TMM restarts.
bugs.fix: Changes to TMM in regards to how entries progress through the SIP state machine have resolved the crash condition.

bugs.title: OSPF ASE route calculation for new external-LSA delayed
bugs.symptoms: External link-state advertisement (LSA) update does not trigger OSPF ASE route calculation, resulting in delay for route state changes from external LSA.
bugs.conditions: -- OSPF enabled. -- More than 20 updated external LSA. -- No updated router and network LSA.
bugs.impact: Delay of route update from external LSA.
bugs.workaround: Manually clear ip ospf process.
bugs.fix: OSPF ASE route calculation from external LSA are happening as normal.

bugs.title: Control and Analysis Plane CPU usage statistics are inaccurate for single core vCMP guests
bugs.symptoms: CPU usage statistics reported for Control and Analysis planes are not described properly for single-core vCMP guests.
bugs.conditions: A vCMP guest with a single core.
bugs.impact: CPU usage statistics report 0 Control Plane cores and 1 Analysis Plane core.
bugs.workaround: On a single core, two hyperthread vCMP guest, one hyperthread/CPU is dedicated to Data Plane while the other is dedicated to Control and Analysis Plane. All statistics attributed to the Analysis Plane in this CPU configuration are in fact the aggregate of Control Plane and Analysis Plane.

bugs.title: No TTL options (set, proxy, preserve, decrement) on IPOTHER profile
bugs.symptoms: Unable to control TLL/IPV6 HL value when ipother profile is used.
bugs.conditions: -- ipother profile is used in the virtual server.
bugs.impact: No option to control TTL value when ipother is used.
bugs.fix: You can now configure TTL Options (set, preserve, proxy, decrement) on the ipother profile. This is available on both IPV4 and IPV6. Specifies the outgoing packet's IP Header TTL mode. The default is Decrement. The available settings are: -- Proxy: Sets the outgoing IP Header TTL value to 255/64 for IPv4/IPv6 respectively. -- Preserve: Sets the outgoing IP Header TTL value to be same as the incoming IP Header TTL value. -- Decrement: Sets the outgoing IP Header TTL value to be one less than the incoming TTL value. -- Set: Sets the outgoing IP Header TTL value to a specific value(as specified by ip-ttl-v[4|6]).

bugs.title: New rules cannot be compiled
bugs.symptoms: When the number of firewall policy rules compiles to a blob sized over 2 GB, the blob size limit is exceeded and no new rules can be compiled. All traffic stops.
bugs.conditions: When compiled rules configured size exceeds 2 GB after a new rule is added.
bugs.impact: New rules cannot be compiled. Traffic stops.
bugs.workaround: Remove rules until the rules compile successfully.

bugs.title: Zones reload when Update button is clicked without any change
bugs.symptoms: When performing zone configuration, if you click the Update button before making changes, the zone still reloads.
bugs.conditions: -- No change is made. -- Update button is clicked.
bugs.impact: Unnecessary zone reload.

bugs.title: Unable to view iApp component view
bugs.symptoms: When accessing the iApp Components tab, the system presents an error similar to the following: An error has occurred while trying to process your request.
bugs.conditions: -- Upgrade to v14.1.x. -- Create a new iApp with an SSL, ASM, or Traffic policy profile. -- Or, attempt to view an iApp containing ASM information
bugs.impact: Unable to access the iApp Component view. Cannot reconfigure the iApp directly (iApp : Application Services : application : any app).
bugs.workaround: To reconfigure the iApp, do the following: 1. Navigate to the following location in the GUI: Local Traffic :: Virtual Server List. 2. Click the Application Link :: Reconfigure. Note: Although this allows you to reconfigure an iApp, it does not provide access to the iApp application details Components page.

bugs.title: Datasafe encrypts stored substitute value for xhr request and not the real value
bugs.symptoms: FPS end Users report they are unable to log in to an application.
bugs.conditions: -- Datasafe enabled. -- A parameter is set to be encrypted in the settings. -- The page contains a custom encryption function which manipulates the value before sending it.
bugs.impact: Client logins fail.
bugs.workaround: Disable Substitute value.
bugs.fix: Added the ability to encrypt [CUSTOM_FUNC](real field), so this issue no longer occurs.

bugs.title: False positive 'Null in request' violation or bare byte subviolations
bugs.symptoms: 'Null in request' violation or bare byte subviolations detected when there is no null in request.
bugs.conditions: Brute force attack mitigated by captcha or challenge.
bugs.impact: Traffic blocking or false positive alarm
bugs.fix: False positive violations no longer happens during brute force attack.

bugs.title: SNMP configuration for trap destinations can cause a warning in the log
bugs.symptoms: The snmpd configuration parameters can cause net-snmp to issue a warning about deprecated syntax.
bugs.conditions: The use of a sys snmp command similar to the following to modify the snmpd.conf file: sys snmp v2-traps { TRAP1 { host 1.2.3.4 community somestring } }
bugs.impact: net-snmp issues a warning that the syntax has been deprecated and reports a warning message in the log.

bugs.title: TMM crash observed while rendering internal pages (like blocked page) for per-request policy
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes.
bugs.conditions: -- SSLO/SWG configured. -- Rendering internal pages (like a blocked page). -- Per-request policy.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer cores while rendering internal pages (like blocked page) for per-request policy.

bugs.title: WebSSO logs record the master key when in DEBUG mode
bugs.symptoms: Debug websso logs record the master key in clear text in /var/log/apm.
bugs.conditions: SSO debug log is enabled.
bugs.impact: MASTER key is exposed in /var/log/apm when SSO debug log is enabled.
bugs.fix: Removed debug log message on MCP Process notification which caused spilling the master key in websso and apm_websso modules.

bugs.title: Engineering Hotfixes might not contain all required packages
bugs.symptoms: An Engineering Hotfix might be missing certain required packages.
bugs.conditions: This can occur with certain Engineering Hotfixes.
bugs.impact: Some of the required packages may be missing.
bugs.fix: Engineering Hotfix ISOs now automatically include packages for targets that may be affected by code change in a specific target.

bugs.title: Empty audience claim added to JWT access token generated by OAuth bearer SSO
bugs.symptoms: Even though there is no audience value configured in OAuth Bearer SSO configuration, SSO generates a JSON Web Token (JWT) access token with 'aud' claim with empty value. In this case, when another APM runs as the OAuth Resource Server (JWT config audience also set to none) JWT token validation fails with error 'Audience not found'.
bugs.conditions: No audience value configured in OAuth Bearer SSO configuration.
bugs.impact: JWT access token is generated by SSO has 'aud' claim with empty value, which results in token validation failure.
bugs.fix: JWT access token generated by SSO would not include 'aud' claim when there is no audience value configured in OAuth Bearer SSO configuration.

bugs.title: Distinct vCMP guests are able to cluster with each other.
bugs.symptoms: -- Distinct vCMP guests are able to cluster with each other. -- Guests end up having duplicate rebroad_mac on one or more slots. This can be checked using below command: clsh tmctl -d blade tmm/vcmp -w 200 -s vcmp_name,tmid,rebroad_mac Check the 'rebroad_mac' field for duplicate mac addresses. vcmp_name tmid rebroad_mac --------- ---- ----------------- default 0 02:01:23:45:01:00 vcmp1 0 00:00:00:00:00:00 vcmp5 0 02:01:23:45:01:04 vcmp6 0 00:00:00:00:00:00 vcmp7 0 02:01:23:45:01:06 vcmp8 0 00:00:00:00:00:00 vcmp9 0 02:01:23:45:01:08 vcmp10 0 02:01:23:45:01:0A <-------------- vcmp11 0 02:01:23:45:01:0A <--------------
bugs.conditions: -- It is not yet clear under what circumstances the issue occurs. -- One of the ways this issue occurs is when guests are moved between blades and they end up having a non-null and duplicate 'rebroad_mac' on one or more slots.
bugs.impact: Only the vCMP guest acting as primary will be operative.
bugs.workaround: -- Disable clusterd from sending packets over tmm_bp by turning off the db variable clusterd.communicateovertmmbp: modify sys db clusterd.communicateovertmmbp value false. To disable the db variable on the affected guest use the following procedure: 1. stop sys service clusterd 2. modify sys db clusterd.communicateovertmmbp value false 3. start sys service clusterd 4. save sys conf Afterwards, the affected guest may still have the wrong management IP address. To resolve that, log into the vCMP Hypervisor and force a management IP update such as changing the netmask.
bugs.fix: The vCMP guests no longer end up having a non-null and duplicate 'rebroad_mac' on one or more slots. Distinct vCMP guests are no longer able to cluster with each other.

bugs.title: Geolocation information inconsistently formatted
bugs.symptoms: The ${geo} pattern in the Logging Profile has only GeoIP data; however, in alerts that are sent to either the alert server or to BIG-IQ, the GEO data includes both GeoIP and GeoLocation information.
bugs.conditions: Configure ${geo} pattern in Logging Profile template and trigger a logging event.
bugs.impact: GeoLocation data is missing in logs written by Logging Profile when using ${geo} pattern.
bugs.fix: The ${geo} pattern in Logging Profile template now provides full GEO informaion, both GeoIP and GeoLocation, in the same format as in alerts.

bugs.title: 'License verification failed' errors occur when changing license
bugs.symptoms: The /var/log/ltm contains license processing errors upon license validation failure whenever a significant license event happens (such as a license change). However the system 'corrects' itself if a valid license exists, so no further log messages will be produced.
bugs.conditions: Whenever a significant license event happens, the internal state wipes the previous license representation, which causes some modules to report the license has failed verification.
bugs.impact: When a license change occurs, the system logs messages similar to the following: -- err mcpd[11745]: 01180010:3: [license processing][error]: license verification failed. -- err mcpd[11745]: 01180010:3: [license processing][error]: invalid input for license parsing. If you have a valid license, there is no functional impact to the product, and you can safely ignore these messages.
bugs.fix: The license verification log message requires no intervention and should be taken only as a serious issue if you have a valid license and the device never goes active, with this error message going into the logs repeatedly.

bugs.title: Cannot select individual reporting fields for destination Splunk
bugs.symptoms: Cannot select individual reporting fields(flow or session granularity) for reporting destination Splunk.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when individual reporting fields are selected for reporting destination Splunk.
bugs.impact: The report has all the fields as opposed to just the selected ones.

bugs.title: cwnd warning message in log
bugs.symptoms: The following benign message appears in the log: cwnd too low.
bugs.conditions: The TCP congestion window has dropped below one Maximum Segment Size, which should not happen.
bugs.impact: None. TCP resets the congestion window to 1 MSS.
bugs.workaround: This message does not indicate a functional issue, so you can safely ignore this message. There is no action to take, but the presence of the message can be useful information for debugging other TCP problems.

bugs.title: Incorrect source MAC used when the BIG-IP in L2 transparent mode generates a TCP RST packet.
bugs.symptoms: Packet with unexpected source MAC seen on the adjacent node to the BIG-IP.
bugs.conditions: - BIG-IP configured in an L2 transparent mode using virtual wires - Traffic forwarded between client and server in an asymmetric manner across virtual wires.
bugs.impact: Possible impacts to services on nodes adjacent to the BIG-IP if policy decisions on those nodes are made with the source MAC of the received packet as input.

bugs.title: Portal Access: URL with double dots at the end of the path is handled incorrectly
bugs.symptoms: Portal Access incorrectly handles HTTP request with double dots (..) at the end of the URL path.
bugs.conditions: HTTP request with double dots at the end of the path, for example: GET /some/path/.. HTTP/1.1 Host: 192.168.0.1
bugs.impact: HTTP response with the code of '404 Not Found'.
bugs.workaround: Use iRule to add slash to the end of the path: GET /some/path/../ HTTP/1.1

bugs.title: Duplicate error messages in log when updating a zone through ZoneRunner GUI
bugs.symptoms: Duplicate error messages in log when updating a zone through ZoneRunner GUI.
bugs.conditions: This occurs upon every update to a zone in the GUI.
bugs.impact: The BIG-IP system logs the multiple occurrences of the following error in the /var/log/daemon.log file: err named[17053]: 18-Feb-2019 15:22:51.011 general: error: zone siterequest.com/IN/external: zone serial (2019021807) unchanged. zone may fail to transfer to slaves.

bugs.title: [APM] Memory leak when PingAccess encounters error after sending traffic data to PingAccess SDK
bugs.symptoms: -- Increased overall TMM memory usage, which eventually forces TMM to start closing connections to reduce memory usage. -- connflow memory usage keeps increasing. Memory usage can be observed with this command: # tmctl -f /var/tmstat/blade/tmm0 memory_usage_stat -w200
bugs.conditions: 1. Using PingAccess. 2. Errors are being logged in /var/log/paa.
bugs.impact: -- Memory leak. -- Eventually TMM starts closing connections randomly.
bugs.fix: When PingAccess encounters an error after sending traffic data to PingAccess SDK, TMM no longer leaks memory.

bugs.title: BIG-IP VE Compression Offload HA action requires modification of db variable
bugs.symptoms: When TMM detects a compression offload device hang it does not invoke the configured high availability (HA) action.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when the following conditions exist: -- BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) Cryptographic Offload is licensed. -- BIG-IP VE VM has been assigned QuickAssist Virtual Functions (VFs). -- A QuickAssist endpoint associated with one of the VFs hangs. -- BIG-IP VE executes compression operations.
bugs.impact: The configured HA action does not occur when a compression offload device hangs. Clients compression requests eventually time out.
bugs.workaround: Disable the pfmand by running the following commands: tmsh modify sys db pfmand.healthstatus value disable tmsh save sys config The configured HA action will now occur when a compression offload device hangs. Note: The pfmand daemon is not needed for BIG-IP VE, so disabling the db variable has no impact for BIG-IP VE configurations.

bugs.title: SCP fails unexpected when FIPS mode is enabled
bugs.symptoms: Secure Copy (scp) to some locations fails with the following message: Path not allowed.
bugs.conditions: -- FIPS mode is enabled. -- Copying a file to a restricted location using SCP.
bugs.impact: Cannot use SCP to copy to restricted locations on the BIG-IP system.
bugs.fix: This scp issue no longer occurs when FIPS cards are installed.

bugs.title: Configuring Advanced shell for Resource Administrator User has no effect
bugs.symptoms: Advanced shell is present in the Terminal Access dropdown list when creating a Resource Administrator User, but the functionality is not available.
bugs.conditions: Configuring Advanced shell for Resource Administrator User.
bugs.impact: There is no warning message, but the setting has no effect. Gives the false impression that you can configure a Resource Administrator User to have Advanced shell access when the role does not support it.
bugs.fix: The Advanced shell option is no longer present in the Resource Administrator User Terminal Access dropdown list.
bugs.behavior: Resource Administrator User can no longer select Advanced shell. The option has been removed from the dropdown list in the GUI for the Resource Administrator User.

bugs.title: 'Unsupported SSO Method' error when requests sharing the same TCP session
bugs.symptoms: In API Protection configurations, 'Unsupported SSO Method' error occurs when requests sharing the same TCP session, and some branch selects Single-Sign On (SSO).
bugs.conditions: -- On the virtual server, the OneConnect profile is selected. -- Requests sharing the same TCP session.
bugs.impact: Some requests are rejected.
bugs.workaround: Remove the OneConnect profile from the virtual server.
bugs.fix: Reset the SSO selection for each request, regardless of whether requests share the same TCP connection.

bugs.title: Qkview silently fails to capture qkviews from other blades
bugs.symptoms: When capturing a qkview on a chassis, there are no warnings provided if the qkview utility is run to gather a qkview from other blades.
bugs.conditions: -- On a chassis system, rename/move the qkview binary from a given blade. -- Execute qkview on another blade, verify that no warnings or errors are produced.
bugs.impact: There is no warning that the qkview failed for a given blade.
bugs.workaround: There is no workaround other than running the qkview on the actual blade.

bugs.title: F5 SSL Orchestrator may fail to install an RPM software package on BIG-IP systems running point release versions
bugs.symptoms: User running on BIG-IP point release is not able to upgrade SSL Orchestrator RPM from SSL Orchestrator landing page.
bugs.conditions: This issue occurs when all of the following conditions are met: * User is running on BIG-IP 14.1.0.x point release. * From SSL Orchestrator landing page user click the Upgrade SSL Orchestrator link to install SSL Orchestrator RPM.
bugs.impact: User is not able to upgrade to newer version of SSL Orchestrator RPM
bugs.workaround: a) Log in to the BIG-IP using management IP b) Navigate to iApps > Package Management LX. c) Click Import. d) Click Choose File and select the RPM software package f) Click Upload.

bugs.title: Daily live update (ASU) may skip a day due to cron timing
bugs.symptoms: Daily live updates, such as FPS Engine/Signatures or ASU from versions earlier than 14.1.0, might skip a day due to cron timing.
bugs.conditions: -- Live updates, such as FPS Engine/Signatures or ASU. -- Versions earlier than 14.1.0. -- For FPS live updates, this also occurs on v14.1.0. -- Frequency set to daily update.
