bugs.symptoms: Tmm receives an update from the ePVA for a hardware accelerated connection that is matched to the wrong correction. This can result in a tmm core, which is reported as a segment fault in the tmm log files.
bugs.conditions: A FastL4 virtual server that has hardware acceleration enabled.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Disable hardware acceleration.

bugs.title: BWC::policy detach appears to run, but BWC control is still enabled
bugs.symptoms: The dynamic BWC policy can be attached from iRules but not detached. No error occurs when BWC::policy detach is run, but the detached policy continues to work.
bugs.conditions: -- Dynamic BWC policy for a HTTP request URI during session. -- Running BWC::policy detach.
bugs.impact: The detached policy continues to work.
bugs.fix: Fixed in Jasper

bugs.title: A tunnel can be expired when going offline, causing tmm crash
bugs.symptoms: When the system transitions from active or next active (standby), e.g., to offline, the internal flow of a tunnel can be expired. If the device returns to active or standby, and if the tunnel is modified, a double flow removal can cause a tmm crash.
bugs.conditions: -- System transitions from active or next active. -- Tunnel is modified. -- Device returns to active or next active mode.
bugs.impact: The tmm process restarts. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: The tmm process no longer crashes under these conditions.

bugs.title: TSUI GUI stuck for the same session during long actions
bugs.symptoms: The GUI becomes unresponsive when you perform an operation that takes a long time (e.g., Attack Signatures update).
bugs.conditions: Long-running task is performed, such as export/import/update signatures.
bugs.impact: GUI is unresponsive for that session.
bugs.workaround: If you need to continue working during long task is performed, you can log in via another browser.

bugs.title: ASM Configuration is Lost on License Reactivation &start;
bugs.symptoms: After re-activating a BIG-IP license, if the configuration fails to load and reverts to a base config load, the ASM policy config contains 'default' or 'stub' policies, even after fixing the error that caused the configuration to fail to load.
bugs.conditions: 1) A parsing error exists in the BIG-IP config such that 'tmsh load sys config verify' would fail 2) There is a license reactivation or the configuration is reloaded
bugs.impact: ASM policy configuration is lost and all policies are reverted to empty 'stubs'
bugs.workaround: In the case of license re-activation/before upgrade: Run the command "tmsh load sys config verify" prior to license activation on ASM units to be sure that the config will pass parsing and avoid the fallback to base configuration load. In a case of booting the system into the new version: Option 1: 1. Using the steps in either K4423 or K8465, fix the issue that was preventing the config to load. 2. Reload the config from the fixed UCS file using the command in K13132. Option 2: 1. Roll back to the old version. 2. Fix the issue that was preventing the config to load. 3. Before activating the Boot Location of the new version at System >> Software Management : Boot Locations, make sure to set the option Install Configuration to Yes. see: K64400324 Option 3: If one of the high availability (HA) units successfully upgraded, then use config-sync to push the working config to the failing unit.

bugs.title: Unable to create policy: Inherited values may not be changed.
bugs.symptoms: When you create a new child policy you see the following error in the GUI: Could not update the Policy. Inherited values may not be changed.
bugs.conditions: 1. Parent policy created using the Fundamental Template a. Differentiate between HTTP/WS and HTTPS/WSS URLs is Disabled b. Auto-Added Signature Accuracy set to High. 2. Parent policy contains a custom filter-based signature. 3. Child policy is created from the parent policy assigned.
bugs.impact: You are unable to create a policy via the GUI.
bugs.workaround: Use direct REST API calls or tmsh.
bugs.fix: Create policy will not fail.

bugs.title: Added the ability for the iRule [HTTP::version] command to report HTTP2 and HTTP3 versions
bugs.symptoms: The iRule [HTTP::version] command will incorrectly report "1.1" when HTTP2 traffic is encountered.
bugs.conditions: --Client or server sends HTTP2 request/response. --iRule with [HTTP::version] command is present on the virtual server
bugs.impact: The incorrect version will be reported by the [HTTP::version] iRule command when it sees HTTP2 traffic.
bugs.workaround: --Use the [HTTP2::version] command --Use an if/else to verify that HTTP2 is being used. "if {[HTTP2::version] != 0}"
bugs.fix: The [HTTP::version] iRule command has been updated to return "2.0" or "3.0" if the corresponding HTTP2 or HTTP3 traffic is seen.

bugs.title: Unable to reconnect outgoing SCTP connections that have previously aborted
bugs.symptoms: When an outgoing SCTP connection is created using an ephemeral port, the connection may appear to be open after an SCTP connection halt. This prevents new connections to the same endpoint, as the connection appears to already exist.
bugs.conditions: -- A virtual server configured with an SCTP profile. -- An outgoing SCTP connection after an existing connection to the same endpoint has halted.
bugs.impact: New connections are unable to be created resulting in dropped messages.
bugs.fix: SCTP connections can now be halted and recreated to the same endpoint.

bugs.title: Keys cannot be created on module protected partitions when strict FIPS mode is set
bugs.symptoms: When the Hardware Security Module (HSM) FIPS mode is set to FIPS 140-2 Level 3 protection, new keys cannot be created in the module's protected partition. Note: Although FIPS grade Internal HSM (PCI card) is validated by the Marvell company at FIPS 140-2 Level 3, the BIG-IP system is not 140-2 Level 3 validated.
bugs.conditions: -- FIPS 140-2 Level 3 protection is configured on a NetHSM partition. -- You attempt to create a FIPS key using that partition.
bugs.impact: New Keys cannot be create.
bugs.workaround: Follow these steps to generate a new NetHSM key called 'workaround' and install it into the BIG-IP config: 1. Generate the key: [root@bigip1::Active:Standalone] config # fipskey.nethsm --genkey -o workaround -c module WARNING: fipskey.nethsm will soon be deprecated for use with Thales. Please switch to using tmsh commands instead. tmsh commands... Generate Key: tmsh create sys crypto key <key_name> security-type nethsm [gen-certificate|gen-csr] ... For an exhaustive list of options, please consult F5's tmsh documentation. Generate CSR for existing key: tmsh create sys crypto csr <csr_name> key <key name> ... For an exhaustive list of options, please consult F5's tmsh documentation. Generate Self-Signed Certificate for existing key: tmsh create sys crypto cert <cert_name> key <key name> ... For an exhaustive list of options, please consult F5's tmsh documentation. Delete Key: tmsh delete sys crypto key <keyname> str[cd /shared/tmp && /opt/nfast/bin/generatekey -b pkcs11 certreq=yes selfcert=yes protect=module size=2048 embedsavefile="workaround" plainname="workaround" digest=sha256] key generation parameters: operation Operation to perform generate application Application pkcs11 protect Protected by module verify Verify security of key yes type Key type RSA size Key size 2048 pubexp Public exponent for RSA key (hex) embedsavefile Filename to write key to workaround plainname Key name workaround x509country Country code x509province State or province x509locality City or locality x509org Organisation x509orgunit Organisation unit x509dnscommon Domain name x509email Email address nvram Blob in NVRAM (needs ACS) no digest Digest to sign cert req with sha256 Key successfully generated. Path to key: /opt/nfast/kmdata/local/key_pkcs11_ua882aa9fadee7e440772cb6686358f4b283922622 Starting synchronisation, task ID 5de83486.6e9e32d7f367eaf4 Directory listing failed: No such file or directory 2. Confirm the presence of the key with the label 'workaround': [root@bigip1::Active:Standalone] config # nfkminfo -l Keys with module protection: key_pkcs11_ua882aa9fadee7e440772cb6686358f4b283922622 `workaround' Keys protected by cardsets: ... 3. Install the key: [root@bigip1::Active:Standalone] config # tmsh install sys crypto key workaround from-nethsm 4. Install the public certificate: [root@bigip1::Active:Standalone] config # tmsh install sys crypto cert workaround from-local-file /config/ssl/ssl.crt/workaround

bugs.title: Verified Accept for SSL Orchestrator
bugs.symptoms: You are unable to configure Verified Accept on SSL Orchestrator.
bugs.conditions: -- SSL Orchestrator in use . -- A TCP profile is in use and it contains the Verified Accept flag.
bugs.impact: No connectivity over SSL Orchestrator.
bugs.fix: Fixed a problem with Verified Accept and SSL Orchestrator.

bugs.title: Installation of Browser Challenges fails in 15.1.0
bugs.symptoms: Browser Challenges default installation fails in 15.1.0 after upgrade or resetting back to default. BIG-IP software v15.1.0 ships with a BrowserChallenges_20191121_043810.im file that does not have a proper encryption, and when trying to install the file via the Live Update page the following error occurs: gpg: WARNING: unsafe ownership on homedir `/ts/share/negsig/gpg_asm_sigfile_installer' gpg: encrypted with 1024-bit ELG key, ID 7C3E3CE5, created 2007-03-20 "asm_sigfile_installer" gpg: Signature made Thu 21 Nov 2019 02:38:10 PM IST using RSA key ID BC67BA01 gpg: Can't check signature: No public key
bugs.conditions: Live Update file BrowserChallenges_20191121_043810.im has a different status than 'Currently Installed'.
bugs.impact: If the file 'BrowserChallenges_20191121_043810.im ' is the newest file then upgrade is not applicable.
bugs.fix: Browser Challenges update file can now be installed via Live Update.

bugs.title: Tunnels removed when going offline are not restored when going back online
bugs.symptoms: When a BIG-IP instance goes offline, any functioning tunnel is removed from the active configuration. Upon restoration to online operation, the tunnel is not automatically restored.
bugs.conditions: Configuration including tunnels.
bugs.impact: Failure of tunnel packet traffic.
bugs.workaround: Manually recreate the tunnel after the BIG-IP instance has been brought back online.
bugs.fix: Tunnels removed when going offline are now restored when going back online.

bugs.title: Scriptd coring while running long-running iApp script
bugs.symptoms: When an iApp script should be terminated due to the max-script-run-time, the script still continues and finishes, sometimes with scriptd coring and posting error messages in /var/log/ltm: -- err scriptd[13532]: 014f0004:3: script has exceeded its time to live, terminating the script <------ after 20 secs, it continues even after the scriptd core. -- notice sod[3235]: 01140041:5: Killing /usr/bin/scriptd pid 13532. -- warning sod[3235]: 01140029:4: high availability (HA) daemon_heartbeat scriptd fails action is restart.
bugs.conditions: An iApp runs a script which runs for longer than the configured max-script-run-time.
bugs.impact: Scriptd core.
bugs.workaround: Increasing the sys scriptd max-script-run-time higher then the default of 300 seconds might be helpful if the higher timeout allows the script to complete. For example, if the script is saving a UCS and the save takes 400 seconds, then increasing the max-script-run-time to 430 seconds would allow the script to finish and would work around this issue.

bugs.title: Unable to create 'Login Page' from 'Brute Force Protection'
bugs.symptoms: Not able to Login page from Brute Force Protection.
bugs.conditions: Clicking create after creating a 'Login page' from Security :: Application Security :: Anomaly Detection :: Brute Force Attack Prevention and entering all required values.
bugs.impact: The login page is not created.

bugs.title: Create policy: trusted IP addresses from template are not shown
bugs.symptoms: If there are trusted IP addresses in the selected template, they are not shown in GUI during policy creation
bugs.conditions: Create user-defined template from policy with trusted IP addresses.
bugs.impact: If you manually enter the same IP addresses that were in template, you may get an error message after policy creation
bugs.fix: Trusted IP addresses from template are shown in policy create.

bugs.title: Mirrored connections on standby are never removed in certain configurations
bugs.symptoms: When the conditions are met, if the interface of the connection on the active system changes, the peer does not get notified of this, and that connection persists on the standby system even after the connection on the active system has been destroyed.
bugs.conditions: -- Using mirrored connections in a DSC. -- Not using auto-lasthop with mirrored connections. -- VLAN-keyed connections are enabled.
bugs.impact: Leaking connections on the standby system.
bugs.workaround: You can use either of the following workarounds: -- Use auto-lasthop with mirrored connections. -- Depending on the BIG-IP system's configuration, disabling VLAN-keyed connections may resolve this.

bugs.title: CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID error seen in logs and SSL handshake fails
bugs.symptoms: SSL handshake fails with error in LTM logs.pkcs11d[10407]: err pkcs11d[10407]: 01680048:3: C_Sign: pkcs11_rv=0x00000082, CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID
bugs.conditions: Key created with Safenet NetHSM is used in SSL profile for virtual server. This error is seen randomly.
bugs.impact: SSL handshake fails.
bugs.workaround: Restart the PKCS11D.

bugs.title: TMSH - Modifying sys httpd ssl-verify-client attribute to 'optional-no-ca' results in error
bugs.symptoms: Error is seen when configuring the ssl-verify-client to optional-no-ca via tmsh tmsh modify sys httpd ssl-verify-client optional-no-ca 01070920:3: Application error for confpp: AH00526: Syntax error on line 166 of /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf: SSLVerifyClient: Invalid argument 'optional-no-ca'
bugs.conditions: Seen when configuring ssl-verify-client to optional-no-ca in httpd profile
bugs.impact: Unable to configure ssl-verify-client to optional-no-ca - impacts authentication
bugs.fix: You can now successfully execute tmsh modify sys httpd ssl-verify-client optional-no-ca

bugs.title: SIP message routing remembers a 'no connection' failure state forever
bugs.symptoms: When SIP message routing fails to route to a pool member (Triggering a MR_FAILED, MR::message status of 'no connection'), The BIG-IP system caches the failed state and continues to return this even after the pool member becomes reachable again.
bugs.conditions: When BIG-IP systen fails to route messages to the peer (server) due to unavailability of route or any other issues.
bugs.impact: The BIG-IP system is never be able to establish connection to the peer.
bugs.fix: SIP message routing now recovers from a 'no connection' failure state.

bugs.title: Syslog-ng / systemd-journald cannot handle logs with embedded newlines, write trailing content to /var/log/user.log
bugs.symptoms: Systemd-journald cannot handle logs with embedded newlines, write trailing content to /var/log/user.log. Bare ')' being logged to /var/log/user.log., for example: cat /var/log/user.log [...]: Deleting file /shared/core/*.core.* [...]: Deleting file /shared/core/*.core.* [...] ) [...] )
bugs.conditions: This occurs when the system logs syslog messages containing embedded newlines, such as - The cron process tries and fails to send an email because of output from a cron script. - Modifying the syslog 'include' configuration - Applying ASM policy configuration change - GTM.debugprobelogging output from big3d - iqsyncer mcpd message debug output (log.gtm.level=debug)
bugs.impact: The logging subsystem accepts syslog messages with embedded newlines, and writes first line to the appropriate file, and remaining lines to /var/log/user.log.
bugs.workaround: View the logs using journalctl

bugs.title: Add support for Auto MAC configuration (ixlv)
bugs.symptoms: Mac addresses are forced to be the same for ixlv trunks.
bugs.conditions: This happens when ixlv trunks are used.
bugs.impact: Mac addresses may not be as depicted on the device.
bugs.fix: Unicast mac filters are used for ixlv trunks.

bugs.title: Improve fast failover of PIM-DM-based multicast traffic when BIG-IP is deployed as an Active/Standby HA pair.
bugs.symptoms: Although the effect differs for different topologies, in general, the multicast traffic is interrupted for 5-to-180 seconds after failover.
bugs.conditions: Fast failover of PIM-DM-based multicast traffic when the BIG-IP system is deployed as an Active/Standby high availability (HA) configuration.
bugs.impact: The multicast traffic is interrupted for 5-to-180 seconds after a failover event.
bugs.workaround: None. This is an improvement request.

bugs.title: TMM crash due to failed assertion 'valid node'
bugs.symptoms: Under undetermined load pattern TMM may crash with message: Assertion 'valid node' fail.
bugs.conditions: This can occur while passing traffic with the Ram Cache profile enabled on a Virtual Server. Other conditions are unknown.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Refrain from using ramcache may mitigate the problem.
bugs.fix: Ramcache module stops handling messages after it is teared down, so it does not attempt to use data structures which have already been deinitialized.

bugs.title: PEM: tmm could core when running iRules on overloaded systems
bugs.symptoms: When sessions usage iRules are called on an already overloaded system it might crash.
bugs.conditions: Session iRule calls on heavily overloaded BIG-IP systems.
bugs.impact: Tmm restarts. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Reduce the load on tmm or modify the optimize the irule.

bugs.title: Adding multicast stats for multicast bridging over L2 wire transparent VLAN-group (LACP STP LLDP)
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system can now be configured to collect multicast statistics for LACP, STP, and LLDP. It is controlled by a sys db variable: l2.virtualwire.multicast.stats It is enabled by default.
bugs.conditions: This is encountered when L2 wire transparent VLAN groups are configured.
bugs.impact: The ability to collect and read multicast statistics makes it easier to debug l2 wire setups. Multicast statistics can be viewed in the following tmctl table: tmctl -w250 tmm/l2_mcast_stat
bugs.fix: Added new stats available like: tmctl -w250 tmm/l2_mcast_stat

bugs.title: When L7 performance FPGA is loaded, "tmsh show sys fpga" shows standard-balanced-fpga.
bugs.symptoms: When L7 performance FPGA is loaded, "tmsh show sys fpga" shows standard-balanced-fpga. "tmsh list sys fpga" will list the expected type "l7-performance-fpga".
bugs.conditions: -- iSeries i5000/i7000/i10000/i11000/i15000 platform -- Pay as you grow (PAYG) license applied -- L7 performance FPGA is loaded
bugs.impact: "tmsh show sys fpga" shows standard-balanced-fpga This is cosmetic and there is no function impact. "tmsh list sys fpga" will list the correct type "l7-performance-fpga".

bugs.title: The iRules LX workspace imported with incorrect SELinux contexts
bugs.symptoms: Files imported from iRules LX workspace may have incorrect SELinux contexts such as abrt_var_cache_t. This can cause reloading the workspace to fail with errors: 01070079: failed to create workspace archive ... Return code {2}
bugs.conditions: Importing the iRules LX workspace.
bugs.impact: Workspace cannot be imported
bugs.workaround: As a workaround you can run the following command on the folders to restore the context: restorecon -R -v

bugs.title: Ensure the system does not set the VE's MTU higher than the vmxnet3 driver can handle
bugs.symptoms: The vmxnet3 driver cannot handle MTUs larger than 9000 bytes.
bugs.conditions: -- Using a BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) with the vmxnet3 driver. -- Passing packets larger than 9000 bytes.
bugs.impact: Either packets are dropped, or the hypervisor may crash on some platforms that do not handle this condition gracefully.
bugs.workaround: Modify the tmm_init.tcl file, adding the following line: ndal mtu 9000 15ad:07b0
bugs.fix: We now ensure that the default setting for the vmxnet3 driver MTU is 9000.

bugs.title: TMSH allows you to specify the 'add-on-keys' option when running the 'revoke sys license' command
bugs.symptoms: TMSH currently allows you to specify the 'add-on-keys' option when running the 'revoke sys license' command, but the option is not honored and the entire license is revoked.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP license and add-on license are installed. -- Attempt to revoke the system license with 'add-on-keys' as an option.
bugs.impact: Add-on-keys option is ignored, and the entire license is revoked instead.

bugs.title: Like-named previous Signature Update installations block Live Update usage after upgrade
bugs.symptoms: Signature Update installations using ASU files with the same name on versions before 14.1.0 block Live Update usage after upgrade to 14.1.0 or later.
bugs.conditions: The same Signature Update file is installed multiple times on the device when running a version earlier than 14.1.0.
bugs.impact: Signature Update cannot be installed using Live Update, and errors appear in logs.
bugs.workaround: 1. Delete the file: /var/lib/hsqldb/live-update/live-update-import.yaml. 2. Restart tomcat: bigstart restart tomcat This causes pre-upgrade records for Signature Update to be lost, but does not have any other functional impact.

bugs.title: Bigd cored due to high iowait
bugs.symptoms: Sod detected heartbeat failure and killed bigd daemon. High number of probe_failures are also observed.
bugs.conditions: bigd (the BIG-IP monitoring daemon) is under heavy load
bugs.impact: Sod may kill bigd, and bigd may core.

bugs.title: ASM Response event logging for "Illegal response" violations.
bugs.symptoms: Response log is not available when the request is legal but returns an illegal response status code. In ASM, logging profiles allow the logging of all blocked responses. The existing response logging allows either all requests or illegal requests only which does not contain response logging data.
bugs.conditions: -- Response logging is enabled -- An illegal response occurs
bugs.impact: Response logging does not occur.
bugs.fix: When a response has ASM response violations and response logging is enabled only for when there was a violation, ASM includes the response in the log. Added an internal variable: disable_illegal_response_logging -- default value 0. If the response logging is enabled in the GUI, only the response logs are captured. If the variable disable_illegal_response_logging is set to 1, then response logging is disabled(even if enabled in GUI).

bugs.title: GUI gives error when attempting to associate address list as the source address of multiple virtual servers with the same destination address
bugs.symptoms: With multiple virtual servers that have the same destination address, changing all of them in the GUI to use an address list as their source address will result in the last one changed failing with an error similar to: 01070344:3: Cannot delete referenced virtual address /Common/1.2.3.4.
bugs.conditions: -- More than one virtual server with the same destination address. -- Changing all the virtual servers that share the same destination address to use an address list for their source address.
bugs.impact: Unable to change the source address of a virtual server to an address list.
bugs.workaround: Use TMSH to manually create a traffic-matching criteria object and assign it to the virtual server: tmsh create ltm traffic-matching-criteria <virtual server name>_VS_TMC_OBJ destination-address-inline <destination address of virtual server> destination-port-inline <destination port of virtual server> source-address-inline 0.0.0.0 source-address-list <address list name> } tmsh modify /ltm virtual <virtual server name> traffic-matching-criteria <virtual server name>_VS_TMC_OBJ destination 0.0.0.0:any

bugs.title: TMSH context-sensitive help for diameter session profile is missing some descriptions
bugs.symptoms: The tmsh context-sensitive help content for the following diameter session attributes is missing: -- respond-unroutable -- retransmission-action -- retransmission-queue-limit-high -- retransmission-queue-limit-low -- retransmission-queue-max-bytes -- retransmission-queue-max-messages
bugs.conditions: When attempting in tmsh to list a diameter session profile followed by a question mark for context-sensitive help- for example: list ltm message-routing diameter profile session <sess-name> ?
bugs.impact: The specified attributes are no described.
bugs.workaround: These are the missing descriptions: -- respond-unroutable: When selected (enabled), messages that do not match any known route will be transformed into an error answer message and sent to the originator of the request. When disabled, unroutable request messages are routed back to the connection where they came from. The default value is disabled. -- retransmission-action: Specifies the action performed when retransmission has been triggered for a request message. The options are: 1) Disabled: Retransmission is disabled. This is the default action. 2) Busy: An answer message is generated with a TOO_BUSY result code and returned to the originator of the request. 3) Unable: An answer message is generated with an UNABLE_TO_DELIVER result code and returned to the originator of the request. 4) Retransmit: The request message will be retransmitted. -- retransmission-queue-limit-high: Specifies the high watermark for the retransmission queue (in percentage). If the retransmission queue exceeds this limit, the transport window will begin closing. A value of 0 will disable closing the transport window. Valid range from 0 to 100. The default value is 90. -- retransmission-queue-limit-low: Specifies the low watermark for the retransmission queue (in percentage). If the retransmission queue drops below this limit, the transport window will reopen. Valid range from 0 to 100. The default value is 60. -- retransmission-queue-max-bytes: Specifies the maximum number of bytes that can be stored in a connections retransmission queue. A value of 0 will disable this limit. The default value is 131072 bytes. -- retransmission-queue-max-messages: Specifies the maximum number of messages that can be stored in a connections retransmission queue. A value of 0 will disable this limit. The default value is 1024 messages.
bugs.fix: The missing descriptions have been added to tmsh and now display properly.

bugs.title: [Portal Access] SELinux policy does not allow rewrite plugin to read certificate files.
bugs.symptoms: Java applets are not patched when accessed through APM Portal Access. /var/log/rewrite contains error messages similar to following: -- notice rewrite - fm_patchers/java_patcher_engine/CryptoToolsManager.cpp:568 (0x1919ab0): CryptoToolsManager :: _ReadCA() - cannot open CA file. /var/log/auditd/audit.log contains AVC denials for rewrite on attempt to read file under /config/filestore/.
bugs.conditions: Java patching is enabled via rewrite profile and Portal Access resource.
bugs.impact: Java applets cannot be patched by APM Portal Access rewriter.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with SELinux policy blocking Portal Access code from reading Java Patcher certificates.

bugs.title: Tcl error log improvement for node command
bugs.symptoms: Because of the Tcl error, connection gets reset and reports an error: err tmm[18774]: 01220001:3: TCL error: /Common/test2- bad port in node <addr> <port> cmdTCL error (line 43) (line 43) invoked from within "node 172.x.x.x IP [LB::server port]"
bugs.conditions: Using node command under pre-load-balancing iRule events.
bugs.impact: Unclear port values in Tcl error message.

bugs.title: Learning suggestion details layout broken in some browsers
bugs.symptoms: One of the suggestion details is placed incorrectly, out of alighment.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when you open the details for learning suggestion, e.g., based on refinement.
bugs.impact: Refinement title is out of line.
bugs.workaround: Use a different browser, if needed.
bugs.fix: Learning suggestion details layout now appears correctly.

bugs.title: Cipher ordering in cipher rules can be wrong
bugs.symptoms: With a cipher string such as ECDHE:ECDH_RSA:NATIVE is used, the expansion is done in the wrong order.
bugs.conditions: Cipher rules are used, and some are expanded.
bugs.impact: Cipher ordering can changes, so unexpected cipher suites are used.

bugs.title: HSB transmitter failure on i2000/i4000 series
bugs.symptoms: The HSB experiences a transmitter failure, which is reported in the TMM log files: F5 crit tmm3[19371]: 01010025:2: Device error: hsb hsb interface 3 DMA lockup on transmitter failure.
bugs.conditions: -- i2000/i4000-series platforms. -- Other conditions under which this occurs are unknown.
bugs.impact: The appliance is rebooted due to triggering a nic_failsafe reboot.
bugs.workaround: None/Unknown.

bugs.title: Incorrect log level for message when OAuth client or OAuth resource server fails to generate secret.
bugs.symptoms: The log message when OAuth client or resource server fails to generate the secret is assigned an incorrect log level, and is incorrectly logged at the emergency level.
bugs.conditions: This is encountered when this message is logged by mcpd.
bugs.impact: Log message cannot be grouped with messages at the correct log level.

bugs.title: AVR analytics is reporting null domain name for a dns query
bugs.symptoms: AVR analytics is reporting null domain name for a DNS query if DNS DoS profile is attached to a virtual server, but the profile does not have the matching type vector enabled to the query type.
bugs.conditions: -- DNS DoS profile is attached to a virtual server. -- The query type in the DNS query does not match an enabled DNS vector on the DNS profile.
bugs.impact: DNS domain name is reported as NULL
bugs.workaround: Enable the matching type vector on the DNS DoS profile.
bugs.fix: The domain name is now reported correctly under these conditions.

bugs.title: Per-request policy is not exported if it contains HTTP Connector Agent
bugs.symptoms: Per-request policy cannot be exported if it contains an HTTP Connector agent.
bugs.conditions: -- Create a Per Request Policy. -- In the sub-routine section, create a new sub-routine and attach HTTP Connector to that sub-routine. -- After the policy creation is done, export the policy.
bugs.impact: Per-request policy cannot be exported and reports an error.
bugs.fix: Create a valid HTTP Connector agent in tmsh and the per request policy gets exported as expected.

bugs.title: Possible temporary CPU usage increase with unusually large named.conf file
bugs.symptoms: You might see occasional and temporary CPU usage increases when named.conf file is unusually large.
bugs.conditions: Unusually large named.conf file and zones are checked for updates (when the SOA expires).
bugs.impact: When a zone file is updated, a downstream effect is the ZoneRunner process to parse again the named.conf file. The parsing of an unusually large file may cause a temporary increase in CPU usage.
bugs.fix: ZoneRunner does not issue a reload command when zones are checked for updates, so no CPU usage increases occur.

bugs.title: [APM Portal Access] SELinux policy does not allow rewrite plugin to create web applications trace troubleshooting data collection
bugs.symptoms: SELinux policy does not allow the rewrite plugin to create a directory and write troubleshooting data into /var/tmp/WebAppTrace.
bugs.conditions: Collecting Portal Access web applications traces per K13384: Performing a web applications trace (11.x - 14.x) :: https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K13384
bugs.impact: Cannot collect Portal Access web applications troubleshooting data as it described in in that AskF5 Article.
bugs.workaround: Connect via SSH using the root account and run this command: restorecon -Rv /var/tmp/WebAppTrace/
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with an SELinux policy blocking Portal Access from processing web applications traces.

bugs.title: Inaccurate warning message for DNS resolver in bot profile
bugs.symptoms: Bot profile requires a DNS resolver to fully operate. The DNS resolver needs to be under the default Route-Domain. A warning message displays when there is no DNS resolver, but it does not state that the DNS resolver should be configured for the default Route-Domain.
bugs.conditions: -- Bot defense profile (with signature enforcement) is in use. -- DNS resolver is configured under a non-default Route-Domain.
bugs.impact: Warning message is inaccurate: a DNS resolver is configured (under a different route domain), but the feature does not fully operate.
bugs.workaround: Configure the DNS resolver under the default Route-Domain.
bugs.fix: This release contains a warning message that indicates that the DNS resolver should be configured under the default Route-Domain.

bugs.title: Command 'tmsh save /sys config' fails to save the configuration and hangs
bugs.symptoms: The 'tmsh save /sys config' command hangs and fails to save the configuration if there is a memory allocation failure when creating the reply.
bugs.conditions: -- A large number of iApps: in the thousands. -- Each iApp has tens of variables.
bugs.impact: Because tmsh cannot save the configuration, if the BIG-IP system reboots, any changes made since the last successful save are lost.
bugs.workaround: Run the command: tmsh save /sys config binary This does not save the configuration to files in /config, but it does at least allow you to save the binary configuration. That way, you can reboot the BIG-IP system and not lose the configuration. Note: It is possible that a reboot will provide sufficient memory to save to configuration files. It depends on the configuration of virtual memory at the time of the save. It is possible that every time you want to save the config, you must use the binary option.

bugs.title: Azure walinuxagent has been updated to v2.2.42.
bugs.symptoms: Some onboarding features are not available in the version of walinuxagent earlier than v2.2.42.
bugs.conditions: Attempting to use a feature that is not available in the current version of the Azure walinuxagent that is included in the BIG-IP release.
bugs.impact: Cannot use new features in the Azure walinuxagent until the Azure walinuxagent is updated.
bugs.fix: The Azure walinuxagent has been updated to v2.2.42.

bugs.title: Tmm crash under heavy load
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP PEM is licensed and configured. -- Heavy traffic is received by PEM virtual server. -- The traffic pattern goes through subscriber add/delete frequently.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: Fixed a tmm crash related to PEM subscriber IDs.

bugs.title: An iRule with a proc referencing a datagroup cannot be assigned to Transport Config
bugs.symptoms: If you try to assign an iRule to a Transport Config, and if the iRule has a proc that references a datagroup, the assignment fails with an error: 01070151:3: Rule [/Common/test2] error: Unable to find value_list (datagroup) referenced at line 6: [class lookup "first" datagroup]
bugs.conditions: -- Assign an iRule to a Transport Config. -- The iRule has a proc. -- The proc references a datagroup.
bugs.impact: Validation fails. An iRule with a proc referencing a datagroup cannot be assigned to Transport Config objects.
bugs.workaround: Make the datagroup a Tcl variable to bypass validation.
bugs.fix: Validation can recognize the datagroup on Transport Config objects.

bugs.title: MRF DIAMETER: additional details to log event to assist debugging
bugs.symptoms: There are not enough details in log events when stale pending requests are removed.
bugs.conditions: An answer message is not received before the configured timeout has been reached.
bugs.impact: The set of arguments in the log message do not have enough information to debug why the message was not responded to.
bugs.fix: New details have been added to help debug why the message was not responded to.

bugs.title: Potential name collision for client-ssl profile named 'clientssl-quic'
bugs.symptoms: This release includes a new base client-ssl profile for use by QUIC virtual servers. If an existing client-ssl profile named 'clientssl-quic' exists, it will be overwritten by the new built-in profile after upgrading.
bugs.conditions: The system to be upgraded has an existing client-ssl profile named 'clientssl-quic'.
bugs.impact: The existing profile will be overwritten by the new built-in profile.
bugs.workaround: Rename the existing profile prior to upgrade.

bugs.title: Hv_netvsc vmbus_17 timeout at boot causes reduced NIC performance
bugs.symptoms: -- Uneven unic channel distribution and transmit errors seen in /proc/unic. -- Packet loss and increased retransmissions under load. -- Errors reported in dmesg: hv_netvsc vmbus_17 (unregistered net_device): timeout before we got a set response....
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) in Azure boots while the hypervisor is under high load.
bugs.impact: -- Reduced throughput. -- Packet loss and increased retransmissions under load.
bugs.workaround: This condition occurs when a timeout occurs when booting, resulting in the NIC driver not getting necessary information from the hypervisor. Rebooting the BIG-IP VE may clear the condition if the hypervisor load has reduced.

bugs.title: Unused parameters remain after modifying the swagger file of a policy
bugs.symptoms: After you update the swagger file of a policy, some parameters that are not defined in the updated swagger may remain in the policy.
bugs.conditions: 1. Policy contains global parameters that were added manually 2. All the URL parameters are deleted in the new swagger file
bugs.impact: Traffic to these parameters will not raise a violation ILLEGAL PARAMETER as expected
bugs.workaround: The leftover parameters need to be removed manually

bugs.title: BD crash on specific scenario
bugs.symptoms: BD crashes while passing traffic.
bugs.conditions: Specific out of memory scenario.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while bd restarts.
bugs.fix: This OOM specific scenario does not cause a crash.

bugs.title: UCS backup archive may include unnecessary files
bugs.symptoms: UCS backup archive file size is much larger than UCS files in previous releases.
bugs.conditions: -- UCS backup process finishes with failure and does not clean temporary files. -- A second UCS backup is attempted.
bugs.impact: Those files are included in the UCS archive, which results in an unusually large UCS backup files.
bugs.workaround: Before running the UCS backup process, remove directories: /var/tmp/ts_db.save_dir_*.cstmp/

bugs.title: Installation of browser challenges fails through Live Update
bugs.symptoms: Live Update of Browser Challenges fails installation. Live Update provides an interface on the F5 Downloads site to manually install or configure automatic installation of various updates to BIG-IP ASM components, including ASM Attack Signatures, Server Technologies, Browser Challenges, and others.
bugs.conditions: -- From the F5 Downloads side, select a software version. -- Click BrowserChallengesUpdates. -- Attempt to download and install Download BrowserChallenges<version_number>.im. Note: Browser Challenges perform browser verification, device and bot identification, and proactive bot defense.
bugs.impact: Browser Challenges update file cannot be installed.
bugs.fix: Browser Challenges update file can now be installed via Live Update.

bugs.title: The icrd returns incorrect route names in some cases
bugs.symptoms: The icrd returns an incorrect route names when a '.' (dot, or period) is present in the subPath, as it treats the subPath as an IP address and the leaf name as a subnet and considers its name as a whole. Also the subPath field is missed in the response route object. This happens only in the case of curl request.
bugs.conditions: -- The subPath contains a '.' in it. -- A curl request is made.
bugs.impact: Result information is not compatible with actual result.
bugs.fix: The system now verifies whether or not the leafname a numeric valuel, so this issue no longer occurs.

bugs.title: Unable to use Rest API to manage GTM pool members that have an pipe symbol '|' in the server name.
bugs.symptoms: Rest API returns 404 'Object not found"' error when attempting direct access to pool member that has pipe symbol '|' in the server or virtual server name.
bugs.conditions: An iControl/REST call to a pool member that has a virtual server on the Server whose name contains a | character in the server or virtual server name.
bugs.impact: The iControl/REST call cannot manage a pool member associated with a virtual server or server whose name contains a | character.
bugs.workaround: Rename the server or virtual server to a name that does not contains the | character.

bugs.title: TMM may crash while processing traffic on AWS
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, TMM may crash while processing traffic with the DPDK/ENA driver on AWS systems.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) on AWS configured with the XNet DPDK/ENA driver.
bugs.impact: TMM restart, leading to a failover event.
bugs.workaround: Configure BIG-IP VE to use the sock driver instead of the default XNet driver.
bugs.fix: TMM now processes traffic as expected when using the XNet DPDK/ENA driver on AWS.

bugs.title: Request samples for some of the learning suggestions are not visible
bugs.symptoms: Learning suggestions created from single request do not show source 'request log' in the 'Suggestion' GUI section.
bugs.conditions: 'Learning Suggestion' created from only one 'Request Log' record.
bugs.impact: Learning suggestions created from single request does not show source 'request log' in the 'Suggestion' GUI section

bugs.title: Translucent vlan-groups set local bit in destination MAC address
bugs.symptoms: Translucent vlan-groups may set the locally-unique bit in a destination MAC address when sending traffic to a pool member/client.
bugs.conditions: On versions earlier than 15.0.0: - Translucent vlan-group is in use. On v15.0.0 and later: -- Translucent vlan-group is in use. -- The connection.vgl2transparent db variable is enabled.
bugs.impact: Traffic handled by translucent vlan-groups may not work properly.
bugs.workaround: On versions earlier than 15.0.0, there is no workaround. -- On version 15.0.0 and later, you can disable the connection.vgl2transparent db variable to mitigate the problem: tmsh modify sys db connection.vgl2transparent value disable Note: connection.vgl2transparent is disabled by default.

bugs.title: Show net ipsec ipsec-sa traffic-selector not working on secondary blade
bugs.symptoms: The tmsh command 'show net ipsec ipsec-sa traffic-selector' does not work on the secondary blade.
bugs.conditions: -- Configuration with secondary blades (cluster scenario). -- Running the command ont he secondary blade: show net ipsec ipsec-sa traffic-selector
bugs.impact: IPsec SA's from the secondary blade are not displayed.
bugs.workaround: You can use either of the following workarounds: -- Remove the traffic-selector classifier from the command, and all IPsec SA's are then displayed. -- The results of all blades can be viewed at once by issuing from the primary blade: clsh tmsh show net ipsec ipsec-sa
bugs.fix: When issuing the command 'tmsh show net ipsec ipsec-sa traffic-selector' on a secondary blade, the correct results are now shown.

bugs.title: TMM may crash while processing IP traffic
bugs.symptoms: Unusual packet flows can cause TMM to crash on a BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE). An error message appears in the stack trace of the core file: Tx cd is valid
bugs.conditions: -- Running VE. -- A specific unusual packet flow.
bugs.impact: TMM crash leading to a failover event.
bugs.fix: TMM now processes IP traffic as expected.

bugs.title: APM configsnapshot are not created when blade transitions from secondary to primary
bugs.symptoms: In a chassis, when a secondary blade transitions to the primary blade it is responsible for keeping APM configuration snapshots current. However, prior to 13.1.0, APM configuration snapshots are not maintained.
bugs.conditions: -- APM configured in a multi-bladed chassis. -- Secondary blade transitions to primary blade.
bugs.impact: Cannot access any APM functionality
bugs.workaround: Restart the apd process using the following command on the new primary blade: # bigstart restart apmd

bugs.title: Flow-control is reset to default for secondary blade's interface
bugs.symptoms: When a secondary blade is a new blade or is booted without a binary db, the LLDP settings on the blade's interface is reset to default.
bugs.conditions: Plug in a new secondary blade, or reboot a blade (that comes up as secondary) without a binary db.
bugs.impact: The flow-control setting is reset to default (tx-rx).
bugs.workaround: Reload the configuration on the primary blade.

bugs.title: ASM CAPTCHA is not working the first time when a request contains sensitive parameters
bugs.symptoms: ASM end users are required to type CAPTCHA letters twice to get the login request to be forwarded to the server. In addition, the original login request is not sent to the server, which results in failed logins.
bugs.conditions: -- ASM provisioned. -- ASM policy attached to a virtual server. -- Brute force enabled in the ASM policy. -- Brute force issues CAPTCHA mitigation.
bugs.impact: False-positive bad logins.
bugs.workaround: Remove sensitive parameters from asm policy. Impact of workaround: This results in sensitive parameters being revealed in the ASM event logs.
bugs.fix: CAPTCHA mechanism now works correctly along with sensitive parameters.

bugs.title: Config script does not refresh management address entry properly when alternating between dynamic and static
bugs.symptoms: Config script does not refresh management address entry properly when alternating between dynamic (DHCP) and static configuration.
bugs.conditions: - Management IP assignment is changed from dynamic (DHCP) to static. - Same IP address is configured, as previously received from DHCP server.
bugs.impact: Remote management access is lost after DHCP lease expires.
bugs.workaround: Restart BIG-IP after changing the management IP address.

bugs.title: Traffic classification does not update when an inactive slot becomes active after upgrade
bugs.symptoms: VIPRION platforms have an automated process of joining a newly inserted blade to a cluster. TMOS install, licensing, and configuration including iAppLX are synchronized from primary to the newly inserted blade automatically without manual intervention. Traffic classification update is not occurring as expected under these conditions.
bugs.conditions: -- Traffic classification configured. -- Update installation. -- VIPRION blade is inactive, and later comes online.
bugs.impact: Traffic policies/rules related to updated installation do not work on inactive slot when it returns to the online state.
bugs.workaround: To prevent this issue from occurring, ensure that all blades are online when installation begins. If you insert a blade, run config sync manually from the active blade.
bugs.fix: Upgrade script now initiates install when the slot becomes active.

bugs.title: Gtm_add does not restart named
bugs.symptoms: Running gtm_add failed to restart the named daemon.
bugs.conditions: Run gtm_add to completion.
bugs.impact: Named is not restarted. No BIND functionality.
bugs.workaround: Restart named: bigstart start named
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue preventing 'named' from restarting after running the gtm_add script.

bugs.title: SCTP flow may be inappropriately aborted due to 'stream-id out of range'
bugs.symptoms: SCTP flow may be aborted due to 'stream-id out of range' even both client and server send SCTP chunk with correct stream-id. The out-of-range stream-id happens because the BIG-IP system fails to store the stream-id during ingress, so it is incorrectly restored on egress. When this occurs, a message similar to the following may be found in /var/log/ltm: notice tmm[19016]: 01900032:5: SCTP serverside association (10.65.125.108:388 -> 10.65.135.103:563) aborted (stream-id out of range).
bugs.conditions: - Standard SCTP virtual deployment. - SCTP client sends ordered data chunk. - SCTP server responds with unordered data chunk. - VLAN tagging is used.
bugs.impact: Traffic is interrupted due to SCTP connection is aborted unintentionally.

bugs.title: Deleting and re-adding the last virtual server that references a plugin profile in a single transaction causes traffic failure
bugs.symptoms: Traffic fails to pass through a virtual server.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server is removed and a new one is added in a single transaction. -- Virtual server references a plugin profile. For example, create a CLI transaction: - delete ltm virtual vs_http - create ltm virtual vs_https destination 1.1.1.1:443 vlans-enabled profiles replace-all-with { http ntlm oneconnect } - submit cli transaction
bugs.impact: Traffic failure on the new virtual server.
bugs.workaround: Create a virtual server that does not accept any traffic, but keeps the NTLM MPI plugin channel alive: tmsh create ltm virtual workaround destination 1.1.1.1:1 profiles replace-all-with { http oneconnect ntlm } vlans-enabled vlans none && tmsh save sys config

bugs.title: TCP:collect validation changed in 12.0.0: the first argument can no longer be zero
bugs.symptoms: Validation for TCP::collect was changed in BIG-IP software v12.0.0 (with the introduction of JET specifications). Prior to 12.0.0, there were no restrictions on the values of the two arguments. As of 12.0.0, the first argument ('collect_bytes') must be a positive integer, and the second argument ('skip_bytes) must be a non-negative integer. Occurrences of 'TCP::collect 0 0' in iRules experience issues when upgrading to a newer version, producing warnings in LTM log: /Common/T_collect:9: warning: [The following errors were not caught before. Please correct the script in order to avoid future disruption. "invalid argument 0; expected syntax spec:"136 17][TCP::collect 0 0].
bugs.conditions: -- Using a version of BIG-IP software earlier than 12.0.0, configure an iRule with a 'TCP::collect 0 0' command. -- Upgrade to 12.0.0 or later.
bugs.impact: Warning in the LTM log file. The iRules containing 0 values do not function as expected. There is no other impact.
bugs.workaround: Change 'TCP::collect 0 0' to a value other than 0 (zero) in any iRules before or after upgrade.

bugs.title: The bigip_gtm.conf is reverted to default after rebooting with license expired
bugs.symptoms: The bigip_gtm.conf is reverted to default after rebooting (or upgrading to a newer BIG-IP software release).
bugs.conditions: -- The BIG-IP license is expired prior to the reboot or upgrade. -- GTM is configured.
bugs.impact: The GTM configuration (in /config/bigip_gtm.conf) information is lost in the newly installed boot location.
bugs.workaround: Renew license before reboot. Always reboot with valid license. If you have already rebooted or upgraded with an expired license, and your configuration has been lost, you can restore it using the following procedure. 1. Re-activate the BIG-IP license 2. Restore bigip_gtm.conf from the auto-created backup (.bak) file: cp /config/bigip_gtm.conf.bak /config/bigip_gtm.conf 3. Load the replaced config: tmsh load sys config gtm-only If this is a the result of a software upgrade, and the .bak file is not available or has been overwritten, you can boot back to the previous volume and re-copy the configuration from there (cpcfg or via the GUI) before rebooting back to the upgraded software release.

bugs.title: Very large policies could have problems with re-import
bugs.symptoms: Policy exported and then imported with Syntax Error: Import error: Syntax Error:(/shared/tmp/apmom/import/p--11-02--07-34-31--208.conf at line: 976) "src-subnet" unexpected argument.
bugs.conditions: Elements in policy are very large (e.g., 100 KB). Note: This is a rarely occurring issue.
bugs.impact: Unable to import policy.
bugs.fix: Policy can now be exported and then import successfully.

bugs.title: TCP connection is not established for ICAP server
bugs.symptoms: There is no TCP connection established for the ICAP server.
bugs.conditions: The conditions under which this occurs have not been defined.
bugs.impact: This is an issue with establishing a serverside TCP connection to the remote server.

bugs.title: Changing a virtual server that uses a oneconnect profile can trigger persistence misbehavior.
bugs.symptoms: High tmm CPU utilization. Stalled connection. Incorrect persistence decisions
bugs.conditions: A oneconnect profile is combined with certain persist profiles on a virtual server. The virtual server configuration is changed while there is an ongoing connection to the virtual server. Any connections that make a request after the configuration change can be affected. The persistence types that are affected are Source Address (but not hash-algorithm carp) Destination Address (but not hash-algorithm carp) Universal Cookie (only cookie hash) Host SSL session SIP Hash (but not hash-algorithm carp)
bugs.impact: High tmm CPU utilization. Stalled connection. Incorrect persistence decisions
bugs.fix: Changing a virtual server that uses a OneConnect profile no longer triggers incorrect persistence behavior.

bugs.title: Portal Access: default port encoded in rewritten url, need to be removed from host header in request to backend
bugs.symptoms: Bad response, or invalid response for request in which default port was used in web-application.
bugs.conditions: Default port is used in the url, back end application does not expect the default port in the request's Host header.
bugs.impact: Web-application misfunction
bugs.workaround: Custom workaround iRule can be used to remove default port form rewritten url.

bugs.title: TMM may consume excessive resources while processing compressed HTTP traffic
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, TMM may consume excessive resources while processing compressed HTTP traffic.
bugs.conditions: -- At least one virtual server with an http-compression profile is configured on BIG-IP.
bugs.impact: Excessive resource consumption, potentially leading to a failover event.
bugs.workaround: By removing the compression profile from the virtual servers, possible interruptions of service may be avoided.
bugs.fix: TMM now processes compressed HTTP traffic as expected.

bugs.title: Global/URL/Flow Parameters with flag is_sensitive true are not masked in Referer
bugs.symptoms: Global/URL/Flow Parameters with flag is_sensitive true are not masked in referrer and their value may be exposed in logs.
bugs.conditions: Global/URL/Flow Parameters with flag is_sensitive true are defined in the policy. In logs, the value of such parameter will be masked in QS, but will be exposed in the referrer.
bugs.impact: The parameter will not be masked in 'Referer' value header in logs, although it is masked in 'QS' string.
bugs.workaround: Can defined the parameters as global sensitive parameters.
bugs.fix: After the fix, such parameters will be treated like global sensitive parameters and will be covered also in the Referer

bugs.title: Portal Access message event has wrong origin if message originates from split tunneled frame
bugs.symptoms: Unexpected exceptions, and other issues can be visible dependent on web-application internal logic.
bugs.conditions: Portal Access message hat originates from a split tunneled frame; for example, in a split tunneling configuration: REWRITE *://* BYPASS *://*twitter* *://*twimg*
bugs.impact: Web-application does not operate as expected. Messages sent from the iframe with src=http://twitter.com to the main window with URL http://my.company.com can cause exception when receiving data.
bugs.workaround: Use a custom iRule to handle this situation.
bugs.fix: Portal Access message event now has the correct origin if the message originates from a split tunneled frame.

bugs.title: Disabling the LCD on a VIPRION causes blade status lights to turn amber
bugs.symptoms: When the LCD is disabled or turned off on a VIPRION system, the blade status lights turn amber.
bugs.conditions: You can cause this to occur by running the command: tmsh modify sys db platform.chassis.lcd value disable
bugs.impact: Blade status lights change to amber, even if nothing is wrong with the system.

bugs.title: Link between 'API protection profile' and 'Security Policy' is not restored after UCS upload
bugs.symptoms: Link between 'API protection profile' and 'Security Policy' created with swagger based 'API protection profile' preserved in UCS file. This link is not restored after UCS upload.
bugs.conditions: UCS upload.
bugs.impact: 'API protection profile' has no link to related security policy.

bugs.title: Configuration for virtual server using shared object address-list in non-default partition in non-default route-domain does not sync to peer node.
bugs.symptoms: Shared object address-list in non-default partition in non-default route-domain does not sync to peer node. The system reports the following exceptions when such an issue occurs: -- err mcpd[4941]: 0107004d:3: Virtual address (/TestwithRD1/0.0.0.0%1) encodes IP address (0.0.0.0%1) which differs from supplied IP address field (0.0.0.0). -- err mcpd[4941]: 01071488:3: Remote transaction for device group /Common/DG1 to commit id 500 6754270728594498269 /Common/bigiptest1 0 failed with error 0107004d:3: Virtual address (/TestwithRD1/0.0.0.0%1) encodes IP address (0.0.0.0%1) which differs from supplied IP address field (0.0.0.0).
bugs.conditions: -- Create Custom partition. -- Create Custom Route-domain. -- Change custom partition. -- Create address list in non-default route domain. -- Create virtual server with previously created address list and any TCP port. -- Now, try to Sync to high availability (HA) peer.
bugs.impact: Sync fails with error. Configuration will not sync to peer node.
bugs.fix: Configuration now syncs to peer node successfully.

bugs.title: Config sync failure when importing a Json policy
bugs.symptoms: Importing a json policy to a BIG-IP that is in a device group machine causes errors on the other devices, which leads to a sync failure.
bugs.conditions: This can occur when a json policy is imported to a BIG-IP that is in a device group
bugs.impact: Config sync fails.
bugs.fix: Peer devices will receive only the initial import call.

bugs.title: No configurable setting for maximum entries in CRLDP cache
bugs.symptoms: There is no setting provided to configure maximum entries the in CRLDP cache.
bugs.conditions: In a configuration with tens of thousands of CRLDP and hundreds of thousands or millions of certificates, certain operations might encounter an internal limit, resulting in a number of revoked certificates.
bugs.impact: No settings exist. Cannot set maximum entries in CRLDP cache.
bugs.fix: There is now a setting for configuring maximum entries in CRLDP cache.

bugs.title: Lines with only asterisks filling message and user.log file
bugs.symptoms: /var/log/message and /var/log/user.log files have lines that only contain asterisks. For example: Nov 12 10:40:57 bigip1 **********************************************
bugs.conditions: Snmp query an OID handled by sflow, for example: snmpwalk -v2c -c public localhost SNMPv2-SMI::enterprises.14706.1.1.1
bugs.impact: The impact is cosmetic only, however it could make reading the logs more difficult if the sflow snmp tables are constantly being queried.
bugs.workaround:
You have two options: -- Filter out all sflow_agent log messages -- Filter out all messages that contain a newline '
' or carriage return character ''. Both workarounds are done by editing the syslog template, this means that if the you upgrades, you must edit the template again to reinstate the workaround. ============================================= Solution #1 - Filter out all sflow_agent logs: 1) remount /usr as read+write: mount -o rw,remount /usr 2) Make a backup copy of the template: cp /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl.orig 3) Add write permissions to the template: chmod +w /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl 4) Add the filter to syslog.tmpl 4a) Open syslog.tmpl for edit: vi /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl 4b) Add the new filter after the filter f_messages: filter f_not_sflow { not match ("sflow_agent" value("$PROGRAM")); }; For example: filter f_messages { level(UNIX_CONFIG_SYSLOG_REPLACE_MESSAGESFROM..UNIX_CONFIG_SYSLOG_REPLACE_MESSAGESTO) and not facility(auth, authpriv, cron, daemon, mail, news) and not message("WA"); }; filter f_not_sflow { not match ("sflow_agent" value("$PROGRAM")); }; 4c) Add the filter to the log that sends all source local message to the syslog pipe: log { source(local); filter(f_not_sflow); destination(d_syslog_pipe); } 5) Save the changes and quit vi. 6) In order for the BIG-IP system to write out the syslog conf with the modified template, you must change the syslog configuration. To do so, use tmsh to modify the 'daemon-from' to 'info' and then back to the default of 'notice': tmsh modify /sys syslog daemon-from info tmsh modify /sys syslog daemon-from notice 7) Ensure the changes were written to /etc/syslog-ng/syslog-ng.conf. 8) remount /usr as read-only mount -o ro,remount /usr ============================================= Solution #2 - Filter out all messages with 
 or : 1) remount /usr as r+w: mount -o rw,remount /usr 2) Make a backup copy of the template: cp /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl.orig 3) Add write permissions to the template: chmod +w /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl 4) Add the filter to syslog.tmpl: 4a) Open syslog.tmpl for edit: vi /usr/share/defaults/config/templates/syslog.tmpl 4b) Add the new filter after the filter f_messages: filter f_no_multi_line { not (message('
') or message('')); }; For example: filter f_messages { level(UNIX_CONFIG_SYSLOG_REPLACE_MESSAGESFROM..UNIX_CONFIG_SYSLOG_REPLACE_MESSAGESTO) and not facility(auth, authpriv, cron, daemon, mail, news) and not message("WA"); }; filter f_no_multi_line { not (message('
') or message('')); }; 4c) Add the filter to the log that sends all source local message to the syslog pipe: log { source(local); filter(f_no_multi_line); destination(d_syslog_pipe); } 5) Save the changes and quit vi. 6) In order for the BIG-IP system to write out the syslog conf with the modified template, you must change the syslog configuration. To do so, use tmsh to modify the 'daemon-from' to 'info' and then back to the default of 'notice': tmsh modify /sys syslog daemon-from info tmsh modify /sys syslog daemon-from notice 7) Ensure the changes were written to /etc/syslog-ng/syslog-ng.conf. 8) remount /usr as read-only: mount -o ro,remount /usr
bugs.fix: The sflow log message that was a multiline message has been changed so that it is no longer multiline.

bugs.title: An outgoing SCTP connection that retransmits the INIT chunk the maximum number of times does not expire and becomes stuck
bugs.symptoms: The outgoing SCTP connection does not expire after attempting to INIT the maximum number of times. It then becomes stuck and does not expire when it reaches its idle-timeout, and cannot be manually deleted.
bugs.conditions: An outgoing SCTP connection is permitted to attempt the INIT retransmit the maximum number of times configured with no responses (accepting or aborting) from the target endpoint.
bugs.impact: Stale SCTP connections are left in the system and start to use up memory. Traffic may be interrupted in certain configurations, as the system thinks it is still attempting to bring up the lost SCTP connection and does not ever try to create a new one.
bugs.workaround: To clear the stale connections, restart tmm: bigstart restart tmm Note: Restarting tmm causes an interruption to traffic.
bugs.fix: SCTP connections now expire properly after the maximum number of INITs have been attempted and can no longer get stuck in this case.

bugs.title: High CPU usage after Inheritance page opened
bugs.symptoms: After you visit the Policy Inheritance page, there is high CPU usage in the browser until you leave the policies page.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when opening the Policy Inheritance page for a policy that does not have a parent.
bugs.impact: High CPU usage by browser
bugs.fix: Normal CPU usage for in policy pages

bugs.title: Adding a new option to disable CSP header modification in bot defense/dosl7 via sys db
bugs.symptoms: Web app flow might fail resulting in JavaScript errors related to CSP policy
bugs.conditions: -- ASM provisioned. -- Bot-Defense or DoS Application profile assigned to a virtual server. -- The backend server sends CSP headers.
bugs.impact: Web application flow might fail.
bugs.workaround: Attach an iRule: when HTTP_REQUEST { set csp 0 } when HTTP_RESPONSE { if { [HTTP::header exists Content-Security-Policy] } { set csp "[HTTP::header values Content-Security-Policy]" } } when HTTP_RESPONSE_RELEASE { if { $csp != 0 } { HTTP::header replace Content-Security-Policy $csp } set csp 0 }
bugs.fix: Adding an option to disable CSP headers modification via sys db.

bugs.title: LTM v14.1.2.1 does not log after upgrade
bugs.symptoms: After upgrading to v14.1.2.1, logs are not generated and sysstat.service is not running.
bugs.conditions: -- Upgrade from BIG-IP v12.1.x (which uses CentOS 6) to BIG-IP v14.1.2.1 or later (which uses CentOS 7). -- The issue is momentary and is not always reproducible.
bugs.impact: Logs are not generated and sysstat.service is not running.
bugs.workaround: Once the BIG-IP system starts up, check for failed services: systemctl list-units --failed If results show sysstat.service as FAILED, run the following command: restorecon -Rv /var/log/sa6 && systemctl start sysstat

bugs.title: TMM may crash with FastL4 and HTTP profile using fallback host and iRule command
bugs.symptoms: TMM may crash when FastL4 is used with an HTTP profile and an iRule command. Even if TMM does not crash, the incorrect iRule may prevent the connection from working.
bugs.conditions: -- A virtual server configured to use FastL4 with an HTTP profile with a fallback host. -- The virtual server has an iRule that performs a pool pick after the connection is established. Note: Using the pool command after the server-side connection is established is not a valid operation.
bugs.impact: TMM typically crashes; however, whether or not TMM crashes, the invalid use of the pool command results in connection failure.
bugs.workaround: Remove the invalid iRule configuration.
bugs.fix: This issue no longer occurs.

bugs.title: Autodosd crash after assigning dos profile with custom signatures to a virtual server
bugs.symptoms: When attaching dos profile to virtual server, it will crash occasionally.
bugs.conditions: -- AFM is provisioned -- Performing profile attachment
bugs.impact: Autodosd crashes and restarts.
bugs.fix: Add addtional check to eliminate race condition.

bugs.title: Possible tmm core when using Dosl7/Bot Defense profile
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes.
bugs.conditions: -- Dosl7/Bot defense profile is attached to a virtual server -- A request is sent with a trusted bot signature and requires a rDNS. -- An asynchronous iRule is attached to the virtual server OR: -- Device ID feature is enabled, and the current request requires a complex Device ID generation. -- The connection is closed before the response arrives.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: Connection hangs since pipelined HTTP requests are incorrectly queued in the proxy and not processed
bugs.symptoms: First HTTP request on a connection creates a connection to the server. Subsequent pipelined requests should be processed and use the established connection to the server. However, the requests were queued in the proxy and not processed resulting in connection hang.
bugs.conditions: - HTTP or HTTP/2 virtual server with httprouter profile. - HTTP/1.1 connections with the client and server. - Pipelined HTTP requests.
bugs.impact: Connection hangs and is eventually reset.
bugs.workaround: No workaround.
bugs.fix: If a connection to the server has been established, pipelined requests are now processed immediately and not queued.

bugs.title: Microsoft Hyper-V hv_netvsc driver unevenly utilizing vmbus_channel queues
bugs.symptoms: -- Uneven unic channel distribution and transmit errors (tx_errcnt) seen in /proc/unic. -- Packet loss and increased retransmissions under load.
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) in Hyper-V or Azure Cloud.
bugs.impact: -- Reduced throughput. -- Packet loss and increased retransmissions under load.

bugs.title: Memory leak when using OAuth
bugs.symptoms: Tmm memory usage keeps going up when passing multiple HTTP requests through a kept-alive TCP connection carrying an OAuth token as bearer in the Authorization header.
bugs.conditions: -- Multiple HTTP requests through a kept-alive TCP connection. -- Requests carry an OAuth token as bearer in the Authorization header.
bugs.impact: Memory leak occurs in which tmm memory usage increases.

bugs.title: Incorrect MAC when virtual wire is configured with FastL4
bugs.symptoms: Incorrect MAC is seen in the network when virtual wire is configured with a FastL4 profile.
bugs.conditions: Virtual wire is configured with a FastL4 profile.
bugs.impact: Incorrect MAC on the packets.

bugs.title: LDAP - tmsh cannot add config to nslcd.conf
bugs.symptoms: nslcd comes as a dependency package for the nss-pam-ldapd and nslcd.conf file contains the configuration information for running nslcd. tmsh does not support modification of nslcd.conf to include some options.
bugs.conditions: This would be encountered only if you wanted to do modify the nslcd configurations
bugs.impact: You are unable to modify nslcd configuration for some options. This prevents the ability to use certain ldap-based remote authentication techniques.
bugs.workaround: Modify nslcd.conf file to include configuration changes manually and restart the nslcd daemon with systemctl restart nslcd

bugs.title: Zone Trusted Signature inadequately maintains following change of master key
bugs.symptoms: During config load or system start-up, you may see the following error: -- 01071769:3: Decryption of the field (privatekey) for object (13079) failed. Unexpected Error: Loading configuration process failed. In some instances, other errors resembling the following may appear: -- Failed to sign zone transfer query for zone DNSZONE01 using TSIG key zone01key.pl. -- Failed to transfer DNSZONE01 from 203.0.113.53, will attempt IXFR (Retry).
bugs.conditions: -- TSIG keys are present in the device configuration. -- The device's master key is changed.
bugs.impact: Unable to view TSIG keys. Configuration cannot be loaded. Failures of DNS zone transfers may occur.
bugs.fix: When master key changes, TSIG keys are now properly re-encrypted, so this problem no longer exists.

bugs.title: Policy with % in name cannot be exported
bugs.symptoms: Policies with characters that are encoded with urlencode in name cannot be exported in GUI
bugs.conditions: Policies has characters that are encoded with urlencode in name
bugs.impact: Policy cannot be exported in GUI
bugs.workaround: Most policies can be cloned, and during clone user can select name without special characters. Then cloned policy can be exported.
bugs.fix: All policies can be exported in GUI

bugs.title: Incorrect parameter created for names with non-ASCII characters in non-UTF8 policies
bugs.symptoms: An incorrect parameter is created for names with non-ASCII characters, e.g., a parameter with Chinese characters in the name in a BIG-IP encoding policy.
bugs.conditions: Non-UTF8 policy parameters created using the GUI.
bugs.impact: The BIG-IP system does not enforce these parameters, and the list of parameters is not rendered correctly.
bugs.workaround: Create the parameter using REST API.
bugs.fix: Parameters are now created correctly in the GUI for any policy encoding and any characters in the parameter name.

bugs.title: BD sends bad acks to the bd_agent for configuration
bugs.symptoms: The bd_agents stops sending configuration in the middle of startup or a configuration change. The policy maybe incomplete in the bd causing a wrong enforcement.
bugs.conditions: This is a rare issue and the exact conditions that trigger it are unknown.
bugs.impact: Bd_agent hangs or restarts which may cause a complete asm restart (and failover). A partial policy may exist in bd causing improper enforcement.
bugs.workaround: Export and import the policy in case the policy is enforced incorrectly and un-assigning / re-assigning does not help.
bugs.fix: Fixed inconsistency scenario between bd and bd_agent.

bugs.title: Non-ASCII static parameter values are garbled when created via REST in non-UTF-8 policy
bugs.symptoms: Non-ASCII parameter static values are garbled when created in a non-UTF-8 policy using REST.
bugs.conditions: -- The policy is configured for an encoding other than UTF-8. -- Attempting to create non-ASCII parameter static values using REST.
bugs.impact: Parameter static values containing non-ASCII characters are garbled when created using REST.
bugs.workaround: Use UTF-8.
bugs.fix: This release supports REST access in non-UTF-8 policies.

bugs.title: BIG-IP VE deployed on cloud provider may be unable to reach metadata services with static management interface config
bugs.symptoms: After rebooting BIG-IP Virtual Edition (VE) deployed on a cloud provider, the instance enters LICENSE INOPERATIVE state. Errors similar to one below are seen in an LTM log: err chmand[4770]: Curl request to metadata service failed with error(7): 'Couldn't connect to server'.
bugs.conditions: - Static management IP address configuration. - Instance is restarted.
bugs.impact: Instance is not operational after restart.
bugs.workaround: After instance is fully booted, reload the license with 'reloadlic'.
bugs.fix: In case of 1 NIC with static route, issuing "bigstart restart mcpd" will not be enough to bring system to the licensed state, issue "reboot" instead.

bugs.title: LTM global SNAT sets TTL to 255 on egress.
bugs.symptoms: When using the global SNAT feature on LTM, IPv4 TTL/IPv6 Hop-Limit values may be erroneously set to 255/64 on egress.
bugs.conditions: Traffic is handled by global SNAT.
bugs.impact: TTL on egress is set to 255/; Hop-Limit on egress is set to 64.

bugs.title: Improve QUIC rate pacing functionality
bugs.symptoms: QUIC rate pacing becomes dis-functional under some conditions.
bugs.conditions: - QUIC rate pacing is in use. - Packet size becomes slightly larger than available rate pacing bytes.
bugs.impact: QUIC rate pacing becomes noneffective which leads to sending data more bursty.
bugs.fix: QUIC rate pacing does not become dis-functional under some conditions anymore.

bugs.title: Improve QUIC goodput for lossy links
bugs.symptoms: QUIC gets lower goodput compared to TCP when tested on lossy links.
bugs.conditions: The tested links are lossy (e.g, 0.1% loss probability).
bugs.impact: QUIC completes the data transfer in longer time.
bugs.fix: QUIC achieves similar or better goodput compared to TCP on lossy links.

bugs.title: 'SNMPD' no longer shows up in the list of daemons on the high availability (HA) Fail-safe GUI page
bugs.symptoms: The SNMPD daemon no longer shows up in the list of daemons on the high availability (HA) Fail-safe GUI page.
bugs.conditions: Viewing the page at: System :: High Availability : Fail-safe : System
bugs.impact: Unable to configure the high availability (HA) settings for the snmpd high availability (HA) daemon through the GUI.
bugs.workaround: Use TMSH to modify the snmpd high availability (HA) settings.

bugs.title: Running service --status-all hangs on db5 errror
bugs.symptoms: Whenever service --status-all command is given on the BIG-IP system, it hangs with the following error. -- error: db5 error(-30969) from dbenv->open: BDB0091 DB_VERSION_MISMATCH: Database environment version mismatch -- error: cannot open Packages index using db5 - (-30969) -- error: cannot open Packages database in /shared/lib/rpm -- error: db5 error(-30969) from dbenv->open: BDB0091 DB_VERSION_MISMATCH: Database environment version mismatch -- error: cannot open Packages database in /shared/lib/rpm -- package f5optics is not installed
bugs.conditions: Running the service --status-all command.
bugs.impact: Command hangs, which prevents seeing the entire service status.

bugs.title: Under certain conditions, 'load sys config verify file /config/bigip.conf' may result in a 'folder does not exist' error
bugs.symptoms: TMSH error example: Configuration error: Can't associate ASM device sync (/Common/testsync/staging.example.com) folder does not exist
bugs.conditions: The conditions under which this occurs are unknown.
bugs.impact: Load of config file fails with an error that the folder does not exist.
bugs.workaround: Use 'tmsh load sys config verify', without specifying a specific file.

bugs.title: LTM database monitor may hang when monitored DB server goes down
bugs.symptoms: When multiple database servers are monitored by LTM database (MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) monitors and one database server goes down (such by stopping the database server process), a deadlock may occur in the LTM database monitor daemon (DBDaemon) which causes an interruption in monitoring of other database servers. When this occurs, one database server going down may cause all monitored database servers to be marked Down for several minutes until the blocking operation times out and normal monitoring can resume.
bugs.conditions: This may occur when: 1. Running a version of BIG-IP or an Engineering Hotfix which contains fixes for bugs ID769309 and ID775901. 2. Stopping a monitored database server process (such as by halting the database service).
bugs.impact: Monitoring of database servers may be interrupted for up to several minutes, causing monitored database servers to be marked Down. This may persist for several minutes until the blocking operation times out, the backlog of blocked DB monitor threads are processed to completion, and normal DB monitoring resumes.
bugs.workaround: You can prevent this issue from occurring by using a different LTM monitor type (such as a TCP monitor or external monitor) to monitor the database servers.

bugs.title: Unable to establish active FTP connection with custom FTP filter
bugs.symptoms: Unable to establish active FTP connection with custom FTP filter.
bugs.conditions: All of the following conditions are true: -- Virtual server using custom FTP filter. -- FTP filter has port (port used for data channel) set to 0 (zero). -- Virtual server has source-port set to preserve-strict. -- Using active FTP through the virtual server.
bugs.impact: -- The active FTP data channel is reset. -- Commands that require data channel in active mode fail.
bugs.workaround: -- Change source-port to change or preserve. -- Set port on FTP filter to be used for data channel. -- Use passive FTP.

bugs.title: Database monitor DBDaemon debug logging not enabled consistently
bugs.symptoms: Debug logging in the database monitor daemon (DBDaemon) for database health monitors (Microsoft SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) is enabled on a per-monitor basis.
