bugs.title: The BIG-IP system may initially fail to resolve some DNS queries
bugs.symptoms: Configurations that use a 'DNS Cache' or 'Network DNS Resolver' are affected by an issue whereby the system may initially fail to resolve some DNS queries. Subsequent queries for the same domain name, however, work as expected. Only some domain names are affected.
bugs.conditions: - The BIG-IP system is configured with either a DNS Cache or Network DNS Resolver. - The cache is still empty in regard to the domain name being resolved (for example, TMM has just started). - The cache configuration specifies 'Use IPv6' (the default) but the system has no IPv6 default route.
bugs.impact: Initial DNS resolution of some domain names fails. Regardless of whether this happens via a DNS cache or Network DNS Resolver, the failure is returned to the client. In the case of a DNS Cache, the client may just be returned with no record. In the case of a Network DNS Resolver, the failure will depend on the feature using the resolver. For instance, SWG, SSL Orchestrator, or the HTTP Explicit Forward Proxy, in general, are examples of features that rely on a Network DNS Resolver. In this case, the client's browser will fail to connect to the requested destination, and the client will be shown a proxy error.
bugs.workaround: Disable 'Use IPv6' in the affected DNS Cache or Network DNS Resolver. 1a. Go to DNS :: Caches :: Cache list. OR 1b. Go to Network :: DNS Resolvers :: DNS Resolver list. 2. Select the item you want to update in the list. 3. Uncheck 'Use IPv6' 4, Select Update. You can keep the object in this state (with no consequences) until you define an IPv6 default route on the system, and you wish for the system to also use IPv6 to connect to Internet name-servers.
bugs.fix: DNS resolution works as expected, with domains resolving the first time they are queried.

bugs.title: Improvement in handling accelerated TLS traffic
bugs.symptoms: Rare aborted TLS connections.
bugs.impact: Certain rare traffic patterns may cause TMM to abort some accelerated TLS connections.
bugs.fix: The aborted connections will no longer be aborted and will complete normally.

bugs.title: TMM may crash when handling 'DNS Cache' or 'Network DNS Resolver' traffic
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes, dumps a core file, and restarts.
bugs.conditions: -- The configuration includes one or more 'DNS Cache' or 'Network DNS Resolver' objects. -- The DNS Cache or Network DNS Resolver objects receive traffic.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts. A redundant unit will fail over.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer crashes when 'DNS Cache' or 'Network DNS Resolver' objects handle traffic.

bugs.title: Arp requests not resolved for snatpool members when primary blade goes offline
bugs.symptoms: Arp requests not resolved for snatpool members and traffic does not go through when the primary blade becomes offline.
bugs.conditions: -- VIPRION platforms serving as AAA and Diameter virtual server to load-balance. -- route-domain configured other than 0. -- Radius authentication pool and snatpool are configured. -- Primary blade goes offline and new Primary is not elected.
bugs.impact: Traffic failure when primary became offline.
bugs.workaround: Disable primary blade which is offline.

bugs.title: The responses for EDNS/Non-EDNS UDP queries against DNS Express zone were truncated
bugs.symptoms: -- EDNS UDP query against DNS Express zone for larger responses get truncated. --Non-EDNS query against DNS Express zone was truncated completely including the ANSWER section.
bugs.conditions: --Configure UDP and TCP listeners with DNS profile that has DNSX enabled and BIND disabled. --Perform EDNS/Non-EDNS queries against the listener.
bugs.impact: No proper DNS responses.
bugs.workaround: Perform either of the following workarounds: 1. Enable DNS Express minimal-responses using DB key dnsexpress.minimalresponse. For detailed information, please refer to K41004650: Enable DNS Express minimal-responses for the Authority and Additional Records sections 2. Disable truncating UDP DNS response using DB key dns.udptruncate. For detailed information, please refer to K91537308: Overview of the truncating rule when DNS response size is over 512 Bytes

bugs.title: ASM blocks WebSocket frames with signature matched but Transparent policy
bugs.symptoms: WebSocket frames receive a close frame
bugs.conditions: -- ASM provisioned -- ASM policy attached to a virtual server -- WebSocket profile attached to a virtual server -- ASM policy transparent mode enabled
bugs.impact: WebSocket frame blocked in transparent mode
bugs.workaround: Change signatures blocking settings to Learn = Yes, Alarm = Yes, Block = No
bugs.fix: WebSocket frame blocking condition now takes into account global transparent mode setting.

bugs.title: Unable to retrieve DNS link statistics via SNMP OID gtmLinkStatRate
bugs.symptoms: Unable to retrieve link statistics via SNMP OID gtmLinkStatRate config # snmpwalk -c public localhost F5-BIGIP-GLOBAL-MIB::gtmLinkStatRate F5-BIGIP-GLOBAL-MIB::gtmLinkStatRate = No Such Object available on this agent at this OID
bugs.conditions: A BIG-IP DNS/LC system configured with link objects. Try to do an snmpwalk for F5-BIGIP-GLOBAL-MIB::gtmLinkStatRate which is not successful.
bugs.impact: BIG-IP DNS system link statistics cannot be retrieved via SNMP.
bugs.workaround: No workaround.

bugs.title: Excessive resource consumption while processing OSCP requests via APM
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, OSCP requests may consume excessive resources.
bugs.conditions: - SSL profile enabled - OSCP verification enabled
bugs.impact: Excessive resource consumption, potentially leading to an out-of-memory condition.
bugs.fix: OSCP requests now consume resources as expected.

bugs.title: Results of POLICY::names and POLICY::rules commands may be incorrect
bugs.symptoms: When a traffic policy is applied to a virtual server, the iRule commands POLICY::names and POLICY::rules returns incorrect results.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP has a virtual server with one or more traffic policies having more than one rule. -- An iRule with POLICY::names and/or POLICY::rules is applied to virtual server to run on multiple transactions over the same connection.
bugs.impact: Traffic processing may not provide expected results.
bugs.fix: POLICY::names and POLICY::rules provide atomic results per transaction going over a same connection.

bugs.title: iRule POLICY command fails in server-side events
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP provides an iRule command POLICY to retrieve information on or manipulate an LTM policy attached to a virtual. This command fails when it is used in server-side event like HTTP_RESPONSE.
bugs.conditions: -- Configure a virtual server with one or more LTM policies. -- The virtual server has an iRule with a POLICY command executed on a server side (e.g. HTTP_RESPONSE).
bugs.impact: A command returns an incorrect value and may cause unexpected outcomes in an iRule execution.

bugs.title: Non-ePVA platform shows 'Tcpdump starting DPT providers:ePVA Provider' in /var/log/ltm
bugs.symptoms: Non-ePVA platform shows 'Tcpdump starting DPT providers:ePVA Provider' in /var/log/ltm
bugs.conditions: This message shows always on all platforms.
bugs.impact: No functional impact.
bugs.fix: Does not show this message on non-epva platforms.

bugs.title: FIN from client does not get propagated to server side, if the FIN arrives before server side reaching ESTABLISHED
bugs.symptoms: FIN from client will not be propagated to server side, if the FIN arrives in BIG-IP before the corresponding server side connection reaches ESTABLISHED.
bugs.conditions: - standard virtual server with the default tcp profile - client sends FIN immediately after 3WHS
bugs.impact: These connections remain until the idle timeout is reached.

bugs.title: BD crash while processing JSON content
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, BD may crash while processing JSON content
bugs.conditions: - ASM enabled - JSON content profile enabled
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while BD restarts.

bugs.title: HTTP::retry for a HEAD request fails to create new connection
bugs.symptoms: In case of a HEAD request, BIG-IP fails to set up a new connection to the server with the HTTP::retry iRule.
bugs.conditions: 1.) Basic HTTP profile is configured on BIG-IP 2.) BIG-IP sends the HEAD request to the server and gets error response 3.) iRule with HTTP::retry is configured 4.) The system is using the default (non-debug) TMM version
bugs.impact: BIG-IP might send the retry HEAD request after the connection is closed, more specifically after the server has sent a FIN, the retry is leaked on the network.

bugs.title: REST calls that modify GTM objects as a user other than admin may take longer than expected
bugs.symptoms: After performing a REST call to modify a GTM object, subsequent requests may take longer than expected to complete. Delays of 800-1000ms are possible for a brief time after a GTM object is modified.
bugs.conditions: Modifying a GTM object with a user other than "admin". When a device is part of a GTM sync group.
bugs.impact: Slower than expected REST performance. Scripts that perform a series of modifications and subsequent queries could be heavily impacted.
bugs.workaround: Use the admin account or use transactions.

bugs.title: False positive enforcement of parameters with specific configuration
bugs.symptoms: False positive parameters are being detected in the payload and enforced wrongly.
bugs.conditions: The URL is not defined (also not as wildcard - not defined at all) and the request has a payload.
bugs.impact: False positive enforcement - may lead to wrong violations and wrong blocking of requests.

bugs.title: Request is not logged
bugs.symptoms: A request is not logged in the local and/or remote logs.
bugs.conditions: A request has evasions detected on very large parameters.
bugs.impact: A missing request in the log.

bugs.title: BD crash after ICAP response
bugs.symptoms: BD crash when checking ICAP job after ICAP response
bugs.conditions: BD is used with ICAP feature
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while BD restarts.

bugs.title: Full Sync Requests Caused By Failed Relayed Call to delete_suggestion
bugs.symptoms: When using parent policies with learning enabled in an auto-sync device group, in some use cases deleting an ignored suggestion on a parent policy will cause a full sync to occur. This can cause unexpected delays in configuration being synchronized between peers, and in the event of repeated instances in quick succession could fill the /var partition
bugs.conditions: 1) Device Group with ASM and auto-sync enabled 2) Parent Policies with learning are in use. 3) Ignored Suggestions are deleted on the parent policy after they have 0 suggesting children left.
bugs.impact: ASM configuration requests a full sync which can cause unexpected slowness in config synchronization and may fill the /var partition if done multiple times in quick succession. A full /var partition can lead to bd cores.

bugs.title: BIG-IP may go offline after installing ASU file with insufficient disk space
bugs.symptoms: When installing an ASU file, if there is not enough disk space in /var, the clntcp update file might become corrupted, causing datasyncd to be offline (and thus cause the entire BIG-IP offline)
bugs.conditions: -- ASM/FPS provisioned. -- Installing ASU file. -- Not enough space in /var partition.
bugs.impact: Device goes offline.
bugs.workaround: Delete the update file: tmsh delete security datasync update-file /Common/datasync-global/update-file-clntcap_update_ (auto complete)

bugs.title: New User automatically unlocked when "Automatically enable locked-out users after" is not configured
bugs.symptoms: "Automatically enable locked-out users after" option takes effect even if it is not configured.
bugs.conditions: - There is a locked-out user in the BIG-IP system - The option "Automatically enable locked-out users after" is not selected but there is a value present in it, the value being other than 0
bugs.impact: Locked-out users are automatically enabled to log-in even when the "Automatically enable locked-out user" option is not selected
bugs.workaround: In GUI: Set 'Automatically enable locked-out users after X seconds' duration to 0 if the 'Manually enable locked-out user' feature is enabled. In TMSH: Set db variable password.unlock_time to 0 if systemauth.disablemanualunlock is false.

bugs.title: Description field of a JSON policy overwrites policy templates description
bugs.symptoms: Creating a UTF-8 policy using a template for the first time creates a binary policy the system uses the next time you create a UTF-8 policy with the same template. If the creation occurs via JSON policy import, the description field of the JSON policy overwrites the description from the template, and the next time you create a UTF-8 policy using the same template, the system uses the description from the first JSON policy.
bugs.conditions: Create an initial UTF-8 policy with some template using a JSON policy with a custom description.
bugs.impact: The next time you create a UTF-8 policy with the same template, unless you provide a description, the system uses the one from the initially created JSON policy instead the template.
bugs.workaround: Before creating the second policy, remove the binary file that was created from the first run. For example if the template used was Fundamental: rm -f /ts/install/policy_templates/fundamental.bin
bugs.fix: The binary file now contains the correct description.

bugs.title: The number of native open connections in the SSL profile is higher than expected
bugs.symptoms: The number of native open connections in the SSL profile shows a value that is higher than expected.
bugs.conditions: SSL renegotiation is enabled. Other conditions are unknown.
bugs.impact: The SSL stats are incorrectly reading higher than expected.
bugs.workaround: Disable SSL renegotiation.

bugs.title: The tpm-status-check service shows System Integrity Status: Invalid when Engineering Hotfix installed
bugs.symptoms: Upon booting a BIG-IP hardware system running an Engineering Hotfix version of BIG-IP v14.1.0 or later, messages of the following form may be logged in the LTM log file (/var/log/ltm): err tpm-status[####]: System Integrity Status: Invalid info tpm-status-check[####]: System Integrity Status: Invalid In addition, a message similar to the following may appear on the serial console while the system is booting: [ ###.######] tpm-status-check[####]: Checking System Integrity Status [ ###.######] tpm-status-check[####]: sh: /bin/rpm: Permission denied [ ###.######] tpm-status-check[####]: tpm-status-check: System Integrity Status: Invalid Similar messages appear when viewing the status of the tpm-status-check service via the systemctl utility: # systemctl -l status tpm-status-check.service * tpm-status-check.service - F5 Trusted Platform Module Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/tpm-status-check.service; static; vendor preset: enabled) Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since <...> Main PID: #### (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE) <...> tpm-status-check[####]: Checking System Integrity Status <...> tpm-status-check[####]: sh: /bin/rpm: Permission denied <...> tpm-status[####]: TPM Status Version 15.1.1.0.6.6 <...> tpm-status[####]: TMOS BIG-IP 15.1.1-0.0.6.0 <...> tpm-status[####]: BIOS 0614 v3.10.032.0 <...> tpm-status[####]: BIOS SIRR 2019-05-30_08-46-02 <...> tpm-status-check[####]: tpm-status-check: System Integrity Status: Invalid <...> systemd[1]: tpm-status-check.service: main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE <...> systemd[1]: Unit tpm-status-check.service entered failed state. <...> systemd[1]: tpm-status-check.service failed. However, checking the System Integrity Status using the 'tpm-status' or 'tmsh run sys integrity status-check' command shows 'System Integrity Status: Valid'.
bugs.conditions: This may occur under the following conditions: -- Running BIG-IP v14.1.0 or later. -- Using Engineering Hotfixes containing fixes for the following bugs: - ID893885 (https://cdn.f5.com/product/bugtracker/ID893885.html) - ID946745 (https://cdn.f5.com/product/bugtracker/ID946745.html) -- Using hardware platforms that include a Trusted Platform Module (TPM), including: - BIG-IP i2000, i4000, i5000, i7000, i10000, i11000, i15000 Series appliances - VIPRION B4450 blades
bugs.impact: The tpm-status-check service inaccurately indicates that the System Integrity Status is not Valid. This is incorrect, and conflicts with the accurate System Integrity Status provided by the 'tpm-status' utility and 'tmsh run sys integrity status-check' command.
bugs.workaround: To observe the correct System Integrity Status, do either of the following: -- Use the 'tpm-status' utility. -- Run the command: tmsh run sys integrity status-check
bugs.fix: This incorrect status reporting has been corrected.

bugs.title: Unexpected config loss when modifying protected object
bugs.symptoms: A virtual server configuration is changed unexpectedly.
bugs.conditions: - Create virtual server with two client SSL profiles - Modify same virtual server in Protected Objects panel.
bugs.impact: Virtual servers client SSL profiles are removed if you have more than one profile.
bugs.fix: Virtual server client SSL profiles are no longer removed from the config if the update happens through Protected Objects panel in the GUI.

bugs.title: RADIUS Accounting Stop message fails via layered virtual server
bugs.symptoms: RADIUS Stop messages do not exit the BIG-IP device after a client disconnects.
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP is configured with APM and multiple virtual servers and an iRule.
bugs.impact: RADIUS Accounting Stop is not sent.

bugs.title: Non-EDNS response with RCODE FORMERR are blocked by AFM MARFORM vector.
bugs.symptoms: When a client sends a DNS request to a NON EDNS capable server, the server may send a legitimate response with RCODE FORMERR and no DNS data. The MALFORM DNS vector blocks those requests.
bugs.conditions: -- The client sends a DNS request to NON EDNS capable server -- The server replies with RCODE FORMERR and no DNS data.
bugs.impact: AFM erroneously detects an attack and mitigates it, and the client does not get a responses from the EDNS server
bugs.workaround: Disable DNS MALFORM vector mitigation or put the EDNS server in allow list.

bugs.title: Standby unit shows a high number of total connections after enabling mirroring.
bugs.symptoms: On a high availability (HA) pair of BIG-IPs configured with mirroring enabled, some flows that are killed immediately will cause two flows to be created on the Standby device. The flows on the Standby are short lived, with the only concerning factor being that the stats are climbing much faster than on the Active.
bugs.conditions: -- Mirroring enabled. -- A connection is shut down.
bugs.impact: Incorrect stats on standby. Since the issue only appears when a connection is being shut down, all of the traffic on the active device should have a working mirrored flow on the standby.

bugs.title: Key handle 0 is treated as invalid for NetHSM devices
bugs.symptoms: HTTPS pool members are marked down when they are up.
bugs.conditions: -- SafeNet HSM configured -- HTTPS monitor uses the safenet keys -- The key handle generated by the HSM is 0
bugs.impact: Pool members are marked down because bigd cannot connect to the pool member using the Safenet HSM key.
bugs.workaround: Use in-TMM monitors as an alternative to bigd monitors.

bugs.title: ASM performance drop on the response side
bugs.symptoms: Clients encounter a longer time to respond from the BIG-IP
bugs.conditions: -- One of the following features is enabled: - convictions - csrf - ajax. -- The response is HTML -- The response has many tags
bugs.impact: Slow performance. May lead to a bd crash on specific responses. Traffic disrupted while bd restarts.

bugs.title: Performance issue with data guard
bugs.symptoms: End user clients encounter poor network performance. Due to a correlation with ID 963461 it can lead to a crash.
bugs.conditions: -- The server response is compressed. -- Data guard is enabled.
bugs.impact: Slow response time.
bugs.workaround: -- Disable data guard or block the data instead of masking it. -- Force server sending uncompressed response using an iRule: when HTTP_REQUEST { HTTP::header remove Accept-Encoding }

bugs.title: Net-snmp5.8 crash
bugs.symptoms: Snmpd crashes.
bugs.conditions: This does not always occur, but it may occur after a subagent (bgpd) is disconnected.
bugs.impact: Snmpd crashes.

bugs.title: Appliance mode hardening
bugs.symptoms: Appliance mode license restrictions do not follow current best practices.
bugs.conditions: - Appliance-mode license - Authenticated administrative user - AGC provisioned
bugs.impact: Appliance mode does not follow current best practices.
bugs.fix: Appliance mode now follows current best practices.

bugs.title: Proxy ssl server response not forwarded
bugs.symptoms: A server response may not be forwarded after TLS renegotiation.
bugs.conditions: -- Proxy ssl enabled -- A server renegotiation occurs
bugs.impact: Server response may not be not forwarded
bugs.fix: Proxy ssl will now forward server response after renegotiation

bugs.title: HTTP/2 virtual server with translate-disable can core tmm
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes while passing HTTP/2 traffic
bugs.conditions: -- HTTP/2 virtual server -- Port and address translation disabled
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Do not configure an HTTP/2 virtual server with translate-disable
bugs.fix: Tmm does not crash anymore.

bugs.title: Remote Desktop app fails to launch from webtop when Per-request Policy is added to virtual server.
bugs.symptoms: Users are unable to launch the Remote Desktop app from the webtop.
bugs.conditions: -- APM is licensed and provisioned. -- Remote Desktop is configured and attached to the per-session policy. -- A per-request policy is attached to the virtual server.
bugs.impact: Users cannot access the remote desktop application.
bugs.workaround: Don't attach the per-request policy to the virtual server if it's not required.
bugs.fix: Remote Desktop app no longer fails to launch from the webtop when per-request policy is added to virtual server.

bugs.title: Error: Exception response while loading properties from server
bugs.symptoms: The General Customization interface for Endpoint Security in the GUI cannot be used for Access Profile with modern customization due to interface error.
bugs.conditions: -- Access Profile with modern customization -- General Customization interface for Endpoint Security
bugs.impact: You are unable to modify Endpoint Security interface strings

bugs.title: Watchdog restart AVRD when publish interval set to 300
bugs.symptoms: Changing avrd snapshot publisher to 300 after it was 30, causes to avrd reboot.
bugs.conditions: Changing avrd snapshot publisher to 300 after it was 30.
bugs.impact: AVRD gets rebooted when it shouldn't be rebooted
bugs.fix: Added the ability to update thread interval of (watchdog) subscribed thread.

bugs.title: Mcpd cores while processing a query for node statistics when there are thousands of FQDN nodes and pool members.
bugs.symptoms: Mcpd might core and restart if it fails to process a query for all node statistics in less than 5 minutes. There is more then one avenue where node statistics would be queried. The BIG-IP Dashboard for LTM from the GUI is one example.
bugs.conditions: Thousands of FQDN nodes and pools with FQDN pool members and a query for all node statistics.
bugs.impact: Mcpd restarted which will cause services to failover. Traffic and configuration disrupted while mcpd restarts.

bugs.title: ASM reports and enforces username always
bugs.symptoms: When session tracking is enabled and configured to enforce usernames for a specific list of login URLs, the username which arrives in an Authorization header is being enforced even if the request to the URL with the Authorization is not configured at all as a login URL.
bugs.conditions: Session tracking is enabled for login URLs with the Username Threshold set to 1.
bugs.impact: Username from the Authorization appears with status = BLOCK-ALL in the session tracking status list, even though session tracking is not configured for that URL.
bugs.fix: Username from the Authorization not appearing with status = BLOCK-ALL in session tracking status list.

bugs.title: Error '01070734:3: Configuration error: Signing key and signing certificate must be set simultaneously'
bugs.symptoms: The error message '01070734:3: Configuration error: Signing key and signing certificate must be set simultaneously' is unclear. It fails to indicate which rewrite profile has failed validation, and it is not clear that the error has something to do with the validation of rewrite profiles.
bugs.conditions: A BIG-IP Administrator is attempting to configure an invalid rewrite profile (one where the 'signing certificate' and 'signing key' options are not simultaneously set).
bugs.impact: A confusing error message is logged, which makes it difficult to know what to do next.
bugs.fix: The error message has been improved to mention the name of the offending rewrite profile.

bugs.title: Protocol Inspection IM package hardening
bugs.symptoms: Protocol Inspection IM packages do not follow current best practices.
bugs.conditions: - Authenticated administrative user - Protocol Inspection IM packages uploaded to BIG-IP
bugs.impact: Protocol Inspection IM packages do not follow current best practices.
bugs.fix: Protocol Inspection IM packages now follows current best practices.

bugs.title: Multiple session_process_pending_event_callback ERROR: could not send callback messages get logged in the tmm logs.
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system tmm logs show multiple session_process_pending_event_callback errors.
bugs.conditions: If a session is deleted before all the session db callback events are handled, this error can occur while passing normal traffic.
bugs.impact: Numerous error event entries found in the TMM log: notice session_process_pending_event_callback ERROR: could not send callback to 10.10.10.10:460 - 10.10.10.10:80 ERR_NOT_FOUND. There is no impact other than additional log entries.
bugs.fix: Log level has been changed so this issue no longer occurs.

bugs.title: IPS automatic IM download not working as expected
bugs.symptoms: IPS automatic download of IM packages from the F5 Downloads site does not complete as expected. IPS automatic IM download considers the BIG-IP software major and minor version numbers. However, the IPS library is dependent only on major version numbers. The site should constrain IM package download only to those that are compatible with the major version.
bugs.conditions: Auto download of IM package for IPS.
bugs.impact: New minor releases, such as BIG-IP v15.1.1 and later, cannot download IPS IM packages.
bugs.workaround: Manually download the IM package and upload it onto the BIG-IP system.
bugs.fix: Minor releases of BIG-IP software can now automatically download the IM package without issue.

bugs.title: "Non OK return code (400) received from API call" is logged for ProtocolInspection auto update
bugs.symptoms: - Protocol Inspection autoupdate logs "Non OK return code (400) received from API call" when the F5 download site does not contain Protocol Inspection Update container for the BIG-IP version.
bugs.conditions: - Protocol Inspection auto update is enabled. - The BIG-IP version does not have the ProtocolInspection container in the relevant download section on F5 downloads.
bugs.impact: - The error message does not accurately explain the cause of the problem.
bugs.fix: - More context is added to the log message when Protocol Inspection file is not present on the downloads site.

bugs.title: Connector error "CONNECTOR: Invalid external event HUDEVT_SENT in state Init
bugs.symptoms: Error log "CONNECTOR: Invalid external event HUDEVT_SENT in state Init" seen in ltm logs and traffic might stall and ultimately will be abort/reset.
bugs.conditions: SSL Orchestrator with services inserted after Category lookup based on HTTP_CONNECT and client side does not accept (zero window) or SSL Orchestrator send buffer is full for HTTP CONNECT request response.
bugs.impact: Connection will stall and will be aborted / reset.

bugs.title: Improper processing of firewall-rule metadata
bugs.symptoms: The 'mcpd' process may suffer a failure and be restarted.
bugs.conditions: Adding very large firewall-policy rules, whether manually, or from config-sync, or from BIG-IQ.
bugs.impact: -- MCPD crashes, which disrupts both control-plane and data-plane processing while services restart. -- Inability to configure firewall policy.
bugs.workaround: Reduce the number of firewall policy rules.

bugs.title: Live Update - Indication of "Update Available" when there is no available update
bugs.symptoms: Live Update notifies you that an update is available even though there is no available update.
bugs.conditions: The latest file is installed but not present on the system and the second-latest file has an 'error' status
bugs.impact: Live Update erroneously indicates that an update is available.
bugs.workaround: 1. upload the latest file that is not present on the system with scp to '/var/lib/hsqldb/live-update/update-files/' 2. restart 'tomcat' service: > bigstart restart tomcat
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with Live Update notification.

bugs.title: Page might be broken when using Single Page Application and calling onreadystatechange() directly
bugs.symptoms: A web application suddenly misfunctions or does not render.
bugs.conditions: Any one of the the following conditions may apply if the web application calls onreadystatechange() directly: -- ASM Policy with `single_page_application` enabled is attached to a virtual server. -- DoS Profile with `Single Page Application` enabled is attached to a virtual server. -- Bot Defense Profile with `Single Page Application` is attached to a virtual server.
bugs.impact: A console error might appear, and the web page might break.
bugs.workaround: When calling onreadystatechange directly - add the xhr object it is called for (even `this`): onreadystatechange(xhr)
bugs.fix: Handle direct calls for onreadystatechange.

bugs.title: IPsec interface-mode tunnel does not initiate or respond after config change
bugs.symptoms: After reconfiguring an interface-mode IPsec tunnel, the IPsec tunnel may fail to initiate or negotiate as a Responder.
bugs.conditions: -- IPsec interface mode -- Changing the IPsec tunnel configuration
bugs.impact: Remote networks cannot be reached because BIG-IP refuses to negotiate IPsec tunnel.
bugs.workaround: Reboot or restart tmm
bugs.fix: Valid changes to the IPsec tunnel configuration result in the tunnel negotiation happening.

bugs.title: Uncaught RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
bugs.symptoms: Web application does not work and JavaScript error is posted in the browser console: Uncaught RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
bugs.conditions: -- ASM provisioned. -- Bot or DoS application profile attached to a virtual server. -- Single page application (SPA) enabled.
bugs.impact: Web application does not work as expected.
bugs.fix: SPA functionality has been corrected to avoid this issue.

bugs.title: AFM DOS half-open does not handle wildcard virtual servers properly.
bugs.symptoms: AFM DOS half-open vector does not handle wildcard virtual servers properly.
bugs.conditions: -- Wildcard virtual-server. -- AFM DOS half-open vector configured. -- Attacks towards multiple destinations covered by a single virtual-server.
bugs.impact: - Wrong statistics reporting. - Wrong status of syncookie protection. - Unexpected traffic drops.
bugs.workaround: Split wildcard virtual server into a series of /32 virtual servers.

bugs.title: SSL Orchestrator does not send HTTP CONNECT tunnel payload to services
bugs.symptoms: In some cases, when Services in SSL Orchestrator (service-connect agent in per-request policy) is inserted after Category lookup for CONNECT request hostname, the HTTP CONNECT tunnel payload/data is not sent to services.
bugs.conditions: SSL Orchestrator use case and Services are inserted after Category lookup for CONNECT request hostname
bugs.impact: HTTP CONNECT tunnel payload is not sent to services
bugs.fix: HTTP CONNECT tunnel payload is now sent to services.

bugs.title: SELinux permission issues leads to daemon startup failure
bugs.symptoms: SOD daemon keeps restarting and also other daemons including ssh are down. In /var/log/ltm you see permission denied errors: tenant-1 logger[13289]: Re-starting sod tenant-1 err sod[13270]: 01140001:3: Shared mem error: Permission denied. tenant-1 err sod[13270]: 01140035:3: Flock error Permission denied @183. tenant-1 err sod[13270]: 01140001:3: Shared mem error: Permission denied.
bugs.conditions: The selinux context of files under /dev/shm is updated wrongly as system_u:object_r:initrc_state_t:s0 instead of system_u:object_r:tmpfs:s0 during upgrade.
bugs.impact: The functionality of SOD daemon including other daemons such as ssh will not be available.
bugs.workaround: Change the selinux mode to Permissive mode with below command setenforce 0 and give "bigstart restart" to restart all the services.
bugs.fix: Selinux context of files under /dev/shm is updated correctly as system_u:object_r:tmpfs:s0 .

bugs.title: [Regression of ID787881 & ID761032] DNSX fails to sign zone transfer using tsig key after failure
bugs.symptoms: DNSX fails to sign zone transfer using tsig key.
bugs.conditions: A transfer error occurs while DNSX is initializing.
bugs.impact: DNSX zones are not been updated.
bugs.workaround: Re-enter the tsig key secret.

bugs.title: Classification of ftp data-channel traffic is "tcp"
bugs.symptoms: When a classification profile is attached to a virtual server, and ftp traffic is passed through it, the control channel is classified as "tcp.ftp", but the data channel is only classified as "tcp".
bugs.conditions: Classification profile attached to virtual server, ftp traffic being classified.
bugs.impact: Incorrect classification
bugs.workaround: Upgrade to 14.1.0 or later, where the ftp data traffic is classified as "ftp_data"

bugs.title: BIG-IP dashboard downloads unused widgets
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP dashboard page downloads all widgets, even widgets that are not visible on the dashboard.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when viewing the BIG-IP dashboard.
bugs.impact: Slower-than-necessary GUI response, and the dashboard shows higher-than-necessary CPU utilization.

bugs.title: ASM Load hangs after upgrade &start;
bugs.symptoms: ASM upgrade hangs, and you see the following in var/log/ts/asm_start.log: ------------------------- asm_start|DEBUG|Nov 15 07:04:41.751|25365|F5::ConfigSync::restore_active_policies,,Restoring active policy - policy /Common/my_portal (id = 603) ... END OF FILE ... ------------------------- In /var/log/asm: ----------------------------- 2020-11-15T06:01:23+00:00 localhost notice boot_marker : ---===[ HD1.cm6250 - BIG-IP 13.1.3.4 Build 0.255.5 <HD1.cm6250> ]===--- info set_ibdata1_size.pl[20499]: Setting ibdata1 size finished successfully, a new size is: 9216M info tsconfig.pl[24675]: ASM initial configration script launched info tsconfig.pl[24675]: ASM initial configration script finished info asm_start[25365]: ASM config loaded err asm_tables_dump.pl[31430]: gave up waiting for ASM to start, please try again later -----------------------------
bugs.conditions: -- ASM provisioned -- 600 or more security policies -- Performing an upgrade
bugs.impact: ASM post upgrade config load hangs and there are no logs or errors

bugs.title: OSPF duplicate router detection might report false positives
bugs.symptoms: OSPF duplicate router detection might report false positives
bugs.conditions: Router sends LSA that is looped in network and sent back to its origin.
bugs.impact: Cosmetic

bugs.title: SSL filter does not re-initialize when OCSP validator is modified
bugs.symptoms: The client SSL or server SSL profile can specify an OCSP object for client or server certificate status validation. After modifying the DNS resolver of the OCSP object, the new nameserver is never picked up. In other words, an incorrect OCSP responder will be contacted.
bugs.conditions: OCSP object is configured in Client Certificate Constrained Delegation (C3D) client SSL or in server SSL and is later modified.
bugs.impact: The incorrect (or the original) OCSP responder is contacted to get the peer certificate revocation status.
bugs.fix: When an OCSP validator is modified, the system now reloads the SSL profile to pick up the new DNS resolver.

bugs.title: Statistics are not reported to BIG-IQ
bugs.symptoms: After a BIG-IP system is attached to BIG-IQ, there are no statistics reported. The 'avrd' process periodically fails with a core on the BIG-IP system.
bugs.conditions: A BIG-IP system is attached to BIG-IQ.
bugs.impact: No statistics collected.
bugs.fix: The avrd process no longer fails, and statistics are collected as expected.

bugs.title: HSB mitigation is not applied on BDoS signature with stress-based mitigation mode
bugs.symptoms: BDoS signature attacks are mitigated in software rather than via HSB
bugs.conditions: Dynamic or custom signature in stress-based mitigation mode on appliance with HSB support
bugs.impact: More resources loading during DDoS attack
bugs.fix: Correct free spot search with offloading to HSB

bugs.title: Per-request policy authentication becomes unresponsive
bugs.symptoms: Per-request policy execution can appear to be slow during subroutine evaluation, and apmd appears to take a large amount of CPU.
bugs.conditions: The per-request policy is using subroutine to execute an authentication related agent that is dispatched to apmd for completion. These typically involve authentication agents that interact with an external authentication server, such as LDAP, RADIUS, or AD.
bugs.impact: Connectivity may be impaired or lost.
bugs.workaround: Failover the high availability (HA) pair, or restart apmd.

bugs.title: Active/Standby sync process fails to populate table DCC.HSL_DATA_PROFILES on standby machine
bugs.symptoms: DCC.HSL_DATA_PROFILES table on standby machine stay empty after sync process. Error for DB insert failure into table DCC.HSL_DATA_PROFILES thrown in asm_config_server.log.
bugs.conditions: There is no specific condition, the problem occurs rarely.
bugs.impact: Sync process requires an additional ASM restart
bugs.workaround: Restart ASM after sync process finished

bugs.title: When BIG-IP is configured with PingAccess profile, tmm can core when there is an active connection
bugs.symptoms: When BIG-IP is configured with a PingAccess profile and an SSL profile is associated with both the BIG-IP virtual server and a ping access configuration, an active connection to the virtual server may lead to a TMM crash.
bugs.conditions: -- SSL is configured on both the BIG-IP virtual server that contains the ping access profile and ping access configuration. -- Active connection to the BIG-IP virtual server -- Config sync is triggered or "tmsh load sys config" is triggered
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: No workaround.
bugs.fix: Fixed a TMM crash related to ping access.

bugs.title: Displayed 'Route Domain ID' value is confusing if it is set to None
bugs.symptoms: The numeric value of RT_DOMAIN_NONE is 65535. Lsndb displays this value, which is confusing.
bugs.conditions: If the parent route domain is set to "None", lsndb displays 65535.
bugs.impact: No impact on functionality.
bugs.fix: Change while printing value of RT_DOMAIN_NONE(65535) to "None"

bugs.title: IM package file hardening &start;
bugs.symptoms: IM package file uploads do not follow current best practices.
bugs.conditions: - IM package file uploaded to BIG-IP
bugs.impact: IM package file uploads do not follow current best practices.
bugs.fix: IM package file uploads now follow current best practices.

bugs.title: Disruption of mcpd with a segmentation fault during config sync
bugs.symptoms: The mcpd process on the peer device fails with a segfault, restarts and then segfaults again in a loop Numerous messages may be logged in the "daemon" logfile of the following type: emerg logger[2020]: Re-starting mcpd
bugs.conditions: -- High availability (HA) configuration -- A port-and-address list configuration is changed to be only an address list -- A config sync occurs
bugs.impact: Continuous restarts of mcpd process on the peer device.
bugs.workaround: One possible measure for getting the peer-machine "mcpd" out of its failure mode is to command the still-functioning system to push a "full" config sync to the appropriate device group. Doing this twice consecutively may be necessary. # tmsh run /cm config-sync force-full-load-push to-group APPROPRIATE-DEVICE-GROUP

bugs.title: Creating a net packet filter in the GUI does not work for ICMP for IPv6
bugs.symptoms: When using the GUI to create a 'net packet-filter' rule to block ICMP packets, the filter does not block IPv6 packets.
bugs.conditions: -- Using the GUI to create a packet filter rule to block incoming ICMP packets. -- Attempting to block an IPv6 address.
bugs.impact: Packets get through the filter unexpectedly.
bugs.workaround: Modify the packet filter manually using tcpdump syntax. For example, the following syntax is used to block ICMP packets for both IPv4 and IPv6: icmp or icmp6

bugs.title: GENEVE protocol support
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP software does not support the GENEVE protocol.
bugs.conditions: -- AWS Gateway load balancer is in use, which uses the GENEVE protocol
bugs.impact: GENEVE protocol is unsupported.
bugs.fix: BIG-IP software now supports the GENEVE protocol.

bugs.title: BFD down on multi-blade system
bugs.symptoms: After a secondary blade reboots in a multi-blade system, bi-directional forwarding detection (BFD) stops functioning.
bugs.conditions: -- Multi-blade VIPRION environment -- BFD enabled -- A secondary blade reboots
bugs.impact: BFD flaps on the secondary blade that was rebooted. The BFD session flap clears the routes on the peer.

bugs.title: Connection stall happened when the shutdown received before all egress data
bugs.symptoms: If the SSL receives shutdown before receiving all egress data, it will not close the connection until the idle timeout.
bugs.conditions: Shutdown event received by the SSL before all egress is received.
bugs.impact: Connections are not closing until the idle timeout.
bugs.fix: If shutdown arrives before the remaining egress data, the connection might not immediately close.

bugs.title: Tmm memory leak
bugs.symptoms: Tmm leaks memory for DNSSEC requests.
bugs.conditions: NetHSM is configured but disconnected. or Internal FIPS card is configured and tmm receives more DNSSEC requests than the FIPS card is capable of handling.
bugs.impact: Tmm memory utilization increases over time.
bugs.workaround: Connect the netHSM.
bugs.fix: A new DB variable dnssec.fipswaitingqueuecap is introduced to configure the capacity of the FIPS card. You can throttle the incoming DNSSEC requests based on the count of outstanding DNSSEC requests in netHSM/Internal FIPS queue. tmsh modify sys db dnssec.fipswaitingqueuecap value <value> this value sets the capacity per tmm process.

bugs.title: Improper data logged in plaintext
bugs.symptoms: Improper data may be logged when audit forwarding is enabled.
bugs.conditions: Enable TACACS+ authentication with audit forwarding enabled.
bugs.impact: Sensitive data exposure.
bugs.fix: Removed improper data from logging

bugs.title: MCPD cored during config syc when configuration has large numbers of access policies with macros
bugs.symptoms: Mcpd is killed by SOD during config sync. In /var/log/ltm you see this log signature: notice sod[7174]: 01140041:5: Killing /usr/bin/mcpd pid 7180. warning sod[7174]: 01140029:4: HA daemon_heartbeat mcpd fails action is restart.
bugs.conditions: A config sync on a system containing a number of access policies (more than 1800).
bugs.impact: Mcpd consumes excessive time validating the configuration and is killed by the SOD daemon. Traffic disrupted while mcpd restarts.

bugs.title: Cannot create XML profile based on WSDL when wsdl contains empty soap:address – getting error ‘Column 'object_uri' cannot be null’
bugs.symptoms: Perl error returned when saving new XML content profile using wsdl file with empty soap:address node "<soap:address/>".
bugs.conditions: Creating a new content profile using a wsdl file which contains a "<soap:address/>" node which does not have a "location" attribute value. When this content profile is saved, ASM attempts to create an associated URL with no value, which fails validation.
bugs.impact: After trying to save the content profile, you see an error message: "Could not create XML Profile; Error: DBD::mysql::db do failed: Column 'object_uri' cannot be null"
bugs.workaround: Delete the node "<soap:address/>" from the wsdl file

bugs.title: Policy entity search with non-ASCII value filter returns no results in REST/GUI in non-UTF-8 policies
bugs.symptoms: WAF policy entities (such as parameters) are not found when filtering by non-ASCII values in REST/GUI in non-UTF-8 policies.
bugs.conditions: WAF policy is defined as non-UTF-8, and a non-ASCII value is used in an entity search filter.
bugs.impact: No results are returned.
bugs.fix: Non-ASCII WAF policy entities are returned in a filtered search in REST/GUI in non-UTF-8 policies.

bugs.title: NAT translation failures while using SP-DAG in a multi-blade chassis
bugs.symptoms: NAT translation fails
bugs.conditions: -- VIPRION multi-blade chassis -- Configure AFM NAT/CGNAT and attach the AFM NAT Policy / lsnpool to the virtual server -- Configure sp-dag on the vlan's
bugs.impact: Traffic failure, performance degraded
bugs.workaround: Change the DB variable tm.lsn.retries to the maximum value of 4096
bugs.fix: Increase the number of attempts in selecting local translation IP (an IP when used makes the return packet to land on the same TMM where the NAT selection is happening). This can be controlled with DB variable tm.lsn.retries. The actual attempts is 16 times the value set in this db variable.

bugs.title: Client connection flow is aborted when data is received by generic msg filter over sctp transport in BIG-IP

bugs.impact: BIG-IP is unable to process the traffic received over the SCTP transport for MRF generic message routing

bugs.title: Rate Shaping stops TCP retransmission
bugs.symptoms: When rate shaping is applied to a virtual server, the BIG-IP system does not retransmit unacknowledged data segments, even when the BIG-IP system receives a duplicate ACK.
bugs.conditions: This issue occurs when both of the following conditions are met: -- Virtual server configured with a rate shaping. -- Standard type of virtual server.
bugs.impact: The BIG-IP system does not retransmit unacknowledged data segments.

bugs.title: Multiple FQDN ephemeral nodes not deleted upon deleting FQDN template node
bugs.symptoms: If an FQDN template node is configured with "autopopulate enabled" and the FQDN name resolves to multiple IP addresses, multiple FQDN ephemeral nodes will be created. If the FQDN template node is then deleted, the associated FQDN ephemeral nodes (sharing the same FQDN name) will not be deleted as expected.
bugs.conditions: This may occur under the following conditions: -- An FQDN template node is configured with "autopopulate enabled" -- The configured DNS server resolves the FQDN name to multiple IP addresses -- You are running an Affected Version of BIG-IP, or an Engineering Hotfix based on a non-Affected Version of BIG-IP which contains a fix for ID 722230 This issue does not occur if only one FQDN ephemeral node is created for the associated FQDN template node.
bugs.impact: Unused FQDN ephemeral nodes may remain in the active configuration. -- Since is it not possible to delete an FQDN template node if there are any FQDN template pool members referring to that node, it is not possible for any FQDN ephemeral pool members to remain when the steps that lead to this issue occur. -- Since traffic can only be passed to FQDN ephemeral pool members, the existence of the unused FQDN ephemeral nodes does not lead to traffic being passed to such nodes.
bugs.workaround: It is possible to work around this issue by one of the following methods: -- Manually deleting the remaining FQDN ephemeral nodes using the "tmsh" command-line interface (CLI) (Note that this is normally not possible. It is possible to manually delete an FQDN ephemeral node only if the corresponding FQDN template node no longer exists.) -- Restarting BIG-IP (for example, using the command "bigstart restart")

bugs.title: In SSL forward proxy when the signing CA cert and end-entity cert has a different signature algorithm, the SSL connection may fail
bugs.symptoms: In SSL forward proxy, the client side handshake may fail with the message: fwdp lookup error.
bugs.conditions: The handshake failure occurs when the certificate chain consists of different key types. For example, the following cert chain may fail the handshake: root CA (rsa) --> intermediate CA1 (rsa) --> intermediate CA2 (ec) --> end-entity cert (ec) The signing CA which is intermediate CA2 has a key of EC type, but cert is signed by RSA signature. The end-entity cert has a key of EC type, but cert is signed by ECDSA. In this case, the signer cert has different signature from that of the end-entity cert.
bugs.impact: SSL forward proxy handshake fails.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with SSL forward handshakes.

bugs.title: When all of the interfaces in the trunk are brought up, Gratuitous ARP is not being sent out.
bugs.symptoms: Gratuitous ARP (GARP) messages are dropped at the time of sending GARP because the number of links up in the trunk is 0 (which returns "error 18" ... ERR_NOT_FOUND)
bugs.conditions: -- Two BIG-IP systems with switchless configuration, such as i2xxx and i4xxx. -- Bring down and up the interfaces at the same time in the trunk.
bugs.impact: Neighboring device arp table is not updated about the BIG-IP interface status, because no gratuitous ARP message is sent out.

bugs.title: TMM may leak memory early during its startup process, and may continue to do so indefinitely.
bugs.symptoms: TMM leaks memory in the packet and xdata components. The aggressiveness of the leak depends on how much traffic TMM receives from the Linux host subsystem.
bugs.conditions: - A BIG-IP system running more than 1 TMM instance. - Early during its startup process, TMM begins receiving traffic from the Linux host subsystem destined to the network (e.g., remote syslog traffic routed to its destination through TMM). - Depending on the system's configuration, TMM attempts to set up flow forwarding for the aforementioned traffic. This may happen, for instance, if the egress VLAN is configured for 'cmp-hash src-ip'. - TMM hasn't fully completed its startup process yet.
bugs.impact: TMM leaks memory. If the flow set up during early TMM startup continues to receive a constant stream of new packets, then the flow may live on indefinitely, and TMM may continue to leak memory indefinitely. In the example of remote syslog traffic, this could happen, for instance, if the box keeps logging messages at a sustained rate. Eventually, TMM may be unable to allocate any more memory and crash. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: You can work around this issue by ensuring that TMM does not receive any traffic from the Linux host subsystem for forwarding during early startup. In the example of remote syslog destinations, you could specify the management IP address of the system as the source IP address for the traffic, thus forcing the traffic out of the management port instead of TMM. This implies the management port has a suitable working route to the destination.

bugs.impact: HTTP responses that should be delivered to the client by the proxy are not being sent out.

bugs.symptoms: System reports error for the modify command for Wide IP. 01b60021:3: Last resort pool type not specified for Wide IP 9084.example.com of type A.

bugs.title: HA failover connections via the management address do not work on vCMP guests running on VIPRION
bugs.symptoms: A high availability (HA) failover connection using the management IP addresses does not work on vCMP guests running on a VIPRION. BIG-IP instances running directly on hardware, on Virtual Edition, and as vCMP guests running on an appliance are unaffected. HA failover connections using self IPs are unaffected.
bugs.conditions: -- vCMP guest running on a VIPRION -- HA failover connection using the management IP addresses (unicast and/or multicast)
bugs.impact: Failover state determination over the management port is permanently down.
bugs.workaround: While self IP-based HA failover connections are not affected by this issue, F5 recommends configuring failover connections over both management IPs and self IPs (as detailed in K37361453: Configuring network failover for redundant VIPRION systems :: https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K37361453). To mitigate this issue, run the following command on each blade of every guest: touch /var/run/chmand.pid The workaround does not survive a reboot, so a more permanent workaround is to edit the file /config/startup and add a line to touch /var/run/chmand.pid. Add this line to the end of /config/startup: (sleep 120; touch /var/run/chmand.pid) & Note: The sleep time of 120 seconds should be tested as it depends on how quickly or slowly the Guest starts up, so the appropriate value for one system may differ from another system. Alternatively, You can use instructions in K11948: Configuring the BIG-IP system to run commands or scripts upon system startup :: https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K11948 to issue commands at system startup after verification if mcpd is up and ready, e.g.: #!/bin/bash source /usr/lib/bigstart/bigip-ready-functions wait_bigip_ready # Customized startup command(s) can be added below this line. touch /var/run/chmand.pid # Customized startup command(s) should end above this line.

bugs.conditions: DOS vector configuration change
bugs.impact: Memory corruption

bugs.title: A DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver) returns SERVFAIL to some queries.
bugs.symptoms: - A DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver) returns SERVFAIL responses to clients, despite the BIG-IP system receiving a good (albeit delayed) response from upstream servers. - When this happens, the BIG-IP system rejects the responses from the upstream servers with ICMP errors (Destination unreachable - Port unreachable). - If the db key dnscacheresolver.loglevel is set to debug5, the following error message is visible in the /var/log/ltm file when this issue occurs: debug tmm[13147]: DNScache: request example.com. has exceeded the maximum number of glue fetches 17 to a single delegation point - If a Network DNS Resolver is used with an HTTP Explicit Proxy profile, the symptoms can appear as "503 Service Unavailable" responses to clients due to DNS lookup failure.
bugs.conditions: This issue occurs when the following conditions are met: - A DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver) is in use on the BIG-IP system. - The aforementioned object is configured with a forward-zone that uses multiple servers to perform resolutions. - The RTT of the servers fluctuates. For example, the servers are generally fast to reply for most domains, but take extra time to reply for a given domain. - 'Randomize Query Character Case' is enabled in the DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver). - If the requests for the domain take a long time to resolve, BIG-IP may reply with SERVFAIL.
bugs.impact: Clients of the BIG-IP DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver) are not returned an answer. As a result, application failures may occur.
bugs.workaround: You can work around this issue by changing 'Randomize Query Character Case' to 'No' in the DNS Cache (or Network DNS Resolver) settings.
bugs.fix: The infra-cache-min-rtt can now have a setting of unbound which sets the minimum RTT with upstream servers for both net resolver and cache resolver. Increase this value if using forwarders needing more time to do recursive name resolution. The default value is 50ms.
bugs.behavior: The infra-cache-min-rtt can now have a setting of unbound which sets the minimum RTT with upstream servers for both net resolver and cache resolver. Increase this value if using forwarders needing more time to do recursive name resolution. The default value is 50ms.

In /var/log/daemon.log you see the following log message: logger: Re-starting lind In /var/log/ltm you see the following log message? err lind[<pid>]: 013c0004:3: Fatal error: block id new probe failed - device file:/dev/cdrom The SSH CLI repeats " Emergency Logger: restarting lind"
bugs.conditions: Unknown
