bugs.title: DBDaemon restarts unexpectedly and/or fails to restart under heavy load
bugs.symptoms: While under heavy load, the Database monitor daemon (DBDaemon) may: - Restart for no apparent reason - Restart repeatedly in rapid succession - Log the following error while attempting to restart: java.net.BindException: Address already in use (Bind failed) - Fail to start (remain down) after several attempts, leaving database monitors disabled and marking monitored resources Down.
bugs.conditions: - One or more active GTM and/or LTM database monitors are configured with short probe-timeout, interval and timeout values (for example, 2, 5, or 16 respectively). - A large number (for example, 2,000) of GTM and/or LTM database monitor instances (combinations of above monitor and pool member) are configured. - Active GTM and/or LTM database monitors are configured with debug yes and/or count 0.
bugs.impact: The DBDaemon restarts for no apparent reason. The DBDaemon fails to start (remain down) after several attempts, leaving database monitors disabled and marking monitored resources Down.
bugs.workaround: The conditions that are suspected to cause these symptoms include effects of ID1025089. This issue has not been confirmed to occur on BIG-IP versions which include a fix for ID1025089. On other versions, measures to prevent or reduce occurrences of ID1025089 (by reducing database monitor workload) are expected to also prevent or reduce occurrences of these symptoms. If the DBDaemon fails to restart, the following steps may allow DBDaemon to restart successfully upon the next database monitor probe: -- Check for a running instance of DBDaemon with the following command: ps ax | grep -v grep | grep DBDaemon -- If DBDaemon is running, this command will return a set of parameters including the numerical process ID (PID) at the beginning of the line and a command line that begins with "/usr/lib/jvm/jre/bin/java" and includes the parameter "com.f5.eav.DBDaemon", such as: 24943 ? Ssl 46:49 /usr/lib/jvm/jre/bin/java -cp /usr/lib/jvm/jre/lib/rt.jar:/usr/lib/jvm/jre/lib/charsets.jar:/usr/share/monitors/postgresql-jdbc.jar:/usr/share/monitors/DB_monitor.jar:/usr/share/monitors/log4j.jar:/usr/share/monitors/mssql-jdbc.jar:/usr/share/monitors/mysql-connector-java.jar:/usr/share/monitors/ojdbc6.jar -Xmx512m -Xms64m -XX:-UseLargePages -DLogFilePath=/var/log/DBDaemon-0.log com.f5.eav.DBDaemon 1521 24943 0 -- If a running DBDaemon process is identified, use the "kill" command to terminate the running DBDaemon process: kill # (where # is the DBDaemon PID from the above "ps" command) -- Repeat the above "ps" command to confirm that the DBDaemon process has been terminated. If a new DBDaemon process has not been started (with a different PID), proceed to the next steps. -- Check the /var/run directory for the presence of any files with names beginning with "DBDaemon", such as: /var/run/DBDaemon-0.lock /var/run/DBDaemon-0.pid /var/run/DBDaemon-0.start.lock Note: The numeric value in the above example filenames corresponds to the Route Domain of pool members monitored by database monitors. If the database monitors are only applied to pool members in the default route domain (RD 0), that value will be "0" as seen above. If database monitors are applied to pool members in a non-default route domain (RD 7, for example), the numeric value will correspond to that route domain, such as: /var/run/DBDaemon-7.lock /var/run/DBDaemon-7.pid /var/run/DBDaemon-7.start.lock -- If no DBDaemon process is running, delete any /var/run/DBDaemon* files. It is especially important to delete: /var/run/DBDaemon-#.start.lock (indicates DBDaemon restart is in progress and that no further restart actions should be attempted) /var/run/DBDaemon-#.pid (indicates current DBDaemon PID) -- If the above actions do not result in DBDaemon restarting upon the next database monitor ping, then a complete BIG-IP restart will likely be required to recover from unknown conditions within the Java subsystem that may prevent successful DBDaemon operation: bigstart restart or: reboot

bugs.title: BIG-IP in non-default route domain cannot reach directly connected network
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system is unable to ping any IP addresses other than its own Self IPs, except if the IP is configured in the default route domain (RD 0).
bugs.conditions: This can occur when an IP address is configured in the non-default route domain using the same subnet for two different connected BIG-IP systems.
bugs.impact: Ping does not work in the non-default route domain.
bugs.workaround: bigstart restart mcpd OR Reboot Big IP

bugs.title: iRule 'virtual' command does not work for connections over virtual-wire.
bugs.symptoms: iRule 'virtual' command does not work for connections over virtual-wire.
bugs.conditions: - Connection over a virtual-wire. - Redirecting traffic to another virtual-server (for example, using an iRule 'virtual' command)
bugs.impact: Connection stalls on the first virtual-server and never completes.

bugs.title: Disabled "Illegal Base64 value" violation is detect for staged base64 parameter with attack signature in value
bugs.symptoms: An "Illegal Base64 value" violation will be reported for a staged parameter even though Alarm/Blocking/Learning is disabled for this violation.
bugs.conditions: - A parameter has to be set to staging mode with base64 decoding. - The Alarm/Blocking/Learning flags has to be disabled for the violation "Illegal Base64 value". - The incoming request has to have the defined parameter in QS with an attack signature that is not base64 encoded in the parameter value.
bugs.impact: The violation "Illegal Base64 value" is reported.
bugs.fix: The violation "Illegal Base64 value" is not reported if Alarm/Blocking/Learning flags are disabled.

bugs.title: MCPD restart on secondary blade during hot-swap of another blade
bugs.symptoms: In rare instances, inserting a new blade into a VIPRION system can trigger a config error on another secondary blade due to attempting to delete the old blade's physical disk while it is still "in use": err mcpd[7965]: 01070265:3: The physical disk (S3F3NX0J902788) cannot be deleted because it is in use by a disk bay (1). err mcpd[7965]: 01070734:3: Configuration error: Configuration from primary failed validation: 01070265:3: The physical disk (S3F3NX0J902788) cannot be deleted because This causes MCPD to restart on the secondary blade due to the config error.
bugs.conditions: -- VIPRION system with at least 3 blades -- Remove a blade and replace it with a different one
bugs.impact: -- MCPD restarts on the secondary blade other than the blade that was replaced. The config error triggering this is due to an issue with the cluster syncing process between blades; however, the config issue is temporary, and should be resolved after mcpd restarts on the secondary blade.

bugs.title: CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT iRule event is not triggered for TLS1.3 when the client sends an empty certificate response
bugs.symptoms: When an SSL client connects to the BIG-IP system using TLS 1.3 and sends an empty certificate, the CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT iRule event is not triggered.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server configured on BIG-IP with SSL and iRule added -- Client authentication for client certificates is set to "request" -- iRule relying on CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT -- A client connects to BIG-IP using TLSv1.3 protocol without a certificate(empty certificate)
bugs.impact: CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT irules aren't triggered.
bugs.fix: CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT iRules are now triggered when an SSL client connects to BIG-IP with TLS1.3 and sends an empty certificate message.
bugs.behavior: CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT iRules are now triggered when an SSL client connects to BIG-IP with TLS1.3 and sends an empty certificate message.

bugs.title: PEM intra-session mirroring can lead to a crash
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes while passing PEM traffic
bugs.conditions: -- PEM mirroring enabled and passing traffic
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: Logout error code for modern customization
bugs.symptoms: Empty error code %[error_message] in modern style user-logout.js.
bugs.conditions: - Modern customization.
bugs.impact: Unable to access error codes in Modern Customization.

bugs.title: Attempts to create illegal virtual-server may lead to mcpd crash.
bugs.symptoms: Mcpd crashes after the creation of virtual server with incorrect or duplicate configuration is attempted.
bugs.conditions: -- One or more attempts to create a virtual server with an illegal configuration are performed (i.e. attempts to create a virtual server that shares a configuration with an existing virtual server or has an incorrect configuration)
bugs.impact: Mcpd crashes with __GI_abort. Traffic disrupted while mcpd restarts.

bugs.title: OSPF "default-information originate" injects a new link-state advertisement
bugs.symptoms: When configured with "default-information originate", the BIG-IP system might inject a new 0.0.0.0 link-state advertisement when receiving a default route from an OSPF neighbor. This results in two 0.0.0.0 link-state advertisements being advertised from the box.
bugs.conditions: "default-information originate" is configured.
bugs.impact: Duplicate link-state advertisements

bugs.title: Some SIP traffic patterns over TCP may cause resource exhaustion on BIG-IP
bugs.symptoms: Certain SIP messages can cause excessive memory use under when SIP is used over TCP.
bugs.conditions: Using a SIP Profile with a TCP connection
bugs.impact: Tmm memory grows considerably and it may not be freed.
bugs.workaround: No workaround.
bugs.fix: The traffic pattern no longer causes excessive memory usage.

bugs.title: BGP4 SNMP traps are not working.
bugs.symptoms: BGP4 SNMP traps are not working.
bugs.conditions: --Perform any BGP related event and check for snmp traps.
bugs.impact: No BGP SNMP traps.

bugs.title: TMM may behave unexpectedly while processing HTTP traffic
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, TMM may crash while processing HTTP traffic
bugs.conditions: - HTTP profile enabled
bugs.impact: TMM may crashing leading to a traffic interruption and failover event.
bugs.fix: TMM now processes HTTP traffic as expected.

bugs.title: Tmm may core when BFD peers select a new active device.
bugs.symptoms: Tmm cores.
bugs.conditions: -- BFD is in use -- the active/owner BFD device changes
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: iqsyncer will get stuck in a failed state when requesting a commit_id that is not on the target GTM
bugs.symptoms: Too many GTM sync requests are exchanged with the devices and and the config sync may fail sometimes.
bugs.conditions: DNS/GTM licensed devices are configured in a sync Group. The requested commit_id is not present anymore on the target GTM device.
bugs.impact: Sync operations are extremely slow (5-8 minutes for a pool to show up) which may fail sometimes. Excessive network traffic.

bugs.title: AFM does not detect NXDOMAIN attack when DNS cache is activated.
bugs.symptoms: When the DNS cache is activated, the NXDOMAIN DoS vector does not increase for the virtual server context. As a result, NXDOMAIN flood attack is never detected/mitigated at the virtual server context. At the device level, NXDOMAIN stats are incorrect.
bugs.conditions: -- DNS cache is activated -- An NXDOMAIN DoS vector occurs
bugs.impact: NXDOMAIN flood attack is not detected/mitigated at the virtual server context.
bugs.fix: An NXDOMAIN flood attack can be detected and mitigated when DNS cache is enabled.

bugs.title: Access policy is passed without being evaluated if a request is sent while deleting a session
bugs.symptoms: Some APM connections are allowed even though the previous session has timed out.
bugs.conditions: A request arrives at the same time a session teardown occurs due to a timeout
bugs.impact: Client request is allowed without going through the access policy.

bugs.title: Analytics iApp installation fails
bugs.symptoms: By default restjavad.disablerpmtasks value is true. This causes iApp RPM installation to be blocked.
bugs.conditions: Analytics iApp RPM installation
bugs.impact: The RPM installation fails with an error "403, Protocol Exception".
bugs.workaround: Change the restjavad.disablerpmtasks sys db variable to false, and then restart restjavad: tmsh modify sys db restjavad.disablerpmtasks value false To restart restjavad on a VIPRION or multi-bladed vCMP guest or multi-bladed F5OS tenant: clsh tmsh restart sys service restjavad To restart restjavad on an appliance or single-slot vCMP guest or F5OS tenant: tmsh restart sys service restjavad NOTE: This will require a cluster sync for any device groups configured for manual config sync. All updated systems will require a restart of restjavad for the change to take affect. After restjavad restarts on all affected devices, you can perform the iApp installation.
bugs.fix: By default, the sys db variable restjavad.disablerpmtasks should be "false". When appliance mode is enabled, this DB key is forced to "true".

bugs.title: ASM truncates cookies that contain a space in the name and TS cookie as part of cookie list.
bugs.symptoms: HTTP requests are truncated at the cookie and raise a violation.
bugs.conditions: -- Cookie list contains TS cookie -- A cookie contains a space in the name -- TS cookie stripping is enabled (db asm.strip_asm_cookies is set as true)
bugs.impact: Backend server does not receive a complete cookie.
bugs.workaround: Sys db asm.strip_asm_cookies is set as false.

bugs.title: Virtual server responding with ICMP unreachable after using /Common/service
bugs.symptoms: After adding /Common/service profile and removing it from the virtual server, the virtual server starts dropping traffic with ICMP unreachable. This profile is normally only needed in SSLo deployments.
bugs.conditions: /Common/service was attached and removed from a virtual server.
bugs.impact: Traffic is dropped on a virtual server.
bugs.workaround: Restart TMM after making the configuration change.

bugs.title: Failed Configuration Load on Secondary Slot After Device Group Sync
bugs.symptoms: Configuration synchronization fails on secondary slots after the primary slot receives a full sync from a peer in a device group.
bugs.conditions: Bladed chassis devices are configured in an ASM enabled device group
bugs.impact: Incorrect enforcement on secondary slots.
bugs.fix: Synchronization to secondary slots is successful.

bugs.title: Config.auditing.forward.multiple db Variable with value "none" is not working as expected with multiple destination addresses in audit_forwarder.
bugs.symptoms: When config.auditing.forward.multiple db is set to none, BIG-IP should restrict the system to send it to only one destination when multiple destination addresses are configured.
bugs.conditions: When configured to "none", logs are broadcasted to all the destination addresses. Working as "broadcast" mode.
bugs.impact: End user could not use "none" functionality

bugs.title: Peer unit incorrectly shows the pool status as unknown after merging the configuration
bugs.symptoms: The peer unit incorrectly shows the state of pool members as "checking" after merging the configuration from the terminal.
bugs.conditions: This is encountered if 2 or more configurations are specified for an already configured pool on the peer device when using the "tmsh load sys config merge from-terminal" command. For example: Existing pool: ltm pool http_pool { members { member1:http { address 10.82.243.131 monitor http } } } tmsh load sys config merge from-terminal: ltm pool http_pool { members none } ltm pool http_pool { members replace-all-with { member1:http { address 10.82.243.131 monitor http } } }
bugs.impact: Pool members are marked with a state of "Checking".
bugs.workaround: Define all object properties at once (in a single configuration block) instead of multiple times (in multiple configuration blocks) when merging the configuration from the terminal.
bugs.fix: Specifying the configuration for an LTM pool object multiple times when issuing the "tmsh load sys config merge from-terminal" command no longer causes LTM pool members to remain marked with a state of "Checking".

bugs.title: MAX_F5_ERROR_STR macro truncating log messages of size more than 1024 macro truncating log messages of size more than 1024
bugs.symptoms: Truncated log messages are found in /var/log/apm
bugs.conditions: APM session variables that are large (e.g., policy_path, configVariableCatalogSessionKey)
bugs.impact: Some of the APM session variables are missing from /var/log/apm

bugs.title: Config load failure when Trusted CA Bundle is missing and URL is present in the Bundle Manager
bugs.symptoms: 1. BIG-IP will come up but there will be a config load failure. 2. During the upgrade, config sync issues occur.
bugs.conditions: 1. Bundle Manager contains URL( exclude-url/include-url) 2. Trusted CA Bundle is not populated in the Bundle Manager.
bugs.impact: 1. BIG-IP will be in "Inoperative"/"Not All Devices Synced" state
bugs.workaround: Add the Trusted CA Bundle (default ca-bundle.crt) to the Bundle Manager. OR Remove the URLS (both exclude-url and include-url) from the Bundle Manager.

bugs.title: PEM behaviour on receiving CCA with result code: 4012 and FUA on the Gy interface
bugs.symptoms: PEM received Radius Acct req, and sent Both Gx Gy Interface CCR. When receiving Gy CCA Multi-Services-Credit-Control.Result-code:4012 (Diameter_Credit_Limit_Reached),Final-Unit-Action (Redirect) and "Redirect-Server-address" is NOT installed on the PEM session.
bugs.conditions: Session quota information is passed from OCS to PCEF on the Gy interface.
bugs.impact: The action specified in FUI does not get applied to the session. Quota management will not work properly for the session.
bugs.fix: For the case where the PEM receives a CCA with a result code: 4012 and FUI, added changes to install FUA on the session.

bugs.title: Displaying virtual server in drop down box for AAAA record types
bugs.symptoms: No virtual server is displayed in the drop down box for AAAA record types.
bugs.conditions: DNS :: GSLB : Pools : Pool List, then create a new pool of Type: AAAA Viewing the member list and attempting to select a virtual server as a member
bugs.impact: The GUI does not display virtual server records for AAAA record types.

bugs.title: Tmm cored for accessing the pool after the gtm_add or updating topology record
bugs.symptoms: Tmm can crash
bugs.conditions: TMM process fails seconds after the gtm_add command is run or topology records are updated with large number of records.
bugs.impact: On very rare occasions, TMM can crash. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Reduce the number of pools and the number of region records.

bugs.title: Increase number of custom URL category available to PEM
bugs.symptoms: The current implementation allows a maximum of 4000 custom URL categorization categories.
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP with URL categorization feature enabled.
bugs.impact: Users can create only a maximum of 4,000 categories for URL categorization.
bugs.fix: Enhanced the software to allow a maximum of 36,000 custom URL categorization categories.

bugs.title: SIP msg alg zombie flows
bugs.symptoms: The SIP msg alg can disrupt the expiration of a connflow in a way that it stays alive forever.
bugs.conditions: SIPGmsg alg with suspending iRule commands attached.
bugs.impact: Zombie flow, which cannot be expired anymore.
bugs.workaround: Restart TMM.
bugs.fix: Flows are now properly expired.

bugs.title: Unexpected parameter handling in BIG3d
bugs.symptoms: The iQuery listener does not handler certain parameters received correctly.
bugs.conditions: Messages sent to the iQuery listener.
bugs.impact: Unexpected behavior.
bugs.workaround: If the IP addresses or subnets of trusted mesh members are known, then mesh communication security can be improved by creating a network-specific packet filter or by adding management interface firewall rules, depending on the situation.
bugs.fix: Parameters are handled as expected.

bugs.title: TACACS system-auth Accounting setting has no effect when set to send-to-all-servers/send-to-first-server
bugs.symptoms: If the destination address is a single server, then the accounting info is sent to only the particular server. If the destination has multiple servers, then the accounting info is sent to all servers irrespective of the setting "auth tacacs system-auth accounting"
bugs.conditions: Select multiple destination addresses and change the "auth tacacs system-auth accounting" to send-to-first-server, the accounting information is sent to all the destination servers.
bugs.impact: You are unable to use send-to-first server functionality

bugs.title: Parameter set as non-Base64 encoded value is treated as a Base64 encoded value
bugs.symptoms: URL parameters that are configured as 'Base64 Decoding' false are still treated as Base64 Encoded values. This leads to reading incorrect parameter values.
bugs.conditions: Create a parameter, not staged with user-input, alpha-numeric, Base64 values set to False.
bugs.impact: A request gets blocked with an attack signature detected, when it should not be. Negative signature check gets skipped or generates false alarms.
bugs.workaround: Create the parameter with user-input, alpha-numeric and BASE64 values as TRUE
bugs.fix: The system now check to determine whether Base64 is set for the parameter before decoding it.

bugs.title: TCP syncookie-initiated connections may end up unexpectedly IP-fragmenting packets mid-connection
bugs.symptoms: When route metrics are applied by the TCP filter to a connection initiated by a syncookie, TCP sets the effective MSS for packetization, thereafter the egress_mtu will be set as per the route metrics entry, if present. The packets falling between the effective MSS and the lowered egress_mtu end up being unexpectedly IP-fragmented.
bugs.conditions: SYN cookies enabled and activated. A route metrics PMTU entry for the destination address that is smaller than the VLAN's egress MTU.
bugs.impact: Application traffic can fail or see disruption due to unexpected IP fragmentation.
bugs.workaround: Disable syn cookies (Reference: https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K80970950). Alternatively, you can apply a lower static MTU to the interface.

bugs.title: Removing ports from traffic-matching criteria gives unexpected results
bugs.symptoms: After removing a port or a port range from traffic-matching criteria, the port is removed, but another port or port range may also be removed.
bugs.conditions: - Traffic-matching criteria are in use. - Multiple ports/port ranges are in use. - A port or port range is removed.
bugs.impact: Filtering may not work as expected.
bugs.workaround: Restart the TMM after removing the ports.

bugs.title: Unable to SCP files using WinSCP or relative path name
bugs.symptoms: When attempting to retrieve a file with WinSCP, you receive an error dialog and the session will be terminated: "SCP Protocol error: Invalid control record (r; elative addresses not allowed) Copying files from remote side failed." If attempting to transfer a file by relative path with a command line utility the transfer will fail with the message: "relative addresses not allowed"
bugs.conditions: -- Running BIG-IP version with fix for ID 915981 -- Using WinSCP set to use SCP protocol to retrieve files from a BIG-IP system. -- Using a relative remote path to transfer a file with command line scp utility.
bugs.impact: No longer able to use WinSCP to retrieve files such as packet captures, log archives, or other diagnostic data from the BIG-IP system.
bugs.workaround: Use a command line SCP tool that allows specifying an absolute path for the source and/or destination file (a path that starts with a forward slash /), when the source and/or destination locations are a BIG-IP device. If the user ID is permitted to do so, you may use WinSCP in SFTP mode.

bugs.title: BIG-IP transmits packets with incorrect content
bugs.symptoms: In rare instances, BIG-IP transmits packets with incorrect content
bugs.conditions: BIG-IP virtual edition utilizing the ixlv driver.
bugs.impact: Incorrect packets transmitted from the BIG-IP.

bugs.title: Unable to create apm policy customization image using tmsh or VPE in the configuration utility command when source-path is specified
bugs.symptoms: Creating an APM policy image file with source_path attribute fails.

bugs.impact: You are unable to use the source_path attribute for creating APM customization image files.

bugs.title: Session Tracking screen may be missing the scroll bar after saving the configuration
bugs.symptoms: After pressing the Save button, the page may be refreshed without the ability to scroll down.
bugs.conditions: 1. Go to Security ›› Application Security : Session Tracking screen. 2. Change the configuration, for example choose 'Use individual Login Pages' and move the login URL from available to Selected (under Session Tracking Configuration section). 3. Save.
bugs.impact: After the page is refreshed, the scroller may be not available.

bugs.title: Tmsh:Add tmsh command to create/modify Alg-logging in AFM NAT module
bugs.symptoms: You are unable to configure the ALG profile for AFM NAT via tmsh.
bugs.conditions: Using tmsh to configure ALG logging profiles

bugs.title: DAG context synchronization problem in high availability (HA) mirroring on VELOS platforms
bugs.symptoms: There might be problems in DAG context synchronization in high availability (HA) mirroring on VELOS platform. The problem can be observed as a long sequence of logs similar to: notice SDAG CDP: Selected DAG state from primary PG 0 for CMP state 07 with clock 4622

bugs.title: BD crash on specific scenario
bugs.symptoms: BD crashes while passing traffic.
bugs.conditions: Specific request criterias that happens while there is a configuration change.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while bd restarts.

bugs.title: LSN_ADD/DELETE log messages were not sent for port 20 (ftp data channel)

bugs.title: Configuration failure due to the DB validation exception happening in the ips_inspection_sig and ips_inspection_compl tables
bugs.symptoms: During the upgrade, configuration error with reason DB validation exception occurs and unique constraint violation in the tables ips_inspection_sig and ips_inspection_compl.
