bugs.title: Incorrect configuration for "Auto detect" parameter is shown after switching from other data types
bugs.symptoms: The Configuration shown in the GUI for the "Auto detect" Parameter value type is incorrect after certain steps are performed.
bugs.conditions: 1. Create a default policy 2. Create new a Parameter with "User-input value" as a Parameter Value Type, and "File Upload" as the Data Type. 3. Save the settings above, and go back to the newly created Parameters settings. 4. Change its Parameter Value Type to "Auto detect".
bugs.impact: You either see unrelated fields, e.g. "Disallow File Upload of Executables" or missing tabs, like Value Meta Characters.
bugs.workaround: You can save a configuration with "User-input value" as a Parameter Value type, and "Alpha-Numeric" as Data Type, and then set "Auto detect" as Parameter Value Type.

bugs.title: SSL does not resume/reset async LTM policy events correctly when both policy and iRules are present
bugs.symptoms: -- A connection to the virtual server hangs from the client device. -- A memory leak occurs in tmm
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server has an L7 policy configured. -- Virtual server has iRules configured.
bugs.impact: -- Clients are unable to connect to the virtual server. -- A memory leak occurs.
bugs.workaround: Remove the L7 policy or the iRules from the virtual server configuration.

bugs.title: Nlad core observed due to ERR_func_error_string can return NULL
bugs.symptoms: The following symptoms are observed in /var/log/ltm: err nlad[17535]: OpenSSL: DRBG Continuous RNG test failed: DRBG stuck. Nlad core is observed /var/log/kern.log:Apr 7 03:46:53 <vs name > info kernel: nlad[13119]: segfault at 0 ip <> sp <> error 4.
bugs.conditions: NLAD core is SIGSEGV - crashing while processing a SSL Certificate via a SAML login.
bugs.impact: Core results in disruption of APM sessions
bugs.fix: NA

bugs.title: Virtual Servers may reply with a three-way handshake when disabled or when processing iRules
bugs.symptoms: Virtual servers may complete a three-way handshake before resetting a connection when they are disabled or when iRules process traffic for disabled virtual servers.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual Server with a pool assigned -- Pool is disabled administratively
bugs.impact: When a virtual server is marked as disabled and a client attempts to connect to it, tmm will normally send a reset to the first SYN packet. However, if you then administratively disable the pool ( disabled pool members - Not forced offline) tmm will complete the three-way handshake before sending resets. Additionally, when in this state, iRules will process and can pass traffic to pools if the iRule is configured to do that even though the virtual server status is disabled.
bugs.workaround: Avoid marking pools disabled or use forced offline for virtual servers that you want to administratively disable.

bugs.title: File /shared/GeoIP/v2/F5GeoIPRegion2v2.dat is not owned by any package
bugs.symptoms: In the GUI via System :: Software Management : Update Check or in tmsh show sys software update-status there may be errors relating to GeoIP similar to the following: "file /shared/GeoIP/v2/F5GeoIPRegion2v2.dat is not owned by any package"
bugs.conditions: After the BIG-IP reboots and GeoIP data is installed.
bugs.impact: This issue is cosmetic and does not affect GeoIP lookup operation. The error can be safely ignored.
bugs.workaround: Reinstall or update the geoIP data

bugs.title: TMM core due to assertion "valid type" failed at umem_free().
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes after making a bulk configuration change on the Active device and performing a config sync in a full sync mode.
bugs.conditions: -- High availability (HA) environment -- Performing a full config sync after making a change to the active device
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: Tmm may core when PEM virtual with a simple policy and iRule is being used
bugs.symptoms: Tmm cores with SIGSEGV.
bugs.conditions: -- PEM virtual with a simple policy and iRule attached.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: DAG context synchronization debug instrumentation
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system lacks instrumentation for the exchange of tmm DAG state over the statemirror channels between high availability (HA) peers running on VELOS.
bugs.conditions: -- High availability (HA) pair running on VELOS
bugs.impact: When average application response latency increases and health checks flap and the DAG is suspected, instrumentation is unavailable.

bugs.title: Prevent crash due to lack of queue buffers
bugs.symptoms: TMM fails to start up due to lack of buffers to allocate to receive (RX) queues
bugs.conditions: -- Using Xnet and DPDK drivers -- The product sum of (# of TMMs) * (# of interfaces) * (RX queue size) exceeds 65535. Ex: 16 TMMs * 2 interfaces * queue size of 2048 = 65536 8 TMMs * 4 interfaces * queue size of 2048 = 65536 8 TMMs * 2 interfaces * queue size of 4096 = 65536
bugs.impact: TMM fails to start up and gets stuck in a restart loop
bugs.workaround: Decrease one of the following so the product sum goes below 65535 - # of TMMs - # of interfaces - RX queue size

bugs.title: Inconsistent behavior in violation detection with maximum parameter enforcement
bugs.symptoms: Request with JSON body with more than 600 parameters causes the event log to show incorrect violations.
bugs.conditions: -- 'Maximum params' configured to 600 in JSON profile -- 'Maximum array length' configured to 'Any' -- A request occurs that contains more than 600 parameters in the body in JSON format
bugs.impact: No violation for passing maximum parameters given in event log, although the maximum number of allowed parameters was exceeded.
bugs.fix: The violations VIOL_HTTP_PROTOCOL and VIOL_JSON_FORMAT are now recorded in the event log.

bugs.title: Add additional server side support for f5-epi links.
bugs.symptoms: f5-epi links do not properly validate during machine info check.
bugs.conditions: - Machine info check is enabled in access policy.
bugs.impact: Undesirable behavior
bugs.workaround: -No-
bugs.fix: Note: 1081133 must be resolved on the server as well Behavior is as expected.

bugs.title: Error message "http_process_state_prepend - Invalid action:0x10a091" for version 15 and "http_process_state_prepend - Invalid action:0x107061" for versions 16 and 17 appears in the LTM log
bugs.symptoms: The error message "http_process_state_prepend - Invalid action:0x10a091" ("http_process_state_prepend - Invalid action:0x107061") erroneously appears in the /var/log/ltm log file. The error message "Access encountered error: Access pcb policy result is neither not_started nor inprogress: 3" also appears in the /var/log/apm log file.
bugs.conditions: An http(s) virtual server that also has an Access profile and per-request-policy configured.
bugs.impact: There is no impact.

bugs.title: Per virtual SYN cookie may not be activated on all HSB modules
bugs.symptoms: The virtual reports Hardware SYN cookie mode, but some of the SYNs are still processed in software.
bugs.conditions: On platforms where one TMM instance attached to multiple HSB modules.
bugs.impact: A portion of an SYN flood is processed in Software instead of Hardware.
bugs.fix: SYN cookie processing is correctly offloaded to all HSB modules.

bugs.title: IP Address description column does not appear on table from version 16.1.x
bugs.symptoms: In the new GUI design for IP Address Exceptions table, the "Descriptions" column was removed.
bugs.conditions: For a policy configured in Security ›› Application Security : Security Policies : Policies List, setting IP Address Exception description, will be shown only inside the IP details window, and not on the main table (inside IP Address Exceptions tab).
bugs.impact: You need to click on the IP details link to see the description.
bugs.fix: The table will include back the Description column.

bugs.title: GTM iQuery connections may be reset after SSL key renegotiation.
bugs.symptoms: During routine iQuery SSL renegotiation, the iQuery connection will occasionally be reset.
bugs.conditions: This occurs occasionally during routine renegotiation. Renegotiation occurs once very 24 hours, per connection, by default (but can be controlled by the db key big3d.renegotiation.interval)
bugs.impact: It causes a brief disconnection between the GTMs in the sync group.

bugs.title: Mcpd message: Unable to do incremental sync, reverting to full load for device group /Common/gtm
bugs.symptoms: GTM may occasionally send the wrong commit_id_originator to other sync group members, causing a full sync to occur instead of an incremental one. The following message may be seen in the /var/log/gtm log "Unable to do incremental sync, reverting to full load for device group /Common/gtm"
bugs.conditions: Frequent GTM group syncs.
bugs.impact: Unnecessary GTM full sync when an incremental sync would have been more efficient.

bugs.title: SNAT with FLOW_INIT firewall rule may core TMM due to wrong type of underlying flow structure
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes with SIGSEGV while passing firewall traffic.
bugs.conditions: -- SNAT + firewall rule -- FLOW_INIT used in an iRule
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: MCPD memory leak
bugs.symptoms: Viewing virtual server firewall policy rules leaks some memory in MCPD.
bugs.conditions: - BIG-IP AFM is provisioned - Virtual server firewall policy rules are viewed, e.g. by running one of the following commands: tmsh show ltm virtual fw-enforced-policy-rules tmsh show ltm virtual fw-staged-policy-rules
bugs.impact: A memory leak occurs when the command is run.

bugs.title: Multiple Referer header raise false positive evasion violation
bugs.symptoms: When Multiple Referer headers contains a backslash character ('＼') in query string portion, 'IIS backslashes' evasion technique violation is raised.
bugs.conditions: - 'Url Normalization' is turned on and 'Evasion Techniques Violations' is enabled. - Multiple Referer header contains a backslash character ('＼') in query string part.
bugs.impact: False positive evasion technique violation is raised for Referer header.
bugs.workaround: In the HTTP Header Properties screen, turn off the 'Url Normalization' on the 'Normalization Settings' section of the 'referer' property.
bugs.fix: Fixed Multiple Referer header handling before URL Normalization.

bugs.title: Valid connections may fail while a virtual server is in SYN cookie mode.
bugs.symptoms: Some of the valid connections to a TCP virtual server may fail while the virtual server is in SYN cookie mode due to an attack.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP i4x00 platform. -- TCP virtual server under SYN flood attack.
bugs.impact: Failed connections, service degradation.
bugs.workaround: Disabling SYN cookie in the TCP or fastL4 profile is a possible workaround, but that would leave the virtual server open to SYN flood attacks.
bugs.fix: The ePVA module is now correctly initialized on the i4x00 platform.

bugs.title: HTTP/2 full-proxy virtual server uses wrong source MAC address and incorrect SNAT address selection
bugs.symptoms: When using an HTTP/2 full-proxy virtual server (with httprouter profile), server-side connections may exhibit the following issues: - Egress packets use the system base MAC address instead of the configured masquerade MAC address. - SNAT automap selects a non-floating self-IP instead of the expected floating self-IP. - SNAT pool member selection does not prefer members matching the traffic-group of the virtual server. This can cause MAC address flapping alerts on upstream network equipment and may disrupt traffic during HA failover events.
bugs.conditions: - Virtual server configured with the httprouter profile (HTTP/2 full-proxy). - Masquerade MAC address configured on a traffic-group, and/or SNAT automap or SNAT pool in use with floating self-IPs.
bugs.impact: Server-side traffic uses incorrect source MAC address and may select non-floating SNAT addresses. Upstream network devices (such as switches or SDN controllers) may detect duplicate MAC/IP entries, causing traffic disruption. During HA failover, connections may not behave as expected because the correct traffic-group was not used.
bugs.workaround: None. Use a standard virtual server configuration without the httprouter profile as an alternative if HTTP/2 full-proxy is not required.
bugs.fix: HTTP/2 full-proxy virtual servers now correctly use the traffic-group associated with the client-side connection for server-side connections, ensuring the correct masquerade MAC address and SNAT address selection.

bugs.title: "Resource Administrator" role cannot change ACL order
bugs.symptoms: You encounter a 'No Access' error when trying to change ACL order
bugs.conditions: You are logged in with a Resource Administrator role.
bugs.impact: You are unable to change the ACL order

bugs.title: AAA: a trailing ampersand is added to serverside request when using HTTP forms based auth
bugs.symptoms: An extra "&" is added to a request
bugs.conditions: A query is specified in a Form-Action field
bugs.impact: The server replies with an error due to the extra trailing & in the request from APM

bugs.title: Length Mismatch in DNS/DHCP IPv6 address in logs and pcap
bugs.symptoms: The wrong length is shown in logs for DNS/DHCP IPv6 addresses.
bugs.conditions: -- DNS/DHCP IPv6 configured in IKE-PEER configuration. -- The tunnel is established.
bugs.impact: The length is reported incorrectly in the logs. It is reported as 15 when it should be reported as 16.
bugs.fix: Fix the logs.

bugs.title: Brute force captcha loop
bugs.symptoms: Captchas for a user that failed to login after several attempts will continue after a successful login.
bugs.conditions: -- A user fails to log in after several attempts. -- The mitigation is captcha mitigation.
bugs.impact: If the user eventually provides the correct password, the user will be able to log in.
bugs.fix: Issue with captcha loop was fixed.

bugs.title: IPv6 link-local floating self-IP breaks IPv6 query to BIND
bugs.symptoms: A IPv6 link-local floating self-IP breaks IPv6 query to BIND.
bugs.conditions: 1. Create a DNS record in BIND. 2. Create an IPv6 floating self-IP (for example, 2002::139) and place it into traffic-group-1. 3. Create an IPv6 DNS listener using the newly created self-IP (2002::139). So far a DNS query should be answered properly by BIND and TMM. 4. Create a dummy IPv6 floating self-IP using a link-local IP (for example, fe80::4ff:0:0:202) and place it into traffic-group-1. Now, the DNS query from outside will be timed out.
bugs.impact: DNS requests will get timed out.

bugs.title: Integrate sPVA DDOS vector functionality to appliance devices with multiple ATSE
bugs.symptoms: Multiple ATSEs are not handled in the current code. The users will observe an incorrect traffic rate limit against the configured vector. Selection of the linked TMM thread to ATSE could go wrong, which will result in the handling of the traffic only on one of the ATSEs.
bugs.conditions: Occurs on appliances with multiple ATSEs when dos_vectors are configured to mitigate the attack.
bugs.impact: An incorrect rate_limit will apply on the vectors. Both the ATSEs (TMM) might not participate in handling of the traffic.
bugs.fix: The traffic will be handled properly and the correct rate_limit will apply on the vector configuration.

bugs.title: TMM crashes when DHCP pool member is not reachable.
bugs.symptoms: TMM might crash when DHCP virtual-server is configured and DHCP pool member is marked down by a monitor.
bugs.conditions: DHCP virtual server.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: HTTP request payload not forwarded by BIG-IP when serverside is HTTP/2 and HTTP MRF router is enabled on virtual server
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP forwards HTTP request headers to pool member, but does not forward the request body. This results in a connection stall, and the connection eventually timing out and failing.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server with HTTP/2 full proxy configured (HTTP MRF router is enabled, and HTTP/2 profile present on virtual server). -- Virtual server has request-logging profile assigned. -- Serverside connection uses HTTP/2. -- Client sends a request that includes a payload body (e.g. a POST).
bugs.impact: HTTP transaction fails; traffic does not pass.
bugs.workaround: Remove the request-logging profile.

bugs.title: APM log files are flooded after a client connection fails.
bugs.symptoms: Once a client connection fails, the var/log/apm log files get flooded with repeat error messages like "queue.cpp func: "printx()" line: 359 Msg: Queued fd"
bugs.conditions: When the client connection fails, for example, when the client connection is no longer valid, the log files are flooded with all queued connections which are available at that point of time.
bugs.impact: The continuous error messages in the log files may cause high CPU issues.
bugs.fix: Log level changed so that these logs are only printed in debug log-level.

bugs.title: MQTT connection stats are not updated properly
bugs.symptoms: Negative values can be seen in current connections.
bugs.conditions: This issue can be seen when the 'CONNECT' message is dropped by iRule or when the first message received is not 'CONNECT.'
bugs.impact: MQTT profile stats are not incremented correctly with CONNECT message.
bugs.workaround: NA
bugs.fix: MQTT profile stats are incremented correctly with CONNECT message.

bugs.title: MCPD SIGABRT and core happened while deleting GTM pool member
bugs.symptoms: Mcpd crashes while deleting a pool member.
bugs.conditions: -- Huge GTM configuration -- One pool members is referenced by 1000 wide IPs
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while mcpd restarts.

bugs.title: Query Type Filter in DNS Security Profile blocks allowed query types
bugs.symptoms: When NXDomain is moved to active/enabled, a query response does not work in the GUI.
bugs.conditions: NXDomain field is in enable state in filtered-query-type in GUI.
bugs.impact: The query response fails.
bugs.workaround: NXDomain field should not be enabled using the GUI. NXDomain is always response type.

bugs.title: TLS1.3 connection failure with 0-RTT and Hello Retry Request (HRR).
bugs.symptoms: Connection failure.
bugs.conditions: This condition can occur when: - The 0-RTT is enabled. - When TLS1.3 session goes for Hello Retry Request (HRR).
bugs.impact: Connection failure.
bugs.workaround: Disable the 0-RTT.
bugs.fix: Added changes which handle this defects.

bugs.title: RSA-KEX ciphers list are removed from httpd configuration in FIPS mode since these are non-approved ciphers for FIPS 140-3 certification
bugs.symptoms: - RSA-KEX ciphers list are removed from httpd configuration when FIPS mode is enabled since these are non-approved ciphers for FIPS 140-3 certification. - Mandatory fix for FIPS 140-3 Certification.
bugs.conditions: - BIG-IP versions 16.1.3 and above. - Applies to systems requiring FIPS 140-3 Certification. - FIPS 140-3 license is installed on BIG-IP or its a FullBoxFIPS device. - https connections are established using the RSA-KEX based ciphers
bugs.impact: - BIG-IP systems running without this fix on a release targeted for certification (BIG-IP 16.1.x or later) will not be running a FIPS 140-3 certified configuration. - https connection using RSA KEX ciphers will not be successful when FIPS 140-3 license is installed in the device.
bugs.fix: Apply this fix to ensure that the system is compliant with FIPS 140-3 Certification.

bugs.title: Virtual server with default pool down and iRule pool up will flap for a second during a full config-sync.
bugs.symptoms: During a full manual config-sync, a virtual server with a default pool which is down and an iRule pool which is up will flap for a second on the receiving unit. For instance: Apr 22 13:52:31 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 01071682:5: SNMP_TRAP: Virtual /Common/my_vs has become unavailable Apr 22 13:52:31 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 010719e7:5: Virtual Address /Common/10.0.0.71 general status changed from GREEN to RED. Apr 22 13:52:31 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 010719e8:5: Virtual Address /Common/10.0.0.71 monitor status changed from UP to DOWN. <...> Apr 22 13:52:32 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 01071681:5: SNMP_TRAP: Virtual /Common/my_vs has become available Apr 22 13:52:35 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 010719e7:5: Virtual Address /Common/10.0.0.71 general status changed from RED to GREEN. Apr 22 13:52:35 bigip-ntr-b.local notice mcpd[7733]: 010719e8:5: Virtual Address /Common/10.0.0.71 monitor status changed from DOWN to UP.
bugs.conditions: -- device-group configured for full manual sync -- virtual server with default pool up and iRule pool down -- a config sync is initiated
bugs.impact: There is no impact to application traffic during the flapping, as the virtual server continues to function correctly even when the unit receiving the config-sync is the Active one. However, the logs (and the ensuing SNMP traps) may be confusing to BIG-IP Administrators and/or network operators monitoring alarms from the system.
bugs.workaround: You can work around this issue by configuring the device-group for incremental config-sync instead (either manual or automatic).

bugs.title: Content profiles created for types other than video and image allowing executable
bugs.symptoms: When creating "API Security" policy, "Disallow File Upload of Executables" options are disabled for contents different than video/* or image/*.
bugs.conditions: Create "API Security" policy with binary content URL.
bugs.impact: Incorrect violation is raised.
bugs.fix: Disabled Disallow File Upload of Executables in content profiles.

bugs.title: F5OS tenant secondary slots are inoperative after licensing or restart of MCPD on the primary
bugs.symptoms: The secondary blades are inoperative when MCPD is restarted on the primary slot, or the license is installed on the F5OS chassis. Following are the symptoms: - Following log message is logged in /var/log/ltm: mprov:29790:[29790]: 'FPGA change is taking a long time. Unable to start the daemons.' for the secondary slots. - The presence of the file /var/run/fpga_mcpd_lockfile on the secondary slots.
bugs.conditions: - Multi-Slot F5OS tenant. - Restarting MCPD on the primary blade or installing the license from the F5OS chassis.
bugs.impact: Secondary blades are inoperative.
bugs.workaround: Execute the following command on the secondary blades that are inoperative: bigstart restart mcpd

bugs.title: iRule 'reject' command under 'FLOW_INIT' event does not send the reject packet out in some cases.
bugs.symptoms: Invoking the iRule command 'reject' under the iRule event 'FLOW_INIT' may, in some cases, fail to send out the intended reject packet (i.e. TCP reset or ICMP port unreachable).
bugs.conditions: The issue occurs when the BIG-IP system does not have a route back to the client, and should instead deliver the reject packet by means of autolasthop.
bugs.impact: The connection is actually removed from the BIG-IP system's connection table, and correctly does not progress. However, the lack of a reject packet could make the client retransmit its initial packet or insist in opening more connections.
bugs.fix: iRule 'reject' command under 'FLOW_INIT' event now works correctly even when autolasthop should be employed to deliver the reject packet back to the client.

bugs.title: High availability messages are dropped by the Standby device.
bugs.symptoms: The following message is seen repeatedly in /var/log/tmm: "<13> session_ha_context_callback: SessionDB ERROR: received invalid or corrupt high availability (HA) message; dropped message."
bugs.conditions: In high availability (HA) pair configurations, the Active device sends a high availability message to the Standby device.
bugs.impact: The Standby device identifies the message as invalid or corrupt and drops it.

bugs.title: Use native driver for e810 instead of sock
bugs.symptoms: Default driver sock cannot provide good performance.
bugs.conditions: Running BIG-IP Virtual Edition (sock is the default virtual function network driver for VE until 15.1.6 release)
bugs.impact: Default driver sock cannot provide good performance.
bugs.workaround: No mitigation when native drivers are not yet available for e810 NIC (for example, 15.1.6 and earlier). Default driver sock are used and that is unable to provide good performance.
bugs.fix: This release provides a native driver.

bugs.title: Less-privileged users (guest, operator, etc) are unable to run top level commands
bugs.symptoms: Less privileged users are no longer able to run top-level commands such as "show running-config recursive". Executing this command from TMOS results in an error: Unexpected Error: Can't display all items, can't get object count from mcpd and mcpd throws error: result_message "01070823:3: Read Access Denied: user (test) type (Abort Ending Agent)"
bugs.conditions: User account with a role of guest, operator, or any role other than admin.
bugs.impact: You are unable to show the running config, or use list or list sys commands.
bugs.workaround: Logon with an account with admin access.

bugs.title: iAppLX extension using express with httpserver script leaves lingering client-side flow on HTTP requests.
bugs.symptoms: While using an iAppLX extension using express with simple HTTP server script, tmsh show sys conn shows a lingering client-side flow that is eventually expired by the sweeper.
bugs.conditions: Virtual server with iAppLX extension using express with a simple httpserver script like below: app.use(express.static('public')); var plugin = new f5.ILXPlugin(); plugin.startHttpServer(app);
bugs.impact: The connection table (tmsh show sys conn) shows a lingering client-side flow that is eventually expired by the sweeper.

bugs.title: Support Resource Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) for cross domains as part of Kerberos SSO
bugs.symptoms: In BIG-IP APM 17.0.0 and earlier versions, the Kerberos SSO Resource Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) is not supported. Constrained Delegation does not work without User Domain Controller admin adding cross domain service FQDNs as part of Delegated User.
bugs.conditions: User Domain Controller admin adding cross domain service FQDNs as part of Delegated User.
bugs.impact: The Service administrators need support of User domain administrators to add new services as part of delegation.
bugs.workaround: User domain administrators can add new services as part of delegation.
bugs.fix: From BIG-IP APM 17.1.0 version onward, RBCD feature is supported. Service administrators can directly add or delete new service FQDNs with in Service Domain Controller.

bugs.title: Diameter in-tmm monitor is logging disconnect events unnecessarily
bugs.symptoms: Errors are logged to /var/log/ltm: err tmm[20104]: 01cc0006:3: Peer (<peer>) connection state has changed: disconnected
bugs.conditions: A diameter in-tmm monitor is configured
bugs.impact: Debug logs are logged at the error level.
bugs.fix: Log level has been changed to the debug level for the peer disconnected log.

bugs.title: Policies not being applied
bugs.symptoms: When two firewall policies are applied, one at a global level and one at the virtual server context, none of the policies are applied.
bugs.conditions: Apply two different policies, one at the virtual server context and the other at a global level.
bugs.impact: Policies are not applied
bugs.workaround: Attach the required policy either in global level or virtual server context, not in both

bugs.title: DELETE of REST Auth token does not result in deletion of the pamcache token file on a multi-slot VIPRION chassis, vCMP guest, or VELOS tenant
bugs.symptoms: The REST tokens are not deleted from cache /var/run/pamcache when the tokens are expired or deleted.
bugs.conditions: - A large number of REST Auth tokens are created in multi-slot VIPRION, multi-slot vCMP Guest, or multi-slot VELOS tenant.
bugs.impact: The deleted token continue to be available in the cache. Memory is consumed as cache is stored in an in-memory filesystem.
bugs.workaround: Execute the following commands in bash to remove the pamcache directory from the set being acted upon by "csyncd": # clsh "cp /etc/csyncd.conf /etc/csyncd.conf.$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" # clsh "sed -i '/run＼/pamcache/,+2s/^/#/' /etc/csyncd.conf" # clsh "bigstart restart csyncd" Also, clear any stale content either by rebooting or deleting the tokens. Remove token files from /run/pamcache manually. Execute the following command by using -print instead of -delete to verify the tokens to be deleted (recommended to not use clsh): # clsh "find /run/pamcache -regextype posix-extended -type f -regex '/run/pamcache/[A-Z0-9]{26}' -delete"
bugs.fix: Auth tokens in /run/pamcache are deleted as required.

bugs.title: Refreshing pool member statistics results in error while processing requests
bugs.symptoms: Pool member statistics aren't displayed and the page shows an error message 'An error has occurred while trying to process your request'.
bugs.conditions: -- A GTM pool is configured with one or more pool members. -- The 'Refresh' button or the timer is used to fetch the pool member statistics again.
bugs.impact: Refresh does not work as expected.
bugs.workaround: Although the refresh button or refresh timer is broken, you can refresh the page to see updated statistics.
bugs.fix: The page refreshes correctly on clicking the button or on setting the timer.

bugs.title: Unnecessary data present in APM URL
bugs.conditions: APM with network access profile configured.
bugs.workaround: -No-
bugs.fix: Modified the code such that APM URLs follow best practices

bugs.title: 'Reset on Timeout' setting might be ignored when fastl4 is used with another profile.
bugs.symptoms: 'Reset on Timeout' setting might be ignored when Fastl4 profile is configured along with some other profile.
bugs.conditions: Fastl4 profile is configured along with some other profile (for example IPS).
bugs.impact: Traffic might be reset unexpectedly.

bugs.title: Tmm core with SIGSEGV in gtmpoolmbr_UpdateStringProc
bugs.symptoms: Tmm cored with SIGSEGV.
bugs.conditions: -- iRule pool command with member which is determined at run-time -- A pool member is used for the iRule -- The previous pool member is deleted and then re-created using the same name -- That pool member is picked again for the next iRule event.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Use a string command to category the pool member variable like this: pool dnspool member [string trim $pool_member]

bugs.title: Unable to connect to "localhost" port 25. err sSMTP[9797]
bugs.symptoms: An error is logged every 20 minutes to /var/log/maillog err sSMTP[9797]: Unable to connect to "localhost" port 25. err sSMTP[9797]: Cannot open localhost:25 The symptoms are similar to what you see in https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K60914243 but the solution in that article will not help. K60914243 talks about 15.x while current issue is on 16.x.
bugs.conditions: This occurs in one of the following happens 1. You have manually deleted restjavad or restnoded log files with following commands rm /var/log/restjavad* rm /var/log/restnonded* 2. One of the restjavad/restnoded log files is small and unable to rotate (rotation fails). This happens when file size does not exceed default "max-file-size"
bugs.impact: Log rotation for restjavad/restnoded will be stuck. You may see system emails about sSMTP errors every 20 minutes.
bugs.workaround: This issue subsides if you manually create a file for the stuck log file. 1. Open a command terminal 2. Run # ls -l /var/log/restnoded* 3. If you find that restnonded1.log is missing then manually create it # touch /var/log/restnoded/restnoded1.log 4. Run # ls -l /var/log/restjavad*.log 5. If you find that restjavad.1.log is missing then manually create it # touch /var/log/restjavad.1.log

bugs.title: Tmm crash after changing "connection.vlankeyed" to disabled on system with L2 wire
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes.
bugs.conditions: Changing "connection.vlankeyed" from enabled to disabled on a system configured for L2 wire
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Keep "connection.vlankeyed" enabled
bugs.fix: The crash was eliminated

bugs.title: Use of iRules command whereis with "isp" or "org" options may cause TCL object leak.
bugs.symptoms: When iRules command whereis is being used with "isp" or "org" options and underlying GEOIP database(s) have not been loaded, cur_allocs for tcl memory increases over time and does not return to the prior level.
bugs.conditions: - iRules command whereis is used with "isp" or "org" options - The underlying GEOIP database(s) have not been loaded
bugs.impact: Cur_allocs for tcl memory increases over time and does not return to the prior level.
bugs.workaround: Load the underlying GEOIP database(s) before using "isp" or "org" options of the iRules command whereis.

bugs.title: Incorrect value for "sed-api-host" is sent to Distributed Cloud with API call
bugs.symptoms: Incorrect Value of "sed-api-host:" is sent to Distributed Cloud in requests to "ibd-ebus.fastcache.net/api/v1/decision".
bugs.conditions: - Virtual with Bot Defense profile attached is in used.
bugs.impact: Incorrect sed-host-ip value is received at Distributed Cloud.
bugs.fix: The correct value of sed-host-ip is forwarded to Distributed Cloud.

bugs.title: Added Rewrite Control Lists builder to Admin UI
bugs.symptoms: Poor usability for admins in Rewrite Control Lists (RCL) functionality
bugs.conditions: You wish to edit Rewrite Control Lists
bugs.impact: Previously there was no RCL builder. The RCL strings where added as is. Now Admin UI has an RCL builder which creates the RCL string.
bugs.fix: RCL Builder added to Admin UI

bugs.title: Client-side abort during server-side establishment may cause tmm to behave abnormally in HTTP MRF proxy
bugs.symptoms: This is due to early abort on client-side during serverside connection establishment.
bugs.conditions: - http vs with an httprouter profile - irule to reject the connection
bugs.impact: - abnormal tmm behavior

bugs.title: In SWG explicit proxy, some TCP connections are reset because of inconsistency between sessionDB and local IP2SessionId map
bugs.symptoms: Some clients' TCP connections are reset with an error "cl sm driver error (Illegal value)" when the BIG-IP system is in this error state.
bugs.conditions: SWG explicit proxy is configured.
bugs.impact: Some clients are unable to access a service.
bugs.workaround: Disable sessionDB mirroring on both active and standby # tmsh modify sys db statemirror.mirrorsessions value disable # tmsh save sys config Restart tmm on standby # bigstart restart tmm
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue causing a TCP reset with certain clients.

bugs.title: HTTP_REJECT processing can lead to zombie SPAWN flows piling up
bugs.symptoms: In the execution of a specific sequence of events, when TCL attempts to execute the non-existing event, it follows a path which in turn makes SPAWN flow to become a zombie, which pile up over time showing up on the monitoring system.
bugs.conditions: -- http2, client-ssl, optimized-caching filters on the virtual server -- HTTP::respond iRule with LB_FAILED event and set of iRules like HTTP_REQUEST, HTTP_RESPONSE, CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE, CACHE_RESPONSE, ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING -- send http2 request through the virtual server
bugs.impact: Clients may not be able to connect to the virtual server after a point in time.
bugs.fix: This defect has been resolved and stale connections are being cleaned up as expected.

bugs.title: ICMP flood or ICMP/IP/IPv6 fragment vectors are not hardware mitigated when configured on zone
bugs.symptoms: Hardware drops are not seen for the vectors ICMP flood or ICMP/IP/IPv6 fragment when configured on zone.
bugs.conditions: In case of a zone configured with ICMP flood or ICMP/IP/IPv6 fragment vectors, will see only attack mitigation and drops at software level.
bugs.impact: Hardware mitigation is not happening when ICMP flood and ICMP/IP/IPv6 fragment vectors configured on a zone.
bugs.fix: This was due to know limitation in one of the hardware module. Added the required changes to use SPVA for these vectors to fix the issue.

bugs.title: REST API Access hardening
bugs.symptoms: REST API Access token generation may not follow security best practices.
bugs.workaround: Restrict high-privileged access to the BIG-IP filesystem to trusted users.
bugs.fix: Security best practices are now followed.

bugs.title: F5OS BIG-IP tenants perform an MCPD "forceload" operation after a reboot
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP tenant software running on an F5OS device performs an MCPD "forceload" operation after a reboot which means the MCPD loads the configuration from the text config file rather than the binary database. /var/log/ltm contains chmand Hardware/Chassis change detected. Forcing db load from the file.
bugs.conditions: The management Mac address transfers from F5OS to BIG-IP tenant are not in sync.
bugs.impact: -- Devices report "changes pending" after the tenant is rebooted. -- This may result in configuration loss if auto-sync is configured. -- This may result in configuration loss as a result of operational foul-ups, regardless of which device had a newer configuration before one was rebooted, the newly-rebooted device will claim to have a newer configuration.
bugs.workaround: A future update to F5OS will fix the issue

bugs.title: Request body on server side egress is not chunked when it needs to be after HTTP processes a 100 continue response.
bugs.symptoms: After HTTP processes a 100 continue responses, the request body is incorrectly not chunked on egress to the server, whenever server-side chunking is expected.
bugs.conditions: - Basic HTTP virtual server with rechunking iRule. - Incoming client requests containing 'Expect' header.
bugs.impact: Server may return an error response, for example, 400 Bad Request.
bugs.fix: The request body is chunked on server-side when expected and the server responses are as per expectation.

bugs.title: iRule command 'connect' may fail to resume when invoked from CLIENT_DATA or SERVER_DATA
bugs.symptoms: The 'connect' iRule command fails to resume when it is called from CLIENT_DATA or SERVER_DATA events. The processing of traffic could halt due to 'irule_scope_msg' and the iRule is not processed as expected.
bugs.conditions: - iRule using the 'connect' command - Diameter/Generic-message 'irule_scope_msg' enabled - 'connect' command is being called from CLIENT_DATA or SERVER_DATA events
bugs.impact: Traffic processing halts (no crash)
bugs.fix: The 'connect' iRule command works as expected in all cases.

bugs.title: Decode_application_payload can break exponent notation in JSON
bugs.symptoms: With decode_application_payload set to 1, the single pass of decoding prior to JSON parsing will convert positive exponents to ascii characters ie "+" to " ". This results in Malformed numeric value violations
bugs.conditions: Positive exponents with decode_application_payload set to 1.
bugs.impact: Malformed JSON violations
bugs.workaround: Disable decode_application_payload decode_application_payload set to 0.

bugs.title: Unable to deploy BIG-IP on Azure with D series(v5) or E series(v5) instance types
bugs.symptoms: When the BIG-IP is deployed with either D series(v5) or E(v5) series, the Azure is unable to add a route to Azure which is used by Azure to communicate with the instance. It is throwing DHCP timeout error as below. Due to this, Azure is unable to communicate and fetch the status and other details of the instances deployed.
bugs.conditions: When the BIG-IP is deployed with either D series(v5) or E(v5) series
bugs.impact: Deployment of BIG-IP on Dv5/Ev5 series timeout due to OS Provisioning timeout.
bugs.workaround: Pre-requisite for this is accelerated networking which is supported on CentOS 7.4 or later. Currently BIG-IP uses CentOS 7.3

bugs.title: Incorrect HTTP request handling may lead to resource leak
bugs.symptoms: Under certain configurations specific HTTP requests may cause BD to waste resources and hang during the ingress process.
bugs.conditions: An unspecified virtual server configuration attached to an ASM policy.
bugs.impact: Excess resource consumption on the BIG-IP. Traffic disruption while TMM restarts.
bugs.workaround: Configure high availability.
bugs.fix: The connection handling between the enforcer and the client after a response violation is received has been corrected.

bugs.title: Emulated Interaction Events occurs when using Bot Defense Profile and Datasafe keylogger protection feature
bugs.symptoms: Datasafe keylogger protection feature causes the Bot Defense profile to detect untrusted events.
bugs.conditions: -- Bot Defense profile is attached to a virtual server -- Datasafe profile is attached to the virtual server, with keylogger protection feature enabled.
bugs.impact: Legitimate users are getting mitigated.
bugs.workaround: Modify bigDB: tmsh modify sys db botdefense.cshui_checked_trusted_events value "mousedown, mouseup, mousemove, touchstart, touchmove, touchend"

bugs.title: HSB lockup using stateless virtual server
bugs.symptoms: The HSB can lockup when BIG-IP is configured with a stateless virtual server. This is seen in the TMM logs: tmm:<13> May 10 12:00:12 localhost notice *** TMM 0 - PDE 0 PCI 2:0.1 IF 0.1 - transmitter failure *** Or in /var/log/ltm: Feb 15 17:25:18 slot1/myguest1.local crit tmm[15533]: 01010025:2: Device error: hsb hsb interface 2 DMA lockup on transmitter failure Feb 15 20:30:03 slot1/myguest1.local crit tmm[12019]: 01230111:2: Interface 0.5: HSB DMA lockup on transmitter failure. Feb 15 20:30:03 slot1/myguest1.local crit tmm[12019]: 01010025:2: Device error: hsb hsb interface 0 DMA lockup on transmitter failure
bugs.conditions: A stateless virtual server is configured.
bugs.impact: The device is rebooted.
bugs.workaround: Configure the virtual to standard (not stateless) and modify the profile with immediate timeout. Once a system is affected, it must be rebooted to resolve the issue. If the system is a vCMP guest, the entire blade or appliance must be rebooted.
bugs.fix: The stateless vip no longer locks up the HSB
bugs.behavior: The stateless vip will now fragment egress traffic.

bugs.title: Creating CSR with invalid parameters for basic-constraints, tmsh does not generate meaningful errors
bugs.symptoms: A similar error as below is observed: Key management library returned bad status: -45, No Error
bugs.conditions: Always observed.
bugs.impact: The error thrown is not meaningful hence it is difficult to identify the invalid parameters.
bugs.fix: Errors are now more descriptive and provide information about invalid parameters.

bugs.title: Incorrect statistics for DNS malformed vector
bugs.symptoms: The DNS malformed register is not set to the correct value, resulting in incorrect statistics.
bugs.conditions: Looking at the DNS malformed register using 'tmctl dos_stat'.
bugs.impact: The DNS malformed register is not set to the correct value, as a result, all of the DNS packets will be classified as malformed.

bugs.title: Tmm crash while doing high-speed logging
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes
bugs.conditions: -- High-speed logging is configured -- Network instability occurs with the logging pool members
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: Gratuitous ARP not issued for non-floating self-IP on clicking "Update" via the GUI
bugs.symptoms: A gratuitous ARP (GARP) is not issued as per K15858.
bugs.conditions: After the BIG-IP system is fully started and interfaces are online, select the non-floating self IP address in the Configuration utility and then select Update (without making any changes).
bugs.impact: You cannot force non-floating self-IPs to send a gratuitous ARP post-boot.

bugs.title: "duplicate priming" assert in IPSECALG
bugs.symptoms: This is a specific issue with a complicated firewall/NAT/IPSEC scenario. In this case, when applying changes to a firewall policy in transparent mode, IPSECALG triggers a "duplicate priming" assert
bugs.conditions: When an IPSec session is established from a device with a source IP which has a firewall policy (transparent mode). As soon as traffic is passed over the new IPSec tunnel, this clash in the rules results in a tmm core.
bugs.impact: TMM asserts with "duplicate priming" assert. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.fix: Data is able to flow through tunnel and no crash

bugs.title: TMM may leak memory when processing sideband connections.
bugs.symptoms: The xdata memory subsystem in TMM is affected by a memory leak. If left unchecked, TMM may eventually crash being unable to allocate any more memory.
bugs.conditions: The system is configured with iRules employing sideband connections. Special undisclosed network traffic from the target servers is required to trigger this issue.
bugs.impact: If TMM crashes, redundant units will fail-over. Standalone units will suffer a momentary outage while TMM restarts.
bugs.fix: TMM now follows best practices for sideband connection handling.

bugs.title: Upgrade from BIG-IP 16.1.3 to BIG-IP 17.0 does not work when FIPS mode is enabled
bugs.symptoms: Upgrade from BIG-IP 16.1.3 to BIG-IP 17.0 does not work when FIPS mode is enabled. Error displayed in console: 01070911:3: The requested integer (2) is out of range (0 - 1) for fipscipherversion in httpd (/Common/httpd) Unexpected Error: Loading configuration process failed.
bugs.conditions: - BIG-IP 16.1.3 - FIPS 140-3 license is installed on BIG-IP 16.1.3 or its a FullBoxFIPS device. When FIPS 140-3 is enabled in BIG-IP 16.1.3 then the upgrade to version 17.0 will fail.
bugs.impact: Upgrade from version 16.1.3 to version 17.0 fails when FIPS enabled.
bugs.workaround: Disable the FIPS 140-3 license and then perform the upgrade.

bugs.title: Unable to add tenant ID greater than 12 characters in Bot Defense profile
bugs.symptoms: The tenant ID field is limited to 12 characteristics in Bot Defense profile and if user provides more than 12 characters, then an error is displayed that field is limited to 12 characters length. Tenant ID length should be minimum of 16 characters length and maximum of 64 characters in Bot Defense profile. To be compatible minimum length has been set to 12 characters which is valid for both F5CS portal and F5XC.
bugs.conditions: - Configuring Bot Defense profile.
bugs.impact: User cannot configure tenant ID successfully, subsequently Bot Defense profile configuration will not be successful.
bugs.fix: The field tenant ID range is updated to have minimum of 12 characters and maximum of 64 characters.

bugs.title: /var/tmp/pccd.out file size increases rapidly and fills up the /shared partition
bugs.symptoms: The /var/tmp/pccd.out file size increases rapidly, filling up the /shared partition.
bugs.conditions: Create a firewall rule or policy.
bugs.impact: The /var/tmp/pccd.out file size increases rapidly, filling up the /shared partition.
bugs.fix: Creating a firewall rule or policy no longer causes the /var/tmp/pccd.out file size to increase rapidly.

bugs.title: [Zebos] Expand zebos/bgp commands in a qkview
bugs.symptoms: Improvement to add the following commands to a qkview: show ip route show ipv6 route show ip bgp neighbors show bgp show ip bgp attribute-info show ip bgp scan show ip pim neighbor show route-map show process
bugs.fix: The following commands are added to a qkview: Show ip route show ipv6 route show ip bgp neighbors show bgp show ip bgp attribute-info show ip bgp scan show ip pim neighbor show route-map show process

bugs.title: Tcpdump SSL provider generates invalid trailer
bugs.symptoms: You are unable to decrypt TLS 1.3 traffic captures using procedures described in K31793632 after upgrading..
bugs.conditions: -- Tcpdump traffic capture of TLS 1.3 traffic
bugs.impact: Administrators and F5 Support is unable to troubleshoot issues that occur with TLS 1.3 traffic or handshakes.

bugs.title: GRO/LRO is disabled in environments using the TMM raw socket "sock" driver.
bugs.symptoms: GRO/LRO packets are not received: "tmctl -d blade tmm/ndal_rx_stats" shows "0" in "lro". The linux host has GRO disabled: "ethtool -k eth1 | grep generic-receive-offload" shows "off".
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP is deployed in a Hyper-V environment. -- Any environment such that "tmctl -d blade tmm/device_probed" displays "sock" in "driver_in_use".
bugs.impact: Performance is degraded.
bugs.workaround: Manually enable GRO on the device: ethtool -K eth1 gro on Check that it's enabled with: ethtool -k eth1 | grep generic-receive-offload
bugs.fix: When sending large payload, "tmctl -d blade tmm/ndal_rx_stats" shows "1" in "lro". "tmctl -d blade tmm/ndal_dev_status" shows "y:y" (available:enabled) in "lro". The linux host indicates the device has GRO enabled: "ethtool -k eth1 | grep generic-receive-offload" shows "on".

bugs.title: Boot Marker logs missing ISO formatted date
bugs.symptoms: On affected BIG-IP v15.1.x versions starting with BIG-IP v15.1.4, boot_marker log messages marking system startup events do not include ISO formatted dates.
bugs.conditions: This occurs on affected BIG-IP v15.1.x versions starting with BIG-IP v15.1.4.
bugs.impact: 1. For log files covering a long period of time, it may not be obvious in which year a particular recorded boot event occurred, and the precise timing much be inferred by other data. 2. The ISO date format is not used for boot_marker logs when ISO date format is enabled (tmsh modify sys syslog iso-date enable), breaking ICSA compliance. 3. The boot_marker log message format is inconsistent with other BIG-IP versions (v14.1.x and earlier, v16.0.0 and later).

bugs.title: Tmm crash with FastL4 virtual servers and CMP disabled
bugs.symptoms: With CMP disabled, all traffic is forwarded to one TMM thread. A crash occurs when these flows are torn down.
bugs.conditions: The following is configured on a virtual server: -- A fastL4 profile -- CMP is disabled -- An IPS firewall policy
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Enable CMP on the virtual server. tmsh modify ltm virtual <virtual_server_name> cmp-enabled yes

bugs.title: Horizon VDI clients are intermittently disconnected
bugs.symptoms: VMware Horizon Clients experience intermittent freezes and disconnects as the mapping between blast UUID and session id in CLIENT_CLOSED function is maintained only for 20 seconds.
bugs.conditions: -- VMware VDI is configured via an iApp -- The connection to the virtual server is lost for more than 20 seconds
bugs.impact: VMware Horizon Clients experience freezes and disconnects intermittently.
bugs.fix: VMware Horizon Clients are not being disconnected intermittently.

bugs.title: Tmm core when accessing a pool after gtm_add or updating a topology record
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes while passing traffic.
bugs.conditions: TMM process fails seconds after the gtm_add command is run or topology records are updated with large number of records.
bugs.impact: On very rare occasions, TMM can crash. Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Reduce the number of gtm configuration objects such as pools, topology records, region records.
bugs.fix: Reverted the changes that causing the regressions.

bugs.title: Broken link under Cryptographic Failure section in OWASP page
bugs.symptoms: The link for Mask Credit Card Numbers in Request Log is broken.
bugs.conditions: 1. Navigate to Security ›› Overview : OWASP Compliance page. 2. Click on a policy which has an OWASP score. 3. Under A2 Cryptographic Failures category, find the Mask Credit Card Numbers field in Request Log. 4. Click the FULFILLED/NOT FULFILLED link. The link does not load the requested page.
bugs.impact: The user does not have an easy access for the policy details page from OWASP page.
bugs.workaround: Navigate to Security ›› Application Security : Security Policies : Policies List ›› <policy_name> page and find the entry of Mask Credit Card Numbers in Request Log.
bugs.fix: The link for Mask Credit Card Numbers in Request Log is loading the page.

bugs.title: ASM may skip signature matching
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions ASM skips signature matching.
bugs.conditions: Authorization header type is Bearer. - When input contains less than or more than 3 parts of JWT token values. - When base64 decode fails while decoding JWT token.
bugs.impact: Signature matching gets skipped.
bugs.fix: ASM checks for signature matching.

bugs.title: Certain configuration settings leads to memory accumulation
bugs.symptoms: Some specific traffic configurations causing memory consumption.
bugs.conditions: Profiles attached to Virtual server
bugs.impact: Memory will get accumulated.
bugs.workaround: Set udp timeout > 0 on a UDP profile.
bugs.fix: corrected memory management during packet processing.

bugs.title: The header ISTL-INFINITE-LOOP might get forwarded to origin server
bugs.symptoms: The internal header ISTL-INFINITE-LOOP is forwarded to the origin server.
bugs.conditions: - Bot Defense profile is in use. - Interstitial endpoint is configured.
bugs.impact: Origin server receives internal header 'ISTL-INFINITE-LOOP header'.
bugs.fix: The header ISTL-INFINITE-LOOP is removed from request before forwarding to the origin server.

bugs.title: TMM may crash when enable-rapid-response is enabled on a DNS profile
bugs.symptoms: TMM crash
bugs.conditions: The "enable-rapid-response" is enabled on a DNS profile. The BIG-IP is a platform that has hardware syncookie capability.
bugs.impact: TMM restart, unexpected failover
bugs.workaround: Disable rapid response or disable syncookies in the tcp profile attached to the rapid response virtual server.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer crashes

bugs.title: Performance drop observed in some Ramcache::HTTP tests on BIG-IP i10800 platform
bugs.symptoms: Drop in TPS of around 6.5% observed for Ramcache::HTTP tests.
bugs.conditions: - BIG-IP i10800 l7-performance-fpga platform - 5KB file size with 1 Request Per Connection - 5KB file size with 100 Request Per Connection Virtual server with the following profiles - 1. http 2. tcp profile with nagle disabled 3. web acceleration profile with following attributes - - cache-max-age 36000 - cache-object-max-size 1500001 - cache-object-min-size 1
bugs.impact: Delay in client side response during peak traffic flow due to lowered throughput.

bugs.title: TMM restarting repeatedly after upgrade 15.1.5.1
bugs.symptoms: TMM may crash while processing FastL4 traffic.
bugs.conditions: The SSE instruction in checksumadjust function is present and crashing the TMM
bugs.impact: When sending FastL4 traffic TMM may leads to crash
bugs.fix: The TMM no longer crashes

bugs.title: In-TMM TCP monitor memory leak
bugs.symptoms: TMM memory use grows unbounded; aggressive sweeper is engaged
bugs.conditions: -- In-TMM TCP monitors are enabled
bugs.impact: TCP peer ingress accumulates over time. Over an extended period of time the aggressive sweeper begins freeing memory.
bugs.workaround: 1. Rebooting the BIG-IP system after the change is made is one potential remedy. 2. Use regular LTM monitors.
bugs.fix: Fixed a memory leak with in-tmm TCP monitors.

bugs.title: SSL Persistence behavior change for TLS1.3 connection between v16.1.0 and v16.1.2.2
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP system resets TLS 1.3 connections when the client-hello contains a session-ID.
bugs.conditions: -- Virtual server has ssl persistence enabled -- TLS 1.3 is used -- The client-hello message contains a session-ID.
bugs.impact: Traffic uses TLS 1.3 and SSL persistence is disrupted.

bugs.title: TMM crash reported with specific policy settings
bugs.symptoms: TMM crashes when HTTPS request for a non-existent document
bugs.conditions: 1) Virtual server with HTTP Profile 2) LTM Policy with "shutdown connection" for 400/404 response codes 3) Request for non-existent document
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Remove the policy and use an iRule with the same conditions as in the policy.

bugs.title: IPI is not dropping traffic from IPREP database malicious IPs
bugs.symptoms: IPI is unable to drop traffic when you send an attack using IPs from the IPREP list of IPs.
bugs.conditions: -- IPI Subscription License installed
bugs.impact: The packet is not dropped and mysql logs or network-ipi logs are not seen for such.
bugs.workaround: No
bugs.fix: IPI is now able to drop traffic from IPREP IPs, and the traffic drops are logged.

bugs.title: APM policy sync fails when access policy contains customization images
bugs.symptoms: APM policy sync fails after an upgrade. Mcpd logs an error err mcpd[6405]: 01b70117:3: local_path (/tmp/psync_local_file) starts with invalid directory. Valid directories are /var/config/rest/, /var/tmp/, /shared/tmp/.
bugs.conditions: APM access policy contains a custom image file
bugs.impact: APM policy sync fails.
bugs.fix: Customization image file is allowed to be created from /tmp local_path.

bugs.title: iControl REST call with token fails with 401 Unauthorized
bugs.symptoms: For a short period after creating or refreshing a token, the iControl REST calls may fail with a 401 Unauthorized error and an HTML body content, or a 401 F5 Authorization Required error and a JSON body content. When using F5 Ansible modules for BIG-IP, the modules may fail with an error "Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)". The AS3 may return an error "AS3 API code: 401".
bugs.conditions: - REST call using valid token. - Can commonly occur on the call after a token has been refreshed or a Token list has been requested.
bugs.impact: The iControl REST calls may temporarily fail (typically less than 1 second) after the creation or refresh of an iControl REST token.
bugs.workaround: After being issued a token or refreshing a token, wait a second before attempting to use it. If this does not work, request a new token. No workaround exists for AS3 or F5 Ansible BIG-IP modules.
bugs.fix: A race condition on a PAM file update has been resolved. Tokens should remain valid.

bugs.title: Incorrect 'No reply from big3d: timed out' result for certain destinations monitored by GTM.
bugs.symptoms: It is possible for monitor probes to a certain destination to be owned by no GTM device in the sync-group. As a result, no monitoring of the destination will be performed, and the monitored object will be incorrectly marked down with reason "no reply from big3d: timed out".
bugs.conditions: -- GTM sync-group with multiple GTM devices (including a sync-group that contains only a single GTM server with more than one GTM device in it). -- Monitors specifying an explicit destination to connect to (e.g. with the property "destination 192.168.1.1:*"). -- The destination of a monitored object (e.g. the IP address of the gtm server) is different from the destination explicitly defined in a monitor assigned to the object. -- The two mismatching destination values are assigned to different GTM devices in the sync-group for monitoring.
bugs.impact: Monitored GTM objects may have an incorrect status.
bugs.fix: All monitor probes are not correctly assigned to a GTM device.

bugs.title: DNS NOTIFY with TSIG is failing due to un-matched TSIG name
bugs.symptoms: DNS NOTIFY messages are ignored.
bugs.conditions: The TSIG on the secondary needs to have the same algorithm and secret, but one or more characters in the name must be a different case.
bugs.impact: Failure to update the zone in a timely fashion.
bugs.workaround: Remove the offending TSIG on the secondary and re-create it with case matching the primary server.

bugs.title: No notification about disabled "Virus detected" violation in case of enabling "Anti-Virus Protection"
bugs.symptoms: If the "Virus detected" violation is disabled, there is no notification about it after enabling "Anti-Virus Protection".
bugs.conditions: 1. In Security ›› Application Security : Policy Building : Learning and Blocking Settings screen, for Virus Detected violation set at least one of the Learn, Alarm, or Block checkboxes as empty. 2. In Security ›› Application Security : Security Policies : Policies List ›› <selected_policy> screen - check the Scan HTTP Uploads (in Anti-Virus Protection field) 3. No warning is shown.
bugs.impact: No warning is shown to user which indicates that the related violation settings are switched off (Learning, Alarming or Blocking)
bugs.fix: Warning of the related switched-off violation settings will be shown.

bugs.title: PEM queries with filters return error message when a blade is offline
bugs.symptoms: Attempting to retrieve subscriber session data for a specific subscriber returns the following error: "Data Input Error: ERROR: 'query_view' query reply did not contain a result object."
bugs.conditions: One of the blades is disabled, and the pem sessiondb query contains a filter, for example subscriber-id or session-ip.
bugs.impact: Cosmetic error, no impact.
bugs.workaround: Enable the disabled blades, or send a pem sessiondb query without filters.
bugs.fix: No error is returned when sending a pem session query with filters when one of the blades is disabled.

bugs.title: HTTP2 monitors not sending request
bugs.symptoms: HTTP2 monitors do not send monitor traffic, incorrectly marking pool members down.
bugs.conditions: HTTP2 monitor configured.
bugs.impact: Pool members marked down erroneously.
bugs.workaround: Use different monitor type, if possible.

bugs.title: TMM may crash if a data-group is used when an SSL Forward Proxy Bypass/Intercept list contains extremely long entry
bugs.symptoms: A very long entry (exceeding the maximum length allowed by internet stndards) in a data-group used for SSL Forward Proxy Bypass/Intercept hostname list may cause TMM to crash.
bugs.conditions: All of the below conditions have to be met: -- A virtual server uses SSL profile -- This SSL profile has Forward Proxy enabled. -- The SSL profile has Forward Proxy Bypass enabled. -- The SSL profile uses Hostname Bypass and/or Hostname Intercept data-group. -- Anny to the data-groups contains entries which are longer than 255 characters.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Make sure all entries in the data-group used for intercept/bypass hostnanme list do not exceed 255 characters. According to RFC 1035 section 2.3.4, longer hostnames are not valid.
bugs.fix: TMM no longer crashes when hostname data-group entries are too long. Instead there is an error message logged: 01260000:2: Profile <affected SSL profile name>: could not load hostname bypass/intercept list However, incorrect entries need to be fixed as they are not valid anyway and make the data-group to be ignored.

bugs.title: Fasthttp connections infrequently fail
bugs.symptoms: BIG-IP can rarely send client payloads to servers before the connection has been fully established.
bugs.conditions: -- Fasthttp virtual server -- Cookie persistence enabled -- The payload is spread across multiple packets
bugs.impact: Some servers will reset the connection, causing client side HTTP requests to fail.
bugs.workaround: Use a fastl4/standard virtual server instead.

bugs.title: SSL::collect in CLIENTSSL_DATA prevents orderly connection shutdown
bugs.symptoms: If a virtual server has an iRule performing SSL payload processing in CLIENTSSL_DATA, TMM fails to process or forward an ingress TCP FIN from a client, leaving the connection in a zombie state until it eventually idles out.
bugs.conditions: The issue occurs only when SSL::collect is used in CLIENTSSL_DATA when CLIENTSSL_DATA { log local0. "." SSL::release SSL::collect }
bugs.impact: Unexpected growth in the number of connections idling on a virtual server leads to memory pressure.

bugs.title: in-tmm http(s) monitor accumulates unchecked memory
bugs.symptoms: Connflows growing larger than expected/desired.
bugs.conditions: -- in-TMM monitors are enabled -- http(s) monitors are configured -- Pool members continue spooling chunked data
bugs.impact: If an http(s) server does not close its connection to BIG-IP and continues spooling chunked data, the connflow remains and can eventually cause similar issues.
bugs.workaround: Three possible: 1. Fix the server. 2. Periodically reboot the server. 3. Use BigD LTM monitors.

bugs.title: Behavioral DoS does not ignore non-http traffic when disabled via iRule HTTP::disable and DOSL7::disable
bugs.symptoms: Non-HTTP traffic is not forwarded to the backend server.
bugs.conditions: - ASM provisioned - Behavioral DoS profile assigned to a virtual server - DOSL7::disable and HTTP::disable applied at when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {}
bugs.impact: Broken webapps with non-HTTP traffic.
bugs.workaround: Instead of using DOSL7::disable, redirect non-HTTP traffic to a non-HTTP aware virtual server using the iRule command virtual <virtual_server_name>.
bugs.fix: Fixed the Behavioral DoS HTTP::disable command handler in the tmm code.

bugs.title: Nitrox device error logs in /var/log/ltm
bugs.symptoms: The BIG-IP may log errors similar to the following: Apr 20 06:22:30 bigip1 crit tmm3[6615]: 01010025:2: Device error: n3-compress0 Zip engine ctx eviction (comp_code=4): ctx dropped. Feb 1 08:53:00 bigip1 crit tmm1[25889]: 01010025:2: Device error: n3-compress1 Zip engine ctx eviction (comp_code=6): ctx dropped.
bugs.conditions: When AVR is in use, a Nitrox accelerator card is installed in the BIG-IP.
bugs.impact: If these logs are not occurring frequently and are being caused by AVR they can be safely ignored. It is difficult to determine whether these messages are related to AVR or part of a hardware problem with the Nitrox. With AVR debugging enabled the following log message can be observed: <13> 2022-04-22T15:21:30.836+02:00 bigip1 notice AVR: AVR decompression failed (most likely out-of-memory or bad format, err=32)
bugs.workaround: Disable AVR or hardware compression: tmsh modify sys db compression.strategy value softwareonly

bugs.title: SSL handshake failures with invalid profile error
bugs.symptoms: 1. TMM reports SSL handshake failures with reason "hud_ssl_handler:1208: alert(40) invalid profile unknown on VIP" 2. There will be Certificate read errors in the ltm log "reading: Unknown error."
bugs.conditions: -- The certificates associated with the SSL profile are corrupted by modifying/adding/deleting them manually/Venafi -- There are frequent unintentional Certificate updates
bugs.impact: -- The BIG-IP system will not be able process the traffic -- All traffic to particular virtual servers fails
bugs.workaround: 1. Correct the certificates which are corrupted and make them valid. 2. Deattach/Remove the corresponding SSL profile from all virtual servers to which it is applied. 3. In the GUI open the virtual server and click on update and make sure there are no errors shown on the screen. 4. Now re-apply the SSL profile to the virtual server

bugs.title: TMM crash in nexthop_release with ACCESS_ACL_ALLOWED iRule event
bugs.symptoms: Tmm crashes. /var/log/tmm contains May 24 18:06:24 sslo.test.local notice panic: ../net/nexthop.c:165: Assertion "nexthop ref valid" failed.
bugs.conditions: An iRule is applied to a virtual Server containing a ACCESS_ACL_ALLOWED iRule event.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.

bugs.title: Fail to reset INSL statistics
bugs.symptoms: Below INSL statistics reset failure on profile in it or from TMSH: - tot_requests_instl_endpoints_matched - tot_requests_instl_served
bugs.conditions: - Bot Defense profile is configured. - Interstitial endpoint is configured.
bugs.impact: Below statistics can display higher numbers than expected: - tot_requests_instl_endpoints_matched - tot_requests_instl_served
bugs.fix: The INSL statistics reset as expected.

bugs.title: Improve MPTCP retransmission handling while aborting
bugs.symptoms: - MPTCP enabled TCP connection is aborting. - TMM cores.
bugs.conditions: - MPTCP is enabled. - MPTCP enabled TCP connection is aborting.
bugs.impact: Traffic disrupted while tmm restarts.
bugs.workaround: Disable MPTCP option in the TCP profile.
bugs.fix: Improved MPTCP retransmission handling while aborting.

bugs.title: In GUI, sorting needs to be implemented for "Websocket URL" page
bugs.symptoms: You are unable to sort Websocket URLs in the GUI.
bugs.conditions: Viewing the Websocket URL page
bugs.impact: The URLs cannot be sorted.
bugs.fix: Added sorting functionality to the websocket URLs page

bugs.title: Some portions of the BIG-IP GUI do not work when accessed behind an HTTP proxy
bugs.symptoms: Some sections of the BIG-IP GUI fail to load properly, and may report "An error occurred:" Additionally, iControl REST calls may fail with a 401 unauthorized error.
bugs.conditions: -- BIG-IP GUI or iControl REST is accessed behind a proxy that that includes an X-Forwarded-For header -- The "httpd.matchclient" BigDB key is set to true (this is the default).
bugs.impact: Some portions of the GUI are broken as well as iControl REST calls may fail.
bugs.workaround: Disable the "httpd.matchclient" DB key: tmsh modify sys db httpd.matchclient value false bigstart restart httpd
bugs.fix: REST Auth token client ip address and mod_auth_pam client ip address should match

bugs.title: Updating certKeyChain of parent SSL profile using iControl does not change the cert and key outside certKeyChain of the child profile
bugs.symptoms: Invalid config after iControl call: the certificate and key of the child profile do not change as expected.
bugs.conditions: 1. The SSL profile should default from a parent profile. 2. iControl REST is used to change the certkeychain of the parent profile. 3. The issue cannot be seen after the first call but from the second call, it's always reproducible.
bugs.impact: 1. The child profile has an incorrect configuration. 2. The older certificate/key can not be deleted as they are still in use in the child profile.
bugs.workaround: Can use currently deprecated iControl call by using key and cert instead of certkeychain as follows: curl -k -u admin:admin -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X PATCH https://10.155.75.246/mgmt/tm/ltm/profile/client-ssl/parent.example.com -d '{"key":"/Common/default.key","cert":"/Common/default.crt"}'

bugs.title: Broken "select all" checkbox functionality on WS URL page
bugs.symptoms: Under Overridden Security Policy Settings, select "Attack Signature" check box and it does not select all attack-signatures which are excluded in the "Websocket URL" page.
bugs.conditions: On the WS URL page, under overridden attack signature, click the "select all" checkbox and it does not select all items.
bugs.impact: On the WS URL page, under overridden attack signature, click the "select all" checkbox and it does not select all items.
bugs.workaround: Check each item manually.
bugs.fix: Fixed the "select all" checkbox functionality on the WS URL page.

bugs.title: Nlad core observed due to ERR_func_error_string can return NULL
bugs.symptoms: The following symptoms are observed In /var/log/ltm: err nlad[17535]: OpenSSL: DRBG Continuous RNG test failed: DRBG stuck. Nlad core is observed /var/log/kern.log:Apr 7 03:46:53 <vs name > info kernel: nlad[13119]: segfault at 0 ip <> sp <> error 4.
bugs.conditions: NLAD core is SIGSEGV - crashing while processing a SSL Certificate via a SAML login.
bugs.impact: Core results in disruption of APM sessions
bugs.fix: NA

bugs.title: Listing errors in tmsh and installation failures when the configuration includes an AVR scheduled-report.
bugs.symptoms: -- The tmsh utility may return an error when listing analytics configuration. -- TMOS installations may fail and return an error. -- Saving new UCS archives may fail and return an error. In all cases, the error is similar to the following example: TSocket::open() getaddrinfo() <Host: 127.3.0.2 Port: 9090>Name or service not known std exception: (Could not resolve host for client socket.), exiting...
bugs.conditions: -- Multi-blade VIPRION system (either metal or in the form of a vCMP guest). -- AVR is provisioned. -- At least one AVR scheduled-report is present in the configuration. -- An action such as listing the config, saving a UCS archive, performing a TMOS installation, etc. is performed on a secondary blade.
bugs.impact: The operation you were attempting fails and an error is returned.
bugs.workaround: The only workaround consists in removing all AVR scheduled-reports, performing the intended task, and then re-defining the AVR scheduled-reports as necessary. This is of course disruptive and may not be indicated for your site. If you require an Engineering Hotfix for this issue, please contact F5 Support.
bugs.fix: The presence of AVR scheduled-reports in the configuration no longer interferes with administrative tasks.

bugs.title: Refreshing DNS wide IP pool statistics returns an error
bugs.symptoms: Refreshing the wide IP pool statistics results in the error message 'An error has occurred while trying to process your request'.
bugs.conditions: Go to "Statistics > Module Statistics > DNS > GSLB > Wide IPs > Statistic Pools", and click "Refresh".
bugs.impact: No results are returned, and the error message 'An error has occurred while trying to process your request' is displayed.
bugs.workaround: N/A.

bugs.title: Request-log profile does not log HTTP version when HTTP2 request comes
bugs.symptoms: Request-log profile reports HTTP request protocol version as HTTP/1.1 despite actual client side request traffic is HTTP/2.
bugs.conditions: - HTTP/2 virtual server is configured. - request-log profile in use.
bugs.impact: Inaccurate HTTP request protocol version is logged by request-log profile in syslogs.
bugs.workaround: The iRule [HTTP::version] command can be used to report HTTP2 and HTTP3 versions.

bugs.title: [APM][UI] Wizard should also allow same patterns as the direct GUI
bugs.symptoms: Device wizard fails if a certain string is used in the access policy name: - access policy name that fails: abc_1234_wxyz - access policy name that works: abc-1234-wxyz An error can be found in the log: ERROR SAWizard.SACreateAccessPolicy:error - java.sql.SQLException: General error: 01020036:3: The requested Access Profile /common/abc_1234_wxyz was not found. in statement [DELETE FROM profile_access WHERE name = ?]
bugs.conditions: Using certain string patterns when creating an access policy via the wizard (specifically the underscore character).
bugs.impact: The wizard fails and throws errors.
bugs.fix: Fixed the naming mismatch by removing function to concat strings with extra _x.

bugs.title: TMSH/GUI fails to display IPsec SAs info
bugs.symptoms: Ipsec SAs are not visible in GUI/TMSH in tunnel/interface mode GUI network -> ipsec -> diagnostic -> traffic-selectors -> security association details shows no SAs The 'tmsh show net ipsec ipsec-sa traffic-selector ts' command shows no SA
bugs.conditions: -- Configure the ipsec with tunnel/Interface mode. -- Create the tunnel. -- Check the ipsec-sa
bugs.impact: You are unable to see ipsec-sa in GUI/TMSH
bugs.fix: Link of TS cfg with req_key was not working. Added code to fix the issue.

bugs.title: "Invalid monitor rule instance identifier" error after sync with FQDN nodes
bugs.symptoms: The following log messages may be observed in /var/log/ltm: bigip1 err mcpd[4783]: 01070712:3: Caught configuration exception (0), Invalid monitor rule instance identifier: 29. This may also result in some monitors stuck in "checking" state.
bugs.conditions: -- FQDN nodes exist on the configuration. -- A full config sync occurs -- Device contains a fix for ID1017513 -- May happen regardless of bigd or in-tmm monitoring
bugs.impact: Some monitor statuses may not be correctly reported. Some monitors may be stuck in "checking" state.
bugs.workaround: Force the mcpd process to reload the BIG-IP configuration: K13030.
bugs.fix: The monitors are responsive, no errors are recorded.

bugs.title: Messages with "Failed Read: User, referer" are logged in /var/log/httpd/httpd_errors
bugs.symptoms: After logging in to the GUI you may observe these logs under /var/log/httpd/httpd_errors warning httpd[7698]: [auth_pam:warn] [pid 7698] [client 10.6.4.2:61221] AUTHCACHE Error processing cookie AFQ6MCL2VWASB6NZTAWGQLFFWY - Failed Read: User, referer:
bugs.conditions: - Using token authentication for rest calls - Login to the GUI
bugs.impact: - Increased disk space usage under /var/log - Increased memory size of httpd processes
bugs.fix: These messages are no longer logged when not needed.
bugs.workaround: Growth in httpd memory use can be mitigated by restarting httpd: bigstart restart httpd

bugs.title: New HTTP RFC Compliance check for incorrect newline separators between request line and first header
bugs.symptoms: ASM does not enforce incoming HTTP requests where the request line and the first header are separated with a line feed ('＼n').
bugs.conditions: Any HTTP request with a line feed only at the end of the request line will not be enforced.
bugs.impact: Invalid requests might pass through ASM enforcement.
bugs.fix: HTTP requests with LF('＼n') as the only separator between the request line and the first header are enforced, and "Unparsable request content" is reported.

bugs.title: Decrement in MQTT current connections even if the connection was never active
bugs.symptoms: Current connections statistics display unrealistic values.
bugs.conditions: When MQTT Over Websockets setup is in passthrough mode.
bugs.impact: The correct count of the current connections is lost.
bugs.fix: Added a new field called 'activated' in pcb, to verify if the connection was activated at least once.
